The Andaman & Nicobar Administration, Directorate of Sports & Youth Affairs has released the official notification for Khelo India State Centre of Excellence Recruitment 2026 under the Khelo India Scheme. Candidates looking for government sports jobs in 2026 can apply for multiple contractual positions including High Performance Manager, Head Coach, Physiotherapist Grade-1, Nutritionist, Strength & Conditioning Expert, Masseur and Young Professional. The application process is completely offline, and eligible candidates must submit the prescribed application format before the closing date. This recruitment offers attractive monthly remuneration and an opportunity to work at the Netaji Sports Complex, Sri Vijaya Puram, Andaman & Nicobar Islands.

  • Strength & Conditioning Expert: Bachelor’s/Master’s in Sports Science or Strength & Conditioning certification.

  • Departmental candidates: Departmental candidate with three years continuous service in Central Govt will be given age relaxation up to 40 years of age (45 years for SC/ST)

Important Dates

Last date for receipt of application 21 days (including Sundays and holidays) from the date of publication of the advertisIndian Army DG EMEnt in the Employment News and 28 days (including Sundays and holidays) for those in Assam, Meghalaya, Arunachal Pradesh, Mizoram, Manipur, Nagaland, Tripura, Sikkim, Ladakh Division of Jammu & Kashmir State, Lahaul and Spiti Districts and Pangi Sub-Division of Chamba District of Himachal Pradesh, Andaman and Nicobar Islands and Lakshadweep. First date of this advertisIndian Army DG EMEnt in the Employment Newspaper will be taken into account for calculating 21/28 days. If closing date falls on holidays, then next working day will be taken as closing date for receipt of application.

Selection Process

  • Written test will be offline (Optical Mark Recognition (OMR) based) and "Objective Type" for 150 marks with Negative Marking of 0.25 mark for each wrong answer. Duration of examination is two hours. Question paper will be in bilingual i.e. English and Hindi and the syllabus will be in accordance to minimum qualification prescribed for the post at Para 2. Question paper will be "Multiple Choice Question" as under:-
  • Part-I: General Intelligence & Reasoning (50 Questions, 50 Marks)
  • Part-II: General Awareness (50 Questions, 50 Marks)
  • Part-III: General English (25 Questions, 25 Marks)
  • Part-IV: Numerical Aptitude (25 Questions, 25 Marks)
  • Skill test and Physical test (wherever applicable) will be conducted for candidates who pass the written test and come in merit. Skill test and Physical test (wherever applicable) will be qualifying in nature and the candidates who fail to qualify Skill/Physical test shall not be eligible for selection.

General Information / Instructions

  • The number of vacancies is subject to change. Further, the employer has the right to cancel or modify notification without assigning any reason thereof.
  • Abbreviations used: UR- Un-reserved
  • SC/ST/OBC candidates who apply against unreserved post will not be given age relaxation and other concession meant for SC/ST/OBC.
  • The crucial date for determining the age limit shall be the last date of receipt of application.
  • The age relaxation will be applied only in case of those candidates who produce valid certificate(s) of caste/category.
  • Date of Birth filled in by the candidate in application form and the same recorded in the matriculation examination certificate will be considered for determining the age and no subsequent request will be accepted.
  • Posts mentioned above are subject to "All India Transfer Liability and Field Service Liability Rules". Candidates selected may be posted to any "Unit or Location" depending on the organisational interest. No representation will be entertained.
  • Persons working in Central Govt/State Govt/PSUs must provide the "NOC" document obtained through the competent authority of his/her present organization to Recruitment Agency at the time of selection.
  • Application(s) will be shortlisted on the basis of percentage of marks obtained in the Essential Qualification referred at Para 2 and Admit cards will be issued accordingly. No weightage will be given for additional/ higher qualification.
  • Merely fulfilling the essential qualification does not automatically entitle a person to be called for test.
  • Admit card will NOT be issued in case of rejection/ late receipt of applications. Candidates will not be intimated in case of rejection of their application and no correspondence in this regard will be entertained.
  • Incomplete/ Eligible application will be deIndian Army DG EMEd invalid and rejected without intimation to the candidate.
  • Application(s) without DAVP advertisIndian Army DG EMEnt reference number will not be accepted.
  • No man who has more than one wife living and no woman who has more than one husband living, shall be eligible for appointment.
  • Canvassing in any form shall disqualify the candidature. No enquiry or correspondence will be entertained.
  • The selection board shall not be responsible for any lapse on the part of the candidate in this regard. Candidates are responsible for providing all factually correct data and correct certificates/documents. Providing factually incorrect data, fake certificates/documents for providing incomplete certificates/documents by the candidates will result in automatic rejection of his/her candidature.
  • Date of Document Verification, Written Examination and Skill Test for Barber trade as applicable will be intimated via admit card sent through ORDINARY POST in the envelope provided by the candidate alongwith the application and it should remain valid for the future communication. "Place of Work" and location for tests may be same i.e. Static Wksp Indian Army DG EME, Minnie Bay, Sri Vijaya Puram, Andaman & Nicobar Islands.
  • Date & Place of written examination for each trade will be intimated through admit card.
  • The selection committee has discretion to fix minimum qualifying marks in any or all parts of papers.
  • No Transportation Allowance/Dearness Allowance will be admissible. Examination including written / skill test / physical test (where applicable) will be for TWO (02) to FIVE (05) days or more days and may spread across different dates. Candidates will have to make their own arrangIndian Army DG EMEnt for lodging/boarding during conduct of all types of examination.
  • Candidates are required to carry "Admit Card" along with identity proof (either Passport, Aadhar card, PAN Card, Driving Licence) for confirmation while reporting for the document verification, physical test (where applicable), written test and skill test. Aadhar Card prepared more than 10 years ago will not be accepted and identity proof should have same name as given in the application.
  • Bio-metric will be done on first day and subsequent days of reporting of the candidate for the documents verification and written test/ Skill Test/ Physical Test.
  • There shall be no provision for re-evaluation and re-checking of the scores. No correspondence in this regard will be entertained. The decision of appointing authority regarding selection/rejection will be final.

How to Apply

  • Candidates to forward application as per prescribed format given in the advertisIndian Army DG EMEnt alongwith a self-addressed envelope (size-10.5 cm x 25 cm) with postal stamp of Rs 5/- properly sealed in an envelope to the address mentioned against the post applied for through ORDINARY POST. Candidates are requested to superscribe the words "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF "BARBER" on the top of the envelope while sending the application form.
  • Candidates are allowed to apply at one location and applications once submitted cannot be modified under any circumstance. No application will be received by hand.

  • Pay Matrix Level: Level-10
  • Salary Range: Rs. 57,700/- to Rs. 1,82,400/- per month
  • Post Category: Group-A Gazetted (Non-Ministerial)
  • Department: Government Colleges under Department of Education, Government of Arunachal Pradesh
  • Other allowances and benefits as admissible under rules will be provided

Age Limit

  • General Candidates: Up to 30 years of age
  • ST/SC Candidates: Up to 35 years (5 years relaxation)
  • APST Candidates: Up to 37 years (7 years relaxation from general category)
  • PwBD Candidates: Age concession as per Government rules and regulations
  • Regular Government Servants of Arunachal Pradesh: Age relaxation as per Government rules
  • Age relaxation is in accordance with "Assistant Professor for Government Colleges of Arunachal Pradesh" Group 'A' Gazetted (Non-Ministerial) Recruitment Rules 2024

Application Fee

Category Application Fee
APST Candidates Rs. 150/- (Rupees One Hundred Fifty Only)
Other Applicants (General/ST/SC) Rs. 200/- (Rupees Two Hundred Only)
PwBD Candidates NIL (Exempted as per Section 19 of Arunachal Pradesh Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules, 2018)

Important Dates

Event Date/Time
Notification Release Date 22/01/2026
Online Application Start Date 23/01/2026 (17:00 hours)
Last Date for Online Application Submission 23/02/2026 (11:00 hours)
Interview Date To be notified in due course

Selection Process

  • Selection Method: Through Viva-voce/Interview only
  • Total Interview Marks: 100 marks
  • Screening Committee: Commission will constitute a Screening Committee to shortlist candidates eligible for interview as per Appendix-II (Table 3B), UGC Regulations 2018
  • Interview Ratio: Eligible candidates will be invited for interview in the ratio of 1:3 subject to availability based on their score in Appendix-II (Table 3B)
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: Candidates must score minimum 50% of total marks in the interview to qualify for selection
  • Relaxation for PwBD: As per Government notification
  • Shortlisting Criteria: Academic score as specified in Appendix-II (Table 3B) for Colleges will be considered for shortlisting only; final selection based on interview performance
  • Final Selection: As per APPSC Manual for Conduct of Examination-2024

General Information/Instructions

  • APPSC invites online applications from citizens of India for Assistant Professor Examination-2026
  • The number of vacancies and reservation for APST and PwBD candidates are as per Requisition Proforma submitted by the indenting/requisitioning departments
  • Candidates must mandatorily register for One Time Registration (OTR) before filling online application
  • Those already registered in OTR need not register again and can directly login
  • Applicants in Government Service must upload intimation to Head of Department or NOC
  • Only single application should be submitted; if multiple applications submitted, highest Registration ID (RID) will be accepted
  • Fee paid against one RID shall not be adjusted against any other RID
  • Application form once submitted cannot be changed or modified
  • Candidates must carefully read the DISCLAIMER before final submission
  • Wrong information at any stage may lead to cancellation of candidature
  • Eligible candidates must produce all original certificates at the time of interview
  • Decision of Commission regarding eligibility is final
  • The Appointing Authority conducts medical test and verifies character, antecedents, authenticity of documents before appointment
  • Provisional recommendation does not confer right to appointment
  • PwBD candidates must submit disability certificate issued by certifying authority as per Section 57 of Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016
  • Medical Board for disability certificate must include specialty of particular disability as member
  • Selection process for PwBD candidates as per Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and Arunachal Pradesh Rules, 2018

How to Apply

  • Visit the official website: https://appsc.gov.in
  • Step 1: One Time Registration (OTR)
    • Before filling online application, candidates must mandatorily register for OTR
    • If already registered, use same user ID and password to login
  • Step 2: Fill Online Application Form
    • Login with OTR credentials
    • Fill all required details carefully and correctly
    • Application window active from 17:00 hours on 23/01/2026 till 11:00 hours on 23/02/2026
  • Step 3: Upload Required Documents
    • Signature on white paper with black ink (40-50 KB in JPG format)
    • Recent color passport size photo with white background (40-100 KB in JPG format)
    • Self-attested Matriculation Certificate/Marksheet with Date of Birth
    • Self-attested APST certificate (for APST candidates) or Aadhar Card/PRC/EPIC
    • Self-attested Bachelor's Degree certificates and marksheets
    • Self-attested Master's Degree certificates and marksheets
    • Self-attested NET/JRF/SLET/SET certificate
    • Self-attested M.Phil/Ph.D. certificates (if applicable)
    • Certificate from Registrar/Dean for Ph.D. prior to July 11, 2009 (Annexure-1 format)
    • Research publications in peer-reviewed journals
    • Teaching/Post-Doctoral experience certificates
    • Awards certificates
    • PwBD certificate (if applicable)
  • Step 4: Pay Application Fee
    • APST: Rs. 150/-
    • Others: Rs. 200/-
    • PwBD: Exempted
  • Step 5: Submit Application
    • Review all details before final submission
    • Once submitted, no changes allowed
    • Take printout for future reference
  • Detailed instructions for OTR and online application available on APPSC website

Documents Required for Upload

  • Signature of candidate on white paper with black ink pen (40-50 KB in JPG format)
  • Latest/Recent color passport size photo with white background, front faced without headgear and sunglasses (40-100 KB in JPG format)
  • Self-Attested photocopy of Matriculation Certificate/Marksheet with Date of Birth issued by Board
  • Self-Attested Photocopy of APST certificate for APST candidates and Aadhar Card/PRC/EPIC for other applicants
  • Self-Attested photocopy of Bachelor Degree certificates and Mark Sheets issued by Assistant Registrar/Registrar/Controller/Vice-Chancellor
  • Self-Attested photocopy of Master Degree certificates and Mark Sheets issued by concerned University authorities
  • Self-Attested NET with JRF/NET/SLET/SET certificate
  • Self-Attested photocopy of M.Phil/Ph.D. certificates as per UGC Regulations 2009 or 2016
  • Certificate from Registrar/Dean for Ph.D. prior to July 11, 2009 (Annexure-1 format)
  • Research Publications in Peer-Reviewed or UGC-listed Journals
  • Teaching/Post-Doctoral Experience certificates
  • Awards given by International Organizations/Government bodies

National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT)  has released an official notification for the recruitment of 117 Academic Position Posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply Online through the official NCERT website. The last date to submit the application form is 20-02-2026. In this article, you’ll find the NCERT Academic Position Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Online application form.

NCERT Academic Position Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF

Advertisement

Candidates who are interested in applying for the NCERT Academic Position Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the online application form.

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications

  • Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: An eminent scholar having a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, and published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per UGC Regulations-2018. A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate
    • Option B: An outstanding professional, having a Ph.D. degree in the relevant/allied/applied disciplines, from any academic institutions/industry, who has made significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, supported by documentary evidence provided he/she has ten years experience
  • Associate Professor: A good academic record, with a Ph.D. Degree in the concerned/allied/relevant disciplines. A Master's Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry with a minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of Seventy five (75) as per UGC Regulations-2018
  • Assistant Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time as the case may be exempted from NET/SLET/SET
    • Option B: The Ph.D degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking among top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of the following: (i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) (ii) the Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai)
  • Deputy Librarian: A Master's Degree in library science/information science/documentation science, with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever grading system is followed. Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian. Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library. A Ph.D. Degree in library science/Information science/Documentation Science/Archives and manuscript keeping/computerization of library
  • Assistant Librarian: A Master's Degree in Library Science, Information Science or Documentation Science or an equivalent professional degree, with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A consistently good academic record, with knowledge of computerization of a library. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time

Essential Qualifications

  • Educational qualification, experience, age of retirement on superannuation and pay scales of Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Deputy Librarian and Assistant Librarian will be as per the UGC/NCERT, Government of India norms as amended from time to time and in force at the time of closing date of filling-up online application
  • For Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian positions, NET/SLET/SET shall not be required for such Masters Programmes in disciplines for which NET/SLET/SET is not conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC
  • Candidates registered for the Ph.D. programme prior to July 11, 2009, shall be governed by the provisions of the then existing Ordinances/Bye-laws/Regulations of the Institution awarding the degree and such Ph.D. candidates shall be exempted from the requirement of NET/SLET/SET subject to fulfillment of specific conditions: Ph.D. degree awarded in regular mode, Ph.D. thesis evaluated by at least two external examiners, Open Ph.D. viva voce conducted, Candidate has published two research papers from Ph.D. work (at least one in refereed journal), Candidate has presented at least two papers based on Ph.D work in conferences/seminars sponsored/funded/supported by the UGC/ICSSR/CSIR or any similar agency
  • The fulfillment of these conditions is to be certified by the Registrar or the Dean (Academic Affairs) of the University concerned
  • The Academic score as specified in Appendix II for Universities and Colleges shall be considered for short-listing of the candidates for interview only, and the selections shall be based only on the performance in the interview as per UGC Regulations-2018 and as amended from time to time

Experience

  • Professor: A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate OR ten years experience as an outstanding professional from academic institutions/industry with significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned discipline
  • Associate Professor: A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry
  • Deputy Librarian: Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian with evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library
  • Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian: No specific years of experience required, but must have NET/SLET/SET qualification or Ph.D. degree exemption as per UGC norms

Desirable

  • For Professor positions: Published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120
  • For Associate Professor positions: A minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 75
  • For Deputy Librarian: Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library
  • For Assistant Librarian: A consistently good academic record with knowledge of computerization of a library

Salary/Stipend

  • Professor: Academic level 14 with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,44,200/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.37,400-67,000 with AGP-10,000)
  • Associate Professor/Deputy Librarian: Academic level 13A with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,31,400/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.37,400-67,000 with AGP-9,000)
  • Assistant Professor/Assistant Librarian: Academic level 10 with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 57,700/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.15,600-39,100 with AGP-6,000)
  • All pay scales are as per UGC/NCERT/Government of India norms and will be applicable as amended from time to time
  • Selected candidates will be entitled to other allowances and benefits as per Government of India/NCERT rules applicable from time to time

Age Limit (as on 20/02/2026)

  • Age of retirement on superannuation will be as per the UGC/NCERT, Government of India norms as amended from time to time and in force at the time of closing date of filling-up online application
  • The relaxation in age and percentage of marks to candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS/PWD categories is provided in accordance with the UGC/GOI/NCERT rules
  • Persons with Disability (PWD) having disability less than forty percent will not be considered. The disability certificate shall be from a competent medical board constituted by the central or state Government Hospital
  • Such persons should meet the prescribed criteria of physical disability of the respective category as per the Government of India rules

Application Fee

  • UR/OBC/EWS Candidates: Rs. 1000/- (Rupees One thousand only) through online payment mode only
  • Women applicants and applicants belonging to SC/ST/PWD: Exempted from payment of fee
  • No other mode of payment will be accepted other than online payment mode
  • Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances

Important Dates

Event Date & Time
Advertisement Number 177/2026
Commencement of Online Registration on NCERT website 31/01/2026 (10:00 AM)
Last Date of Online Registration and apply online 20/02/2026 (Up to 05:00 PM)
Closing date for eligibility criteria 20/02/2026

Selection Process

  • For Assistant Professor Posts: Up to 50 candidates (category-wise) for the first vacancy and 05 candidates for every additional vacancy will be called for the interview in order of their rank/merit in the list as prepared by the Shortlisting Committee on the basis of marks scored by the candidates, which should not be less than academic score of 60 (Sixty) in any case. In case of tie of marks at the 50th place for 01 vacancy and tie of marks at 5th place for every additional vacancy, all candidates whose marks tie will be called for interview
  • For Professor and Associate Professor Posts: The existing criterion of minimum academic score as per UGC guidelines will be followed subject to the condition up to 10 candidates (category-wise) for the first vacancy and 05 candidates for every additional vacancy will be called for interview in order of their rank/merit in the list as prepared by the Shortlisting Committee on the basis of marks scored by the candidates. In case of tie of marks at the 10th place for 01 vacancy and tie of marks at 5th place for every additional vacancy, all candidates whose marks tie will be called for interview
  • The Academic score shall be considered for short-listing of the candidates for interview only, and the selections shall be based only on the performance in the interview
  • The list of shortlisted candidates will be displayed on the NCERT website
  • The shortlisted candidates will be allowed to appear for the interview only after verification of their eligibility
  • The registration will be provisional as the eligibility of the shortlisted candidate will be verified at the time of Interview from the original documents
  • All Certificates, Degrees and other documents must be produced in original for verification at the time of interview (if shortlisted), failing which the candidate may not be allowed to appear for the interview
  • Final result of the selected candidates will be displayed on NCERT website
  • The Council will not entertain any correspondence with the candidates about their non-selection in the recruitment
  • The decision of the NCERT in all matters relating to selection and allotment of posts/organizations to selected candidates will be final and binding on the candidates

General Information/Instructions

  • National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT) is an apex organization for Educational Research, Teacher Training and Development of Curriculum and Instructional material in school education
  • Positions are available at NCERT, New Delhi and at its constituent units located at Ajmer, Bhopal, Bhubaneswar, Mysuru and Shillong
  • Only Indian Nationals need to apply
  • Eligible and interested candidates are required to apply online only through the NCERT website www.ncert.nic.in at Announcement-Vacancy-Academic. No other means/mode of submission of applications will be accepted
  • The candidates must have a valid email id and mobile number through which he/she will get registered with the online application portal
  • Candidates should fill in the details to register and then fill the information in the online application form at the appropriate places very carefully
  • Fields with STAR (*) mark are mandatory and essential to be filled in by the candidate
  • After the required information have been provided, click submit button. However, before clicking "Submit" button, candidate must make sure that no changes are required and the information provided is correct and final. After application is submitted, no changes will be entertained
  • Candidates are required to upload their scanned recent/colour passport size photograph, applicant's signature and all the relevant documents. The candidates have to keep a copy of application with documents for record and the same to be produced at the time of verification of document/interview, if shortlisted
  • In case a candidate wishes to apply for more than one post, he/she should submit separate application online along with the requisite fee for each post applied for. All the online applications should be completed in all respects. Only one application for individual post from one applicant will be accepted
  • The candidate should meet the eligibility criteria and provide the information which he/she possesses as on the last date of submission of the application. Candidates who do not possess the requisite educational qualification as on the closing date of receipt of application will not be eligible
  • Candidature of a registered candidate is liable to be rejected at any stage of recruitment process or even after joining, if any information provided by the candidate is found to be false or not in conformity with the eligibility criteria
  • Candidate must indicate his/her caste/category in the appropriate column of the application form (SC, ST, UR, OBC (NCL) & EWS etc). Leaving the caste column blank would not automatically be assumed as an application for un-reserved category and the application will be rejected as incomplete
  • The OBC-Non Creamy Layer candidates will be required to submit a valid caste certificate for purpose of reservation in appointment to posts under Government of India/Central Government from a competent authority along with latest Non Creamy Layer certificate and self-declaration that he/she does not belong to the creamy layer as on the closing date of submission of applications
  • The EWS candidates will be required to submit a valid certificate for purpose of reservation in appointment to posts under Government of India/Central Government from a competent authority and self declaration
  • Number of vacancies may vary depending upon the actual requirement. NCERT reserves the right not to fill up any or all the posts or cancel the whole process of recruitment without assigning any reason
  • Mere fulfilling the minimum eligibility requirements does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. NCERT reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates to be called for interview
  • The certificates, which are neither in English nor in Hindi, need to be translated preferably to either in English or in Hindi and the same shall be submitted along with the copy of the certificate in local language
  • The candidate who have received letter grades or grading points instead of marks, should provide conversion chart and percentage equivalent of their respective letter grades, issued by concerned board/university/institution
  • Any subsequent change of address/Telephone No./Email address should be promptly communicated to the Section Officer, Recruitment-1 Section, Room No. 12, 5th Floor, Zakir Hussain Block, NCERT, New Delhi- 110016
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification and the candidature is liable to be summarily rejected
  • In order to avoid last minute rush, the candidates are advised in their own interest to apply well in time
  • All applicants should submit Self Declaration as per prescribed format
  • Applicants serving under Government, Quasi-Government, Public Sector Undertaking and Autonomous Organizations should apply through proper channel and submit at the time of online application the permission letter from their present employer (No Objection Certificate)
  • The shortlisted non-local candidates will be entitled for reimbursement of Train fare restricted up to 3rd AC (except for Special trains like Rajdhani, Shatabadi, etc.) or the actual fare, whichever is less, on submission of tickets
  • Any litigation in the matter will be subject to the Delhi jurisdiction only
  • Candidates in their own interest are advised to remain updated with the selection/recruitment process by visiting the website www.ncert.nic.in regularly for any further instruction/information
  • In case of any query related to Advt. No. 177/2026, e-mail id of the section is [email protected]

Company Name District Disability Rehabilitation Centre (DDRC), North Tripura (DDRC North Tripura)

Post Name Total Posts

  09

Eligibility Criteria

  • Clinical Psychologist
    • M.Phil in Clinical Psychology; or
    • Professional Diploma in Clinical Psychology.
  • Sr. Prosthetist / Orthotist (OH category)
    • Bachelor in Prosthetics & Orthotics (BPO) from any Institute recognized by Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI).
  • Audiologist & Sr. Speech Therapist
    • Bachelor’s in Audiology and Speech & Language Pathology (BASLP); or
    • B.Sc in Speech & Hearing.
  • Hearing Assistant / Jr. Speech Therapist
    • Diploma in Speech & Hearing with knowledge of hearing aids repair and ear-mould making.
  • Mobility Instructor
    • Matriculation; and
    • Certificate/Diploma in Mobility.

    • Post Graduate Diploma in Community Based Rehabilitation (PGDCBR); or

    • Community Based Inclusive Development (CBID); or
    • MRW qualification.
  • Vocational Counsellor cum Computer Assistant
    • Diploma in Vocational Rehabilitation (DVR); or
    • Advanced Diploma in Child Guidance and Counselling (ADCGC); or
    • Bachelor of Rehabilitation Science (B.R.Sc.).
  • Early Intervention Therapist
    • PGDDT / PGDEI / BMR / BRSc / BRT / MRSc / MSc-EI.
  • Trans-Disciplinary Special Educator
    • D.Ed.SE / B.Ed.SE in Hearing Impairment; and/or
    • D.Ed.SE / B.Ed.SE in relevant disability categories as specified (e.g. ID/CP/ASD/MD/Db/SLD).
  • Common Age Criteria
    • Candidate’s age should be 40 years or less on the date of application.
    • Relaxation in upper age limit for ST and SC candidates as per Government of Tripura norms.

Salary/Stipend

  • Honorarium is specified as annual amount for each post:
    • Clinical Psychologist: Rs. 24,600/- per annum.
    • Sr. Prosthetist/Orthotist: Rs. 24,600/- per annum.
    • Audiologist & Sr. Speech Therapist: Rs. 24,600/- per annum.
    • Hearing Assistant/Jr. Speech Therapist: Rs. 17,400/- per annum.
    • Mobility Instructor: Rs. 17,400/- per annum.
    • Multi-Purpose Rehabilitation Worker: Rs. 17,400/- per annum.
    • Vocational Counsellor cum Computer Assistant: Rs. 17,400/- per annum.
    • Early Intervention Therapist: Rs. 17,400/- per annum.
    • Trans-Disciplinary Special Educator: Rs. 17,400/- per annum.
  • Engagement is purely contractual for 11 months; honorarium and conditions are as per DDRC norms for these posts.

Age Limit

  • Maximum age: 40 years or less on the date of application.
  • Age relaxation will be given to ST and SC candidates as per Government norms.
  • No specific mention of minimum age apart from the overall upper limit and usual eligibility for the qualifications.

Application Fee

  • No application fee is mentioned in the recruitment notification.
  • Candidates only need to submit Bio-data and supporting documents through the specified email within the given dates.

Important Dates

Event Date & Time
Start date for receiving applications (by email) 22/01/2026
Last date for receiving applications (by email) 10/02/2026 up to 5:30 PM
Period of contractual engagement 11 months from date of appointment (posts purely contractual)
Written test and interview date & venue To be informed in leading daily newspapers

Selection Process

  • Written test will be held for technical and administrative posts, followed by personal interview.
  • For non-technical post such as Attendant cum Peon cum Messenger (if advertised separately), only personal interview will be held (not part of the current table).
  • Written test pattern:
    • Total 20 marks of Multiple Choice Questions (MCQ).
    • Personal interview carries 5 marks.
    • Total: 25 marks.
  • Written test content: subject-oriented and post-related questions, including General Knowledge.
  • Pass mark: 50% in written test; candidates scoring 50% or more will be selected for personal interview.
  • Number of posts may increase or entire selection process may be cancelled at any time before or after the interview.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the written examination and interview.

General Information/Instructions

  • All posts are purely contractual for a period of eleven months; no claim for regular appointment will be entertained.
  • Applications must be submitted in soft copy (PDF) format by email only, along with recent passport-size colour photograph and self-attested copies of relevant documents.
  • Candidates’ age must be 40 years or less on the date of application; ST/SC candidates will receive age relaxation as per Government norms.
  • Applications received after 5:30 PM on 10/02/2026 will not be accepted; DDRC will not be liable for any delay in submission.
  • Examination date and venue will be notified through leading daily newspapers.
  • The number of posts may increase or the entire process may be cancelled at any stage without assigning reasons.
  • No travelling allowance or dearness allowance is payable for the written test or interview.

How to Apply

  • Prepare Bio-data strictly in the prescribed “BIO-DATA FORMAT” provided in the notification.
  • Fill in all required details including:
    • Name, Father’s/Husband’s name.
    • Permanent address with PIN code (attach address proof).
    • Date of Birth (with proof certificate).
    • Nationality (with proof).
    • Sex and category (UR/ST/SC) with caste certificate (for ST/SC candidates).
    • Contact number and valid email ID.
    • Educational qualifications (name of exam, Board/University, year of passing, percentage of marks).
    • Technical qualifications, registration numbers and experience details, if any, with supporting documents.
  • Attach self-attested copies of:
    • All relevant mark sheets and pass certificates.
    • Address proof and nationality proof.
    • Caste certificate (for ST/SC candidates).
    • Experience and registration certificates where applicable.
  • Scan the complete Bio-data and documents into soft copies (PDF), including a recent passport-size colour photograph.
  • Email the application between 22/01/2026 and 10/02/2026 (up to 5:30 PM) to the official DDRC email ID:
    [email protected]
  • Ensure that all documents are clearly legible; applications received after the deadline will not be accepted.

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications

  • Educational Qualification: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc) degree with Physics subject from any recognized university as on 01/08/2025
  • For General Category Candidates: Minimum 50% marks in B.Sc with Physics
  • For SC/ST Category Candidates: Minimum 45% marks in B.Sc with Physics

Essential Qualifications

  • Must be an Indian citizen
  • Bachelor of Science (B.Sc) degree with Physics from recognized university is compulsory
  • General category candidates must have secured minimum 50% marks in B.Sc
  • Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe candidates must have secured minimum 45% marks in B.Sc
  • The educational qualification should be completed by the cut-off date of 01/08/2025
  • Qualification certificates from matriculation/equivalent examination onwards must be produced during document verification

Experience

  • No specific work experience is required for this position
  • Fresh graduates with required educational qualifications can apply

Desirable

  • Knowledge of wireless communication and radio operations would be preferred
  • Physical fitness as per prescribed standards
  • Good academic record in Physics subject

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay Scale: Level-5 as per Bihar Government pay structure
  • The selected candidates will receive salary as per Level-5 pay scale with all applicable allowances
  • Standard government allowances including Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), and other benefits as per Bihar Government rules will be provided
  • Annual increments and other service benefits as per Bihar Police rules will be applicable
  • Medical facilities and other welfare benefits as per government norms

Age Limit (as on 01/08/2025)

  • For Unreserved (General) Category Male Candidates: Minimum age 21 years and Maximum age 37 years
  • For Unreserved (General) Category Female Candidates: Minimum age 21 years and Maximum age 40 years
  • For Backward Class and Extremely Backward Class (Male & Female): Minimum age 21 years and Maximum age 40 years
  • For Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe (Male & Female): Minimum age 21 years and Maximum age 42 years
  • Age Relaxation for Bihar Government Employees: 05 years relaxation for those seeking promotion to higher pay scale through competitive examination, provided they have completed minimum three years of regular service
  • Age Relaxation for Ex-Servicemen: 03 years plus the period of defense service, provided actual age on cut-off date does not exceed 57 years
  • Age calculation will be based on date of birth mentioned in Matriculation or equivalent examination certificate
  • The cut-off date for age calculation is 01/08/2025

Application Fee

  • For All Category Candidates (Male/Female/Third Gender): Rs. 100/- (Rupees One Hundred only)
  • Payment mode: Online only through Net Banking, Credit Card, Debit Card, or UPI
  • No other payment mode will be accepted
  • Bank charges for online transaction will be borne by the candidates
  • Application fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances
  • Candidates are advised to exercise caution while making payment and avoid multiple payments for single application
  • If amount is deducted due to electricity or internet failure or slow bank link and registration is not completed, the fee will be refunded by Payment Gateway after 07 working days
  • In case of charge back request from bank after successful registration, the application will be rejected and legal action will be initiated
  • BPSSC will not charge any amount other than the application fee mentioned above

Important Dates

Event Date
Advertisement Number 04/2026
Notification Date 02/02/2026
Online Application Start Date 04/02/2026
Online Application Last Date 04/03/2026
Cut-off Date for Age, Qualification & Experience 01/08/2025
Preliminary Examination To be notified
Main Examination To be notified
Physical Efficiency Test To be notified

Selection Process

  • Stage 1 - Preliminary Examination: One paper of 100 marks consisting of 100 objective multiple choice questions with 2 hours duration. 40 questions from General Knowledge and Current Affairs, 60 questions from Physics at graduation level. Minimum 30% marks required to qualify. Candidates scoring 20 times the number of vacancies (category-wise) will be shortlisted for Main Examination based on merit
  • Stage 2 - Main Examination: Consists of two papers:
    • Paper I - General Language Knowledge: 100 marks (50 marks General Hindi + 50 marks General English) of Intermediate level. Objective multiple choice questions. Duration: 1.5 hours. Minimum 30 marks required to qualify. Marks will not be added to merit
    • Paper II - Graduate Level Physics: 100 marks consisting of 100 objective multiple choice questions. Duration: 3 hours. Minimum 33% marks required to qualify. Based on marks in this paper, candidates up to 5 times the number of vacancies (category-wise) will be shortlisted for Physical Efficiency Test
  • Negative Marking: 0.2 marks will be deducted for each wrong answer in both stages
  • Stage 3 - Physical Efficiency Test: Qualifying nature (no marks awarded). All tests must be passed separately:
    • Running: Male candidates (all categories): 1 mile (1.6 km) in maximum 7 minutes. Female candidates (all categories): 1 km in maximum 7 minutes
    • High Jump: Male: Minimum 3 feet 6 inches. Female: Minimum 2 feet 6 inches
    • Long Jump: Male: Minimum 10 feet. Female: Minimum 7 feet
    • Shot Put: Male: 16 pounds shot - Minimum 14 feet. Female: 12 pounds shot - Minimum 8 feet
  • Maximum three attempts will be given for High Jump, Long Jump and Shot Put
  • Failure to achieve minimum standard in any of the four events will result in disqualification
  • Final Merit List: Based on marks obtained in Main Examination Paper II (Physics), successful candidates in Physical Efficiency Test will be selected as per number of vacancies category-wise
  • In case of normalization required due to multi-session/multi-paper examinations, Equi-Percentile Method will be used
  • Medical examination, character verification and background verification will be conducted by appointing authority before final appointment

Physical Measurement Standards

  • Height Requirements:
    • Unreserved and Backward Class Male Candidates: Minimum 165 cm
    • Extremely Backward Class, Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe Male Candidates: Minimum 160 cm
    • Female Candidates (All Categories): Minimum 155 cm
  • Chest Measurement (For Male Candidates Only):
    • Unreserved, Backward Class and Extremely Backward Class Male: Unexpanded - 81 cm (minimum), Expanded - 86 cm (minimum). Minimum 5 cm expansion compulsory
    • Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe Male: Unexpanded - 79 cm (minimum), Expanded - 84 cm (minimum). Minimum 5 cm expansion compulsory
    • No chest measurement for female candidates
  • Weight: Female candidates (all categories): Minimum 48 kg
  • For Kinnar/Kothi/Hijra/Transgender (Third Gender): Gender determination will be done as per identification card issued by District Magistrate under Section 6 of Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act, 2020 in Form-3. Category will be determined accordingly

General Information/Instructions

  • Bihar Police Subordinate Services Commission (BPSSC) is conducting recruitment for Assistant Sub-Inspector (Operation) posts in Bihar Police Radio (Wireless), Bihar, Patna
  • Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply. Male, Female and Third Gender candidates can apply
  • Reservation will be applicable as per Bihar Reservation of Vacancies in Posts and Services (for Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes and Other Backward Classes) Act, 1991 (Bihar Act 3, 1992) as amended from time to time
  • Women Reservation: 35% horizontal reservation for women in each reservation category (keeping intact 3% reservation for Backward Class women). This 35% horizontal reservation is admissible only to original residents of Bihar State as per General Administration Department resolution dated 09/07/2025. However, as per Section 4(3) of Bihar Act 3, 1992, women can also be appointed on merit basis in addition to 35% reservation
  • Freedom Fighters' Descendants: 2% horizontal reservation for grandchildren (grandson/granddaughter) of Bihar State freedom fighters who have been granted pension by Central Government as per General Administration Department resolution dated 03/09/2015. Selected candidates will be counted in their respective reserved/unreserved category
  • EWS Reservation: Reservation for Economically Weaker Sections as per Bihar Reservation in Vacancies in Posts and Services (for Economically Weaker Sections) Act, 2019. Income and Asset Certificate for financial year 2024-25 will be acceptable
  • Transgender Reservation: Kinnar/Kothi/Hijra/Transgender (Third Gender) are included at serial number 47 in Schedule-2 of backward classes list. They will get benefit of reservation applicable to backward classes as per General Administration Department resolution dated 12/09/2014
  • Benefit of reservation applicable only to original residents of Bihar State. Candidates from other states belonging to reserved categories will be treated as unreserved category candidates
  • Candidates working in State/Central Government/PSUs/Autonomous Bodies should apply through proper channel or produce No Objection Certificate at the time of selection
  • During written examination and physical efficiency test, candidates must follow social distancing and all latest instructions issued by administration for prevention from Corona infection
  • Admit card for written examination will be issued online. Information will be provided through newspapers and commission website. Important information may be sent through SMS/E-mail
  • Normally 06 months time may be required to complete selection process. Candidates are advised to ensure their availability for written examination, physical efficiency test and document verification. Request for time extension will not be accepted under any circumstances (family, personal, medical, bone fracture, pregnancy etc.)
  • The appointing authority for Assistant Sub-Inspector (Operation) post is Deputy Inspector General of Police (Wireless and Technical Services)
  • Before final appointment, medical examination, character and antecedents verification of all selected candidates will be conducted by appointing authority as per prescribed rules
  • Candidates must be free from such diseases, structural defects or physical weakness which make them unfit for duties
  • Medical examination will include tests for vision defects, color blindness, hearing power, stammering, flat foot, knocking knee etc. Being found fit in medical examination is mandatory for appointment
  • Candidates with stammering or stuttering defects will not be eligible for selection
  • BPSSC reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process or change any terms and conditions without further notice or assigning any reason at any stage
  • In case of any discrepancy found in Hindi version of advertisement, English version will prevail

How to Apply

  • Candidates must apply online only through BPSSC website https://bpssc.bihar.gov.in
  • Click on "Bihar Police" tab on the website and then click on Advertisement No. 04/2026 link
  • Online application start date: 04/02/2026
  • Online application last date: 04/03/2026
  • No other mode of application will be accepted
  • Before registration and payment, keep a valid and active mobile number and email ID which should preferably be registered in your name
  • Mobile number and email ID are mandatory for registration
  • If you don't have your own email ID, please create one as important information will be shared on your email ID and mobile phone during application and selection process
  • Commission will communicate with candidate on the same mobile number/email ID provided during registration till completion of final stage of recruitment
  • Commission will not be responsible for wrong, invalid or disconnected mobile number or email ID
  • Application Process - Part 1 (Registration):
    • First registration of candidate will be done where information like name, nationality, mobile number, email ID, Bihar State domicile, reservation category, gender and date of birth will be taken
    • After registration, payment process must be completed
    • After successful registration, Registration Number and Password will be sent immediately through SMS/E-mail to candidate's mobile phone and email ID
    • Before payment, candidates have facility to "Edit" their details
    • If you have registered with wrong details, you can use "Cancel Registration Form" provision to cancel your registration after payment. However, previously paid application fee will not be refunded and you will have to pay application fee again for new registration
  • Application Process - Part 2 (Final Submission):
    • After successful registration, login with provided Registration Number and Password
    • Fill required information like father's/husband's name, mother's name, address, educational qualification etc. correctly and give consent on declaration
    • Upload scanned recent color photograph (within 2 months old, white background, 15-25 KB, .jpg/.jpeg/.gif format)
    • Upload signature separately in English and Hindi (in black or blue ink, white background, 15-25 KB, .jpg/.jpeg/.gif format)
    • If instructions regarding photo and signature are not followed, online application will be rejected/cancelled
    • After uploading photo and signature, candidates can edit details by clicking "Edit Details" button before final submission
    • Once confirmed and submitted, application details cannot be edited
    • After submission, confirmation message (SMS/E-mail) will be received on registered mobile number/email ID
    • Print acknowledgement of submitted application on A4 size paper and keep it safely for future correspondence
  • Only one mobile number can be used for one application only
  • Only one application per candidate is allowed. In case of multiple applications from a candidate, all applications will be rejected
  • Candidates applying with fake name and address will be disqualified and strict legal action will be taken

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

  • Indian Nationals holding Graduate or Post Graduate degree in Law from recognized Universities, Colleges and Institutions of National and International repute, and/or Chartered Accountant.
  • Candidates should have obtained at least 50% marks in:
    • 3-year LLB, or
    • 5-year integrated LLB degree programme, or
    • Post Graduation degree programme, or
    • as a qualified Chartered Accountant.

Preferred Qualification

  • Chartered Accountants who have completed their articleship in taxation.
  • Law graduates/post graduates who have been engaged in research work/projects in taxation.
  • Candidates having skills in Information & Communication Technology (ICT) with good communication and interpersonal skills.

Age Limit

  • Candidates should not exceed 35 years of age as on the date of advertisement (27/01/2026).

Job Description

  • Young Professionals will be attached with the office of the CIT(DR) or Sr. DR in the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal.
  • They will study paper books of listed cases, analyse judgements relied upon by the assessee and find judgements in favour of the department.
  • They will identify distinguishing facts where applicable and prepare briefing notes and written submissions.
  • They will undertake research/study on specific points as briefed by the CIT(DR)/Sr. DR.
  • The Mentor (CIT(DR)) will provide orientation on deliverables at the time of joining.

Selection Process

  • The selection process will involve two stages:
    • Screening, and
    • Interview.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be informed via email or speed-post for personal interview.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
  • Shortlisted candidates must produce their bio-data and original certificates for verification at the time of interview.

    [Attention: ITO (Technical)-1],
    1st Floor, Central Revenue Building,
    Beer Chand Patel Path, Patna-800001, Bihar.
  • Mode of submission: By Speed-post or by hand.
  • The envelope containing the application should be superscribed as:
    “Application For Engagement Of Young Professional As Per Young Professional Scheme, 2023”.

Date of Advertisement 27/01/2026
Last Date of Receipt of Applications 17/02/2026 up to 06:00 PM

No specific application fee or processing charge is mentioned in the notification for this Young Professional engagement.

Salary/Stipend

  • No DA, accommodation, phone/conveyance/transport, foreign travel, personal staff, medical reimbursement, CGHS or similar facilities will be admissible.

Instructions

  • Deployment is full-time for one year, extendable by another year based on satisfactory performance.
  • Young Professionals are eligible for 8 days leave in a calendar year, accrued on a pro-rata basis; unavailed leave cannot be carried forward.
  • No remuneration is payable for absence beyond 8 days in a year.
  • The engagement does not confer any right to regular job/appointment or employer–employee relationship with the Income Tax Department.
  • Young Professionals are bound by the Indian Official Secrets Act, 1923 and must sign a Declaration of Secrecy and Non-Disclosure Agreement.
  • They must not publish articles, books or participate in media activities using information obtained during engagement without prior sanction of the Pr. CCIT Region.
  • Engagement may be discontinued at any time by the Department without assigning reasons; normally one month notice will be given.
  • Young Professionals may resign by giving one month’s notice to the competent authority.
  • Continuous absence for 8 days without information or valid reason will lead to automatic termination.
  • The provisions of the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition & Redressal) Act, 2013 will apply.

Selection Process

  • Mode of Selection: Computer Based Test/Written screening test of 120 marks of 1½ hours duration (or as decided by the Aayog) followed by a Typing Test, which shall be mandatory and qualifying in nature.
  • The objective type screening test will consist of 120 multiple-choice questions, each carrying 1 mark.
  • Scope of syllabus:
    – Subjects of 10+2 level prescribed as per essential qualification and as notified in the advertisement.
    – Syllabus relating to Computer Science/Computer Application/IT/ITES/Information Practices prescribed as essential qualification.
    – General Knowledge including General Knowledge of Himachal Pradesh, Current Affairs, Everyday Science, Logical Reasoning, Social Science, General English & General Hindi of Matric standard.
  • Skill test on computer with minimum typing speed of 30 wpm in English or 25 wpm in Hindi for those who qualify screening test; skill test is of qualifying nature.
  • Minimum qualifying marks in written screening test/OMR/CBT: 45% for General category candidates and 40% for SC/ST/OBC/ Wards of Freedom Fighters; Aayog may relax qualifying percentage by a maximum of 5% if required and record reasons in writing.
  • Where skill/physical test is essential, candidates will be shortlisted for such tests based on merit of MCQ/CBT as per ratios given (up to five times, specific caps for 30–40 and more than 40 posts).
  • In case of multiple-shift CBT examination, scores shall be normalized using Z-Score (Mean and Standard Deviation) method for merit preparation.
  • A category-wise waiting list/panel will be prepared, valid for one year from the date of sending recommendation by HPRCA to appointing authority; size of waiting panel depends on number of advertised posts as specified.

General Information/Instructions

  • Online Applications are invited through the official website of HPRCA (https://hprca.hp.gov.in); no offline application form will be accepted.
  • Candidates must be registered on One Time Registration (OTR) portal before filling the ORA and should carefully read instructions/terms and conditions before applying.
  • The downloaded copy of online application form along with necessary original certificates and self-attested photocopies must be brought at the time of document verification or whenever required by HPRCA.
  • Date for determining eligibility in respect of essential qualifications and experience shall be the prescribed closing date for submission of ORA.
  • Minimum and maximum age limits are reckoned as on 01.01.2026; category-wise relaxations apply only to domiciles of Himachal Pradesh as per rules.

  • HPRCA reserves the right to change terms of advertisement, rectify errors, club posts, determine criteria where eligible candidates are fewer, and to implement clarifications/instructions from Government during recruitment process.

How to Apply

  • Candidates must first sign up on the HPRCA portal (https://hprca.hp.gov.in) to create a username and password.
  • After sign-up, candidates must complete One-Time Registration by providing personal information, educational qualifications, work experience (if any), uploading recent photograph, signature and relevant supporting documents.
  • Only users with a completed profile can apply for posts; profile can be updated for changes in qualifications or contact details.
  • Candidates can view available posts on HPRCA portal and click “Apply” for the desired post (Junior Office Assistant (IT) (Job Trainee), Post Code 26001).
  • Applicants must select preferred exam district(s) from the dropdown; HPRCA reserves the right to allot any district/centre due to constraints like availability of computer nodes.
  • The system auto-fills application details from profile; candidates must review and confirm application details.
  • Candidates must pay application fee through the prescribed online payment gateway; no other mode is accepted.
  • After successful payment, the application is considered complete; candidates should ensure no column is wrongly filled or left blank and that all required documents/certificates are uploaded.
  • The notification also provides a checklist and detailed steps for uploading Matric, qualification, experience, category and other certificates, which must be produced in original at documentation.

  • For Pay Level 04 (Group C), the selection will be based on the written test, as per recruitment rules. Written test means Written Test / Computer Based Test and/or Trade Test and/or any other mode of test, as deemed fit.

Persons employed in Government/Semi Government Organizations/Autonomous Bodies/ PSU etc. should process their application through proper channel and submit No Objection Certificate (NOC) with vigilance clearance. Those who are unable to process their application through proper channel may submit 'No Objection Certificate (NOC)' mentioning clearly regarding vigilance clearance from their present employer during the time of interview/final selection. Application without NOC will be treated as advance copy, however the applicants must declare that NOC will be submitted at the time final interview/selection.

Only shortlisted applicants will be called for selection process. The decision of the Institute in this regard shall be final.

The applicants are advised to check the Institute website on regular basis. Applicants are also advised to provide correct email address and regularly check their emails including spam.

Selection Process for GSSC Primary School Teacher 2026

The selection process consists of THREE stages:

Minimum Passing Marks (CBT-I):

  • Unreserved (UR) candidates: 45%
  • OBC/PwD candidates: 40%
  • SC/ST candidates: 35%

Konkani Language Test (Mandatory):

  • Marathi Medium: Minimum 4 marks out of 10 required in Konkani test (mandatory for merit consideration)
  • Konkani Medium: Minimum 8 marks out of 20 required in Konkani test (mandatory for merit consideration)
  • Konkani language questions will appear in the first 10/20 questions
  • Only candidates securing minimum qualifying marks in Konkani will be evaluated for merit list

Shortlisting for CBT-II: 3.5 times the number of posts in each category/sub-category based on CBT-I merit

Stage 2: Computer Based Test - II (CBT-II)

For Marathi Medium Teacher:

Subject Marks
Test of English & Comprehension 10
Test of Numerical Ability 10
Test of Reasoning 10
Test of Marathi Language (including basic grammar) 40
Test of Methodology/Education Pedagogy 10
TOTAL 80 Marks

For Konkani Medium Teacher:

Subject Marks
Test of English & Comprehension 10
Test of Numerical Ability 10
Test of Reasoning 10
Test of Konkani Language (including basic grammar) 40
Test of Methodology/Education Pedagogy 10
TOTAL 80 Marks

Duration: 100 minutes (135 minutes for PwD candidates with compensatory time of 35 minutes)

Shortlisting for Class Demonstration: Twice the number of candidates in each category/sub-category based on CBT-II merit

Stage 3: Class Demonstration - 10 Marks

  • Candidates will be asked to demonstrate on a particular concept of the post for which they have been shortlisted
  • Shortlisted based on CBT-II performance
  • Carries 10 marks

Final Merit & Selection

  • Combined Score: CBT-II marks + Class Demonstration marks
  • Common merit list prepared in descending order of Combined Score
  • Selection process as per Government of Goa O.M. No.1/6/83-PER(Vol.II)Pt.(a)/143 dated 14.01.2019
  • In case of tie (equal marks): Candidate born earlier gets precedence
  • Wait list will also be prepared for each post in descending order of merit

Selection Process (Category-wise):

  1. First: PwD/Ex-Servicemen/Meritorious Sportspersons candidates shortlisted on merit and adjusted against their vertical category (UR/ST/SC/OBC/EWS)
  2. Second: Unreserved (UR) category candidates shortlisted in descending order
  3. Third: Reserved category candidates (who didn't avail age relaxation/concessions except fee) adjusted against UR if eligible on merit
  4. Fourth: Reserved category candidates (OBC/SC/ST/EWS) shortlisted separately in descending order

Important Selection Notes:

  • No Negative Marking in CBT examinations
  • CBT-I is only for screening/shortlisting (marks not counted for final merit)
  • Question type: Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs)
  • Compensatory time for PwD: 25 minutes for CBT-I (60 marks), 35 minutes for CBT-II (80 marks)
  • If PwD/Meritorious Sportspersons not available in their reserved category, vacancies deducted from unreserved
  • If Ex-Servicemen not available, vacancies filled by meritorious candidates
  • If reserved category candidates not available, vacancies remain unfilled

  • Merit list, objections, document verification, skill test, selection list etc. uploaded on Collector office notice board and https://kawardha.gov.in.
  • All information regarding direct recruitment only through https://kawardha.gov.in; no other correspondence.
  • Ineligibility: Candidate married before minimum marriage age; male with more than one living wife or female married to such male; not medically fit; not suitable after inquiry; convicted of offense against women.

Age Limit (as on 01 January 2026)

Residence / Domicile Requirement

Assistant cum Data Entry Operator

  • Preparation of merit list based on: Educational qualification marks – 80 marks, Experience – up to 10 marks, Skill Test – 10 marks.

Outreach Worker

  • Merit list based on: Educational qualification – 80 marks, Relevant experience – up to 10 marks, Interview/Skill Test – 10 marks.
  • Candidates will be shortlisted according to merit for interview/skill test as per department decision.

Tie-Breaking Rules

  • If two or more candidates obtain equal total marks, preference will be given to the candidate older in age (based on date of birth).

Experience Requirements

  • Experience certificates must be issued by the employer on official letterhead with office name, registration number, address, post name, nature of work, and duration/period of experience clearly mentioned.
  • Only full-time experience will be considered; voluntary or part-time services will not be counted.
  • Experience marks: 2 marks per completed year of relevant experience, subject to a maximum of 10 marks.

How to Apply for Balodabazar District Child Protection Unit Recruitment 2026

  1. Download the application form: Obtain the prescribed application format from the official Balodabazar district website under the recruitment/notice section of Women and Child Development Department.
  2. Take print and affix photo: Print the application form on A4 size paper and paste a recent passport-size photograph in the given box (upper right corner) with self-attestation across the photo.

  5. For government employees: Attach a proper No Objection Certificate (NOC) from your current employer if working in any government/semi-government/PSU organization.
  6. Verify mobile number and email ID: Ensure your active mobile number and email ID are clearly written in the form for communication regarding merit list, skill test, or interview.
  7. Submit the application offline: Put the filled form with all enclosures in an envelope and submit it by post or by hand to the given district office address so that it reaches on or before 16 February 2026 within office hours.

Note: Applications received after the last date, incomplete forms, or forms without required documents are liable to be rejected without any correspondence.

Application Submission Address

Send/submit the application to the following address:
District – Balodabazar-Bhatapara, Chhattisgarh
Phone: As mentioned in the official advertisement.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • All posts are purely contractual for 3 years under Mission Vatsalya Yojana with no claim for permanent government service.
  • Selected candidates must undergo a medical examination within 1 month of selection and submit a health fitness certificate; if found medically unfit, services may be terminated.
  • Selected candidates must join and report with original documents within 15 days from the date of issue of appointment order.

  • Age, educational qualification, and experience will be considered strictly as on 01.01.2026.
  • Any form of canvassing, recommendation, or influence will lead to disqualification of the candidate.
  • Reservation will be applicable as per Chhattisgarh Public Service (Reservation) Act, 1994 and related government orders.
  • Only local residents of Chhattisgarh fulfilling domicile conditions are eligible to apply for these posts.

NIT Raipur Faculty Positions Recruitment 2026 Overview

Advertisement
Company Name National Institute of Technology Raipur (NIT Raipur)
