Name of the Post Department Category-wise distribution
Professor (Pay Level 14A) 1) Biomedical Engineering; 2) Chemistry; 3) Information Technology ST – 02 and OBC – 01
Associate Professor (Pay Level 13A2) 1) Architecture and Planning; 2) Biotechnology; 3) Chemical Engineering; 4) Mechanical Engineering; 5) Mining Engineering and 6) Physics SC- 02, ST - 02 and OBC – 02
Assistant Professor Grade I (Pay Level 12) 1) Architecture and Planning; 2) Biomedical Engineering; 3) Chemistry; 4) Metallurgical and Materials Engineering ST-01, OBC-03
Assistant Professor Grade II (Pay Level 10) Biotechnology OBC-01

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualification: The qualification and other terms and conditions of appointment of academic staff as specified under Schedule ‘E’ of NIT Statutes (Amended 2017) (Ref. Gazette of India No. 651, dated July, 24, 2017) shall be read in conjunction with the guidelines or clarifications issued with the approval of the Council on 13thSeptember, 2017; 30th November 2017, 4th December, 2017; 31st January, 2018; 20thApril, 2018; and 16thApril, 2019 and other amendments issued by MoE, Govt of India from time to time (available at www.nitrr.ac.in\recruitment_rules)
  • Essential Qualification: For Engineering Disciplines: B.E./B.Tech. or equivalent and M.E./M.Tech. or equivalent and Ph.D. in relevant/ equivalent discipline with first class in the preceding Degrees. BE/B.Tech. with direct Ph.D. with first class in preceding Degree will also be considered.
  • Essential Qualification: For Architecture Department: B. Arch. or equivalent and M.Arch./M.Plan. or equivalent. Further following shall also be essential qualification without insisting on credit point requirements at Assistant Professor level: (i) M.Arch. or M.Plan. or equivalent with one-year professional experience: Assistant Professor at Academic Grade Pay of Rs. 6000 (ii) M.Arch. or M.Plan. or equivalent with two-year professional experience: Assistant Professor at Academic Grade Pay of Rs. 7000 (iii) For higher cadres the educational qualifications and credit point requirement shall remain same as given in the Table of Schedule‘E’ for Engineering and Sciences
  • Essential Qualification: For Non-Engineering Departments: Ph.D. degree in the relevant or equivalent discipline with first class in preceding Degrees.
  • Desirable Qualification: In case, first class is not mentioned in the preceding Degrees by the University / Institution, then the candidates should have secured at least 6.5 CGPA (on a 10-point scale) or 60% marks in aggregate.
  • Desirable Qualification: In case the candidate has secured CGPA under any other point scale (other than 10-point scale), then certificate issued by the authorized signatory (not the Mentor/Supervisor/Head of the Department) of the Institute / University to the effect of having secured first class in such Degree must be attached. Alternately, the CGPA may be equivalently converted on 10- point scale for determination of eligibility.
  • Desirable criteria for Professor (Level 14A): (a) Good quality publications with at least 20 papers in SCI/SCIE/SSCI Journals. (b) At least three, in combination of ongoing/ completed externally sponsored research project AND/OR patent granted. (c) Supervised at least two Ph.D. completed and one ongoing. (d) Organized three activities in cumulative of Conference(s) OR at least 5 days Workshop/ STTP/FDP course(s).
  • Desirable criteria for Associate Professor (Level 13A2): (a) Good quality publications with at least 10 papers in SCI/SCIE/SSCI Journals. (b) At least two, in combination of ongoing/ completed externally sponsored research project AND/OR patent granted. (c) Supervised at least one Ph.D. completed and one ongoing. (d) Organized two activities in cumulative of Conference(s) OR at least 5 days Workshop/ STTP/FDP course(s).
  • Desirable criteria for Assistant Professor (Level -12): (a) Good quality publications with at least 5 papers in SCI/SCIE/SSCI Journals. (b) At least one ongoing/ completed externally sponsored research project OR one patent granted. (c) Supervised at least one Ph.D. completed/ ongoing. (d) Organized one Conference OR at least 5 days Workshop/ STTP/FDP course.
  • Desirable criteria for Assistant Professor (Level -10): (a) Good quality publications with at least 3 papers in SCI/SCIE/SSCI Journals.
  • Experience: Experience as per Clarification no. 7, GoI, Ministry of Education(MoE, erstwhile MHRD), F.No.33-9/2011-TS.III, Dated 16th April, 2019, (including prior to implementation of NIRF) shall be considered if acquired in any of the following Institutions: • Fully Funded Central Educational Institutions. • IIMs, Other Management Institutions and Research institutions ranked by NIRF up to 50 for any two years. • State Educational Institutions funded by respective State Government. • Other Educational Institutions (Universities and Engineering institutes) ranked by NIRF up to 100 in Overall, and 10 for Architecture, for any two years.
  • Experience: Experience as mentioned above and as per RRs in an Institution/ Organization will only be considered for calculating total experience.
  • Administrative Experience: Contributions to Institute/Department Administration shall be recommended by concerned Head and approved by the Head of the Institution. Otherwise, weightage of administrative experience for evaluating the credit points may not be considered for determining the eligibility. No correspondence shall be entertained in this regard. [As prescribed in Note 1, Point no. 4 of Schedule ‘E’ of NITs Statutes (vide Gazette of India No. 651, Dated, July 24, 2017)].
  • Experience: Less than six months of individual (independent/discrete) experience in different Organizations with gaps in-between even in relevant regular position in any Organization will be ignored in computing total experience.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Assistant Professor Grade I & Grade II: Pay Level 12, 10
  • Associate Professor: Pay Level 13 A2
  • Professor: Pay Level 14 A

Age Limit (as on 17-02-2026)

  • Below 60 years, however candidates within 35 years will be preferred for the entry level post of Assistant Professor Level 10 and 12.
  • Age relaxation may be given for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PWD candidates as per the Govt. of India (GoI) norms.

Application Fee

  • Rs. 2500/- (Rupees Two Thousand Five Hundred Only) for OBC applicants
  • Rs. 1250/- (Rupees One Thousand Two Hundred Fifty Only) for SC/ ST/ PWD applicants
  • No Processing Fee is required from the existing regular Faculty of NIT Raipur
  • For the candidates applying from abroad, application fee will be Rs. 5000/- (Rupees Five Thousand Only)

Important Dates

Notification Date 9 January 2026
Online Application Start Date 15 January 2026
Last Date for Online Application 17 February 2026
Last Date for Hard Copy Submission 27 February 2026

Selection Process

  • The short-listed candidates may be required to appear for written exam/presentation/seminar in the respective Departments, in addition to facing the Selection Committee.
  • The final selection of such candidates will be made on the basis of the recommendations of a Medical Board appointed for examining the physical disability at Raipur.

General Information / Instructions

  • This being an advertisement governed by the four-tier flexible Faculty Recruitment Rules, relevant instructions from MoE issued till the date of interview will be applicable to this recruitment process.
  • The Institute reserves the right to increase/decrease number of vacancies including those in the Reserved Categories without notification.
  • Since all the posts are to be filled-in by open advertisement, candidates working in NIT Raipur who are aspiring for higher Pay levels are required to submit their application even if the posts in the concern Department are not advertised.
  • For the Departments which are not having any vacancy, movement in higher Pay Level or Cadre will be carried out as per specified selection process but restricted to only for serving faculty members of the respective Departments of the Institute (as per Note 1(5) of Schedule ‘E’ of Statutes 23[5](a) of the First Statutes of the National Institute of Technology (Amendment) Statutes, 2017) and as directed by MoE, Government of India, from time to time.
  • The Institute reserves the right to modify/ defer or cancel full / part of the advertisement / recruitment process at any stage of processing without assigning any reason whatsoever and no communication in this regard will be made.
  • Financial assistance for attending national/international conferences for presenting research papers or Chairing sessions, for sponsored training in India and abroad, for membership of professional Societies etc. under the Scheme of Cumulative Professional Development Allowance [CPDA] limited to Rs.1.00 lakh per annum subject to the maximum limit of Rs.3.00 lakh in a block period of three years or as per rules.
  • An initial Research Grant (Seed Grant) up to Rs. 5.00 Lakh for new Faculty as per Institute norms.
  • Provision for undertaking consultancy and testing work as per Institute norms.
  • On campus residence [depending on availability].
  • Medical Facilities to Faculty and their dependent family members as per rules.
  • Reimbursement of expenses on telephone as per approved norms.
  • Group Insurance Scheme for Faculty as per Institute norms.
  • Provision of Child care Leave, Children Education Allowance and maternity/paternity Leave as per Government of India (GoI) norms.
  • LTC as per Government of India (GoI) norms.
  • HRA as per the Government of India (GoI) norms.
  • New entrants will be covered under the New Pension Scheme [NPS-2004] as per Ministry of Education Guidelines, GoI norms, NIT Act and Statutes. The existing Faculty members, if selected, shall be governed by their current Pension Scheme.
  • Leave will be granted as per CCS Leave Rules, 1972.
  • The appointees will be granted ‘No Objection Certificates’ and applications of such appointees for outside job can be forwarded only after completion of two years of services and as per the NIT Statutes.
  • Candidates are required to go through the details of Posts and instructions available on the Institute Website carefully before applying to ensure their eligibility for the post.
  • All recruitment and pay-fixation shall be done by the Appointing Authority, i.e., Board of Governors (BoG) of the Institute only on the recommendations of duly constituted Selection Committees. The decision of the Appointing Authority shall be final. There is no scope for fixing or altering the pay (pay in Level/Cell) outside the Selection Committee for Level10 and 12. The Selection Committee shall be the only entity empowered to consider the past services and qualifications of a candidate. However, higher starting Pay and/or Pay Level may be offered to deserving candidates on recommendation of the Selection Committee upon approval of the Board of Governors for Levels 13A2 and 14A. Selected candidates to the above faculty positions will be fixed in the minimum basic pay as per norm and only the regular service at NIT Raipur, will be counted for any purpose thereafter.
  • As this is a fresh appointment [As per Schedule ‘E’ of Statute 23(5)(a) Note 1(1)], any change in the Pay Level/Cell in 7th CPC, is through direct recruitment through open advertisement. Therefore, the term “promotion” used in RRs/ Guidelines/ MoE (erstwhile MHRD) communications should be read as “Appointment through Direct Recruitment”.
  • The appointee (new entrants)in the contract position should undergo or submit medical fitness certificate and verification of the character antecedent in consonance with; the GoI guidelines.
  • Persons serving in Govt. / Semi Govt. / PSUs / Universities / Educational Institutions should send their applications either THROUGH PROPER CHANNEL or should furnish a NO OBJECTION CERTIFICATE from the Competent Authority of the Organization serving, in the prescribed form at the time of interview otherwise they may not be allowed for interview. However, they can submit the advance copy of the Application Form.
  • Applications which are not online/ not in prescribed form / without relevant supporting enclosures and without fee shall be summarily rejected. No correspondence shall be entertained in this regard.
  • The minimum qualification with regard to academic qualification and experience (on credit basis) for all positions advertised shall be governed by the Schedule ‘E’ of NITs Statutes (issued vide Gazette of India No. 651, Dated July, 24th 2017 [As per Schedule ‘E’ of Statute 23(5)(a), Note 1(1)] and the Amendments.
  • Desirable areas of specialization in various Departments are given in Annexure-II. However, candidates with other relevant areas of specialization may also apply.
  • The date for determining the eligibility of candidates in every respect, i.e., qualifications, experience and preferred age limit etc. shall be considered as on the closing date, i.e., the last date of the submission of Online Application Form.
  • Instructions for submission of application are attached in Annexure-III and is required to be followed.
  • Candidates shall indicate two references of Eminent Person(s) in the specialization/ profession who may be contacted by the Institute for their recommendations.
  • Original documents along with one set of self-attested copies will have to be produced at the time of interview for verification.
  • All Degrees and Certificates should have been obtained from recognized Institute/University.
  • Mere possession of minimum qualification/ experience will not entitle the candidate to be called for interview/ selection or appointment.
  • The Institute has the right to set higher norms than minimum and the areas of specialization while shortlisting, taking into account the specific requirements of the individual departments. The short-listing norms may not be uniform across the departments/ posts of the Institute and shall be binding on all the applicants. Priority of shortlisting shall be as under: (i) All three degrees (UG/PG/PhD) from IIT/IISc/IIM/NIT or reputed institute with NIRF ranking within 100 for universities and engineering institutes or 50 for management institutes for three years or foreign university an institute in QS/THE world ranking upto 500. (ii) At least two degrees (UG/PG/PhD) from IIT/IISc/IIM/NIT or reputed institute with NIRF ranking within 100 for universities and engineering institutes or 50 for management institutes for three years or foreign university an institute in QS/THE world ranking upto 500. (iii) At least one degree (UG/PG/PhD) from IIT/IISc/IIM/NIT or reputed institute with NIRF ranking within 100 for universities and engineering institutes or 50 for management institutes for three years or foreign university an institute in QS/THE world ranking upto 500.
  • The decision of the Institute related to all matters pertaining to the recruitment shall be final and binding on the applicants.
  • Note: if the candidate achieves the degree under integrated mode, then it shall be considered as two degrees among UG/PG/PhD.
  • Policy on avoiding ‘In-Breeding’: Candidates who have obtained their most recent Degree (Ph.D.) from NIT Raipur, will not be considered for recruitment, except where there is a 3-year gap between leaving the Institute and last date of the submission of online application.
  • Govt. of India (GoI) norms of Reservations are followed in the Institute. All reserved candidates are required to submit their Caste/Category certificates in prescribed format [Annexure-IV/V/VII] along with the hard copy of application. No other certificate will be accepted as sufficient proof of Caste/Category.
  • The Caste/Tribe/Community certificates (Annexure-IV) in the proforma prescribed and issued by any of the authorities stated in the OM No. 36012/6/88-Estt. (SCT), Dated 24.4.1990 and OM No.36012/22/93-Estt. (Res.), Dated 15.11.1993, GoI, No. 36028/1/2014-Estt (Res), Dated 3rd September, 2015 will only be accepted as sufficient proof in support of a candidate’s claim belonging to Schedule Caste/ Schedule Tribe/ Other Backward Class (NCL). Relevant Caste /Tribe/ Community certificates are required to be submitted with duly completed application form. No other certificate will be accepted as sufficient proof.
  • (i) The caste of the candidate must be in the State-wise Central list of SCs given at: https://socialjustice.gov.in/common/76750 or https://socialjustice.gov.in/writereaddata/UploadFile/Compendium-2016.pdf
  • (ii) The caste of the candidate must be in the State-wise Central list of STs given at: https://tribal.nic.in/ST/LatestListofScheduledtribes.pdf
  • OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate issued on or after 1stApril 2025 shall only be considered for reservation under OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) category. [Refer Annexure-V].
  • EWS certificate should be issued by Competent Authority (Tahsildar or above). Also, this certificate must be issued on or after 1st April 2025 in order to be considered for reservation under EWS category [Refer Annexure-VI], (NOT APPLICABLE IN THIS ADVERTISMENT).
  • The persons with disability (PWD) shall be required to submit the Disability/Medical Certificate in the prescribed form (Annexure–VII) issued by the Competent Medical Authorities for the purpose of employment as per Government of India norms along with the hard-copy of the application form.
  • The reserved candidates who have applied for unreserved posts will not be eligible for any age relaxation or any other concessions as per DOPT Office Memorandum No. 36011/1/98 Est. (Res) Dated, 1-7-98.
  • The directives contained in the matter of reservation in posts and implementation of Central Educational Institutions Act, 2019 enunciated in the Ministry of Education’s letter dated 05.11.2019 (attached herewith as Annexure-VIII) shall be applicable.
  • Canvassing in any form and/or bringing any influence of any form will be treated as disqualification for the faculty position applied.
  • Legal disputes if any, with NIT Raipur will be restricted within the jurisdiction of Raipur Courts only.
  • The applicant will be solely responsible for the authenticity of submitted information, documents and photographs, etc.
  • The list of candidates shortlisted for further participation in the selection process such as written test/presentation/interview etc. will be displayed on the Institute Website only. The applicants need to keep on visiting Institute Website www.nitrr.ac.in for updates. No correspondence will be made regarding non-eligibility/ not-short listing/ non-selection of the candidates.

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications

  • Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: An eminent scholar having a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, and published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per UGC Regulations-2018. A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate
    • Option B: An outstanding professional, having a Ph.D. degree in the relevant/allied/applied disciplines, from any academic institutions/industry, who has made significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, supported by documentary evidence provided he/she has ten years experience
  • Associate Professor: A good academic record, with a Ph.D. Degree in the concerned/allied/relevant disciplines. A Master's Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry with a minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of Seventy five (75) as per UGC Regulations-2018
  • Assistant Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time as the case may be exempted from NET/SLET/SET
    • Option B: The Ph.D degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking among top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of the following: (i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) (ii) the Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai)
  • Deputy Librarian: A Master's Degree in library science/information science/documentation science, with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever grading system is followed. Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian. Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library. A Ph.D. Degree in library science/Information science/Documentation Science/Archives and manuscript keeping/computerization of library
  • Assistant Librarian: A Master's Degree in Library Science, Information Science or Documentation Science or an equivalent professional degree, with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A consistently good academic record, with knowledge of computerization of a library. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time

Essential Qualifications

  • Educational qualification, experience, age of retirement on superannuation and pay scales of Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Deputy Librarian and Assistant Librarian will be as per the UGC/NCERT, Government of India norms as amended from time to time and in force at the time of closing date of filling-up online application
  • For Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian positions, NET/SLET/SET shall not be required for such Masters Programmes in disciplines for which NET/SLET/SET is not conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC
  • Candidates registered for the Ph.D. programme prior to July 11, 2009, shall be governed by the provisions of the then existing Ordinances/Bye-laws/Regulations of the Institution awarding the degree and such Ph.D. candidates shall be exempted from the requirement of NET/SLET/SET subject to fulfillment of specific conditions: Ph.D. degree awarded in regular mode, Ph.D. thesis evaluated by at least two external examiners, Open Ph.D. viva voce conducted, Candidate has published two research papers from Ph.D. work (at least one in refereed journal), Candidate has presented at least two papers based on Ph.D work in conferences/seminars sponsored/funded/supported by the UGC/ICSSR/CSIR or any similar agency
  • The fulfillment of these conditions is to be certified by the Registrar or the Dean (Academic Affairs) of the University concerned
  • The Academic score as specified in Appendix II for Universities and Colleges shall be considered for short-listing of the candidates for interview only, and the selections shall be based only on the performance in the interview as per UGC Regulations-2018 and as amended from time to time

Experience

  • Professor: A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate OR ten years experience as an outstanding professional from academic institutions/industry with significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned discipline
  • Associate Professor: A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry
  • Deputy Librarian: Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian with evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library
  • Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian: No specific years of experience required, but must have NET/SLET/SET qualification or Ph.D. degree exemption as per UGC norms

Desirable

  • For Professor positions: Published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120
  • For Associate Professor positions: A minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 75
  • For Deputy Librarian: Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library
  • For Assistant Librarian: A consistently good academic record with knowledge of computerization of a library

Salary/Stipend

  • Professor: Academic level 14 with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,44,200/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.37,400-67,000 with AGP-10,000)
  • Associate Professor/Deputy Librarian: Academic level 13A with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,31,400/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.37,400-67,000 with AGP-9,000)
  • Assistant Professor/Assistant Librarian: Academic level 10 with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 57,700/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.15,600-39,100 with AGP-6,000)
  • All pay scales are as per UGC/NCERT/Government of India norms and will be applicable as amended from time to time
  • Selected candidates will be entitled to other allowances and benefits as per Government of India/NCERT rules applicable from time to time

Age Limit (as on 20/02/2026)

  • Age of retirement on superannuation will be as per the UGC/NCERT, Government of India norms as amended from time to time and in force at the time of closing date of filling-up online application
  • The relaxation in age and percentage of marks to candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS/PWD categories is provided in accordance with the UGC/GOI/NCERT rules
  • Persons with Disability (PWD) having disability less than forty percent will not be considered. The disability certificate shall be from a competent medical board constituted by the central or state Government Hospital
  • Such persons should meet the prescribed criteria of physical disability of the respective category as per the Government of India rules

Application Fee

  • UR/OBC/EWS Candidates: Rs. 1000/- (Rupees One thousand only) through online payment mode only
  • Women applicants and applicants belonging to SC/ST/PWD: Exempted from payment of fee
  • No other mode of payment will be accepted other than online payment mode
  • Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances

Selection Process

  • For Assistant Professor Posts: Up to 50 candidates (category-wise) for the first vacancy and 05 candidates for every additional vacancy will be called for the interview in order of their rank/merit in the list as prepared by the Shortlisting Committee on the basis of marks scored by the candidates, which should not be less than academic score of 60 (Sixty) in any case. In case of tie of marks at the 50th place for 01 vacancy and tie of marks at 5th place for every additional vacancy, all candidates whose marks tie will be called for interview
  • For Professor and Associate Professor Posts: The existing criterion of minimum academic score as per UGC guidelines will be followed subject to the condition up to 10 candidates (category-wise) for the first vacancy and 05 candidates for every additional vacancy will be called for interview in order of their rank/merit in the list as prepared by the Shortlisting Committee on the basis of marks scored by the candidates. In case of tie of marks at the 10th place for 01 vacancy and tie of marks at 5th place for every additional vacancy, all candidates whose marks tie will be called for interview
  • The Academic score shall be considered for short-listing of the candidates for interview only, and the selections shall be based only on the performance in the interview
  • The list of shortlisted candidates will be displayed on the NCERT website
  • The shortlisted candidates will be allowed to appear for the interview only after verification of their eligibility
  • The registration will be provisional as the eligibility of the shortlisted candidate will be verified at the time of Interview from the original documents
  • All Certificates, Degrees and other documents must be produced in original for verification at the time of interview (if shortlisted), failing which the candidate may not be allowed to appear for the interview
  • Final result of the selected candidates will be displayed on NCERT website
  • The Council will not entertain any correspondence with the candidates about their non-selection in the recruitment
  • The decision of the NCERT in all matters relating to selection and allotment of posts/organizations to selected candidates will be final and binding on the candidates

General Information/Instructions

  • National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT) is an apex organization for Educational Research, Teacher Training and Development of Curriculum and Instructional material in school education
  • Positions are available at NCERT, New Delhi and at its constituent units located at Ajmer, Bhopal, Bhubaneswar, Mysuru and Shillong
  • Only Indian Nationals need to apply
  • Eligible and interested candidates are required to apply online only through the NCERT website www.ncert.nic.in at Announcement-Vacancy-Academic. No other means/mode of submission of applications will be accepted
  • The candidates must have a valid email id and mobile number through which he/she will get registered with the online application portal
  • Candidates should fill in the details to register and then fill the information in the online application form at the appropriate places very carefully
  • Fields with STAR (*) mark are mandatory and essential to be filled in by the candidate
  • After the required information have been provided, click submit button. However, before clicking "Submit" button, candidate must make sure that no changes are required and the information provided is correct and final. After application is submitted, no changes will be entertained
  • Candidates are required to upload their scanned recent/colour passport size photograph, applicant's signature and all the relevant documents. The candidates have to keep a copy of application with documents for record and the same to be produced at the time of verification of document/interview, if shortlisted
  • In case a candidate wishes to apply for more than one post, he/she should submit separate application online along with the requisite fee for each post applied for. All the online applications should be completed in all respects. Only one application for individual post from one applicant will be accepted
  • The candidate should meet the eligibility criteria and provide the information which he/she possesses as on the last date of submission of the application. Candidates who do not possess the requisite educational qualification as on the closing date of receipt of application will not be eligible
  • Candidature of a registered candidate is liable to be rejected at any stage of recruitment process or even after joining, if any information provided by the candidate is found to be false or not in conformity with the eligibility criteria
  • Candidate must indicate his/her caste/category in the appropriate column of the application form (SC, ST, UR, OBC (NCL) & EWS etc). Leaving the caste column blank would not automatically be assumed as an application for un-reserved category and the application will be rejected as incomplete
  • The OBC-Non Creamy Layer candidates will be required to submit a valid caste certificate for purpose of reservation in appointment to posts under Government of India/Central Government from a competent authority along with latest Non Creamy Layer certificate and self-declaration that he/she does not belong to the creamy layer as on the closing date of submission of applications
  • The EWS candidates will be required to submit a valid certificate for purpose of reservation in appointment to posts under Government of India/Central Government from a competent authority and self declaration
  • Number of vacancies may vary depending upon the actual requirement. NCERT reserves the right not to fill up any or all the posts or cancel the whole process of recruitment without assigning any reason
  • Mere fulfilling the minimum eligibility requirements does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. NCERT reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates to be called for interview
  • The certificates, which are neither in English nor in Hindi, need to be translated preferably to either in English or in Hindi and the same shall be submitted along with the copy of the certificate in local language
  • The candidate who have received letter grades or grading points instead of marks, should provide conversion chart and percentage equivalent of their respective letter grades, issued by concerned board/university/institution
  • Any subsequent change of address/Telephone No./Email address should be promptly communicated to the Section Officer, Recruitment-1 Section, Room No. 12, 5th Floor, Zakir Hussain Block, NCERT, New Delhi- 110016
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification and the candidature is liable to be summarily rejected
  • In order to avoid last minute rush, the candidates are advised in their own interest to apply well in time
  • All applicants should submit Self Declaration as per prescribed format
  • Applicants serving under Government, Quasi-Government, Public Sector Undertaking and Autonomous Organizations should apply through proper channel and submit at the time of online application the permission letter from their present employer (No Objection Certificate)
  • The shortlisted non-local candidates will be entitled for reimbursement of Train fare restricted up to 3rd AC (except for Special trains like Rajdhani, Shatabadi, etc.) or the actual fare, whichever is less, on submission of tickets
  • Any litigation in the matter will be subject to the Delhi jurisdiction only
  • Candidates in their own interest are advised to remain updated with the selection/recruitment process by visiting the website www.ncert.nic.in regularly for any further instruction/information
  • In case of any query related to Advt. No. 177/2026, e-mail id of the section is [email protected]
  • Hindi version of this advertisement is also being published separately. In case of any discrepancies are found in Hindi version, English version will be followed

Madhya Pradesh Rajya Sahakari Bank Ltd. (MP Apex Bank) has released the official notification for MP Apex Bank Recruitment 2026, inviting online applications for a total of 2,076 Clerk, Computer Operator, Society Manager, and Officer Grade posts across various District Central Cooperative Banks in Madhya Pradesh. Eligible candidates with requisite educational qualifications can apply online from 06 January 2026 to 20 February 2026 through the bank’s official portal, with selection based on an online examination and interview process.

Eligibility Criteria for MP Apex Bank Recruitment 2026

Essential Qualifications:

  • For Computer Operator: Graduation from a government-recognized university with knowledge of Hindi and English typing + Mandatory one-year computer diploma from UGC recognized university, DOEACC diploma level, Modern Office Management Course from Government Polytechnic, or COPA certificate from Government ITI
  • OR B.E. (CSE/IT), MCA, BCA, M.Sc. (IT/CS), B.Sc. (IT/CS), M.Tech., M.E.
  • OR AICTE approved Polytechnic Diploma in Computer Science/Computer Applications/Information Technology

  • For Society Manager: Same as Computer Operator

  • Candidates must possess knowledge of Hindi and English typing

Desirable:

  • Computer knowledge and typing skills in Hindi and English

Experience:

  • For Computer Operator (Sambida): Candidates who have previously worked or are currently working on contract in district banks with prior approval of Registrar and minimum 5 years of work experience in DCCBs (including periods in more than one district bank)

(Computer Science/IT)/ MCA from any recognized university. two years of programming experience in a registered institute/government institute/autonomous organization

UPSC CSE 2026 – Preliminary Examination Pattern

The Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination is the first stage of the UPSC selection process. It is a screening test used to shortlist candidates for the Main Examination. Marks scored in Prelims are not counted in the final merit ranking.

Paper Subject Type Marks Duration
Paper I General Studies (GS) Objective (MCQs) 200 Marks 2 Hours
Paper II CSAT (Aptitude Test) Objective (MCQs) 200 Marks 2 Hours

Prelims Key Rules

  • Both papers are objective type (Multiple Choice Questions).
  • Paper II (CSAT) is qualifying in nature – minimum 33% marks required.
  • Marks of Paper I are considered for cutoff and shortlisting for Mains.
  • Negative marking applies: 1/3rd mark deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Leaving a question blank carries no penalty.

UPSC CSE 2026 – Main Examination Pattern

The Civil Services (Main) Examination is the second stage and consists of a written examination followed by an Interview/Personality Test. Marks obtained in the written papers and interview are counted for the final merit list.

Paper Subject Marks Nature
Paper A Compulsory Indian Language 300 Qualifying
Paper B English 300 Qualifying
Paper I Essay 250 Merit
Paper II General Studies I 250 Merit
Paper III General Studies II 250 Merit
Paper IV General Studies III 250 Merit
Paper V General Studies IV (Ethics) 250 Merit
Paper VI Optional Subject – Paper 1 250 Merit
Paper VII Optional Subject – Paper 2 250 Merit

Main Exam Structure

  • Total Written Papers: 9
  • Qualifying Papers: 2 (Indian Language & English)
  • Merit Papers: 7
  • Total Marks (Written): 1750

Interview / Personality Test

Stage Marks
Personality Test / Interview 275

Final Merit Calculation

  • Written Exam Marks: 1750
  • Interview Marks: 275
  • Total Merit Marks: 2025

Important Notes

  • Prelims marks are used only for qualification, not for final ranking.
  • Mains + Interview marks decide final service allocation.
  • Negative marking applies in Prelims only.
  • Candidates must qualify in both language papers to have their merit papers evaluated.

Interested candidates with the required qualifications, including a valid CPL and a minimum of 500 multi-engine flying hours, can apply online via email by 11th February 2026.

AAI Co-Pilot (P2) 2026 – Important Details

Advertisement

AAI Co-Pilot (P2) 2026 Vacancy Details

The Airports Authority of India, Flight Inspection Unit (FIU) at Safdarjung Airport, New Delhi, invites applications from eligible Indian nationals for the following position on contract basis:

Position No. of Posts Base
Co-Pilot (P2) – Beechcraft B350/B360 02 Flight Inspection Unit, Safdarjung Airport, New Delhi

AAI FIU operates four aircraft (Dornier Do-228, SKA B-350, SKA B-360) equipped with Fully Automatic Flight Inspection System (AFIS) for flight calibration services of CNS facilities such as ILS (up to Cat-III), VOR, DME, NDB, VGSI, RADAR, GBAS/RNAV/RNP/LPV procedures, ADS-B etc.

Eligibility Criteria for AAI Co-Pilot (P2) 2026

1. Educational Qualification & License Requirements

  • 10+2 (with Physics & Mathematics) from a recognized board/university.
  • Current valid CPL issued by DGCA, India with:
    • Minimum of 500 flying hours on multi-engine.
    • Minimum of 1000 total flying hours.
  • Current FRTOL issued by DGCA, India.
  • Current IR Endorsement.
  • Current RTR (A) or RTR (P) or RTR (C) issued by WPC, Ministry of Communication, India.
  • Current Class-1 medical fitness certificate issued by DGCA, India.
  • Valid English Language Proficiency (ELP).
  • Candidates should be in possession of an Indian current passport; if not available, proof of submission of passport application must be attached.

2. Age Limit

  • Maximum age for engagement of Co-Pilot: up to 60 years, as per DGCA India rules (age calculated as on 01/02/2026).
  • Co-Pilot can be re-engaged up to maximum age of 65 years, subject to license currency and fulfillment of DGCA requirements.

3. Other Eligibility Conditions

  • Data provided in the application must be discrete and supported by self-certified documents/certificates.
  • Candidates employed in Government/Semi Government/Public Sector Undertakings must bring a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of interview.

Selection Process for AAI Co-Pilot (P2) 2026

The selection process includes:

  • Scrutiny of applications and supporting documents submitted by email.
  • Shortlisting of eligible candidates based on laid down qualification and experience criteria.
  • Intimation to shortlisted candidates via email regarding personal interview schedule (venue, date and time).
  • Personal interview of shortlisted candidates at the stipulated venue, as intimated by AAI FIU.

The shortlisted candidates will be considered for engagement on fixed term contract basis. Candidature is purely provisional and liable to rejection at any stage if eligibility criteria or document authenticity is not satisfied. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature.

Application Fee for AAI Co-Pilot (P2) 2026

  • The advertisement does not mention any application fee for Co-Pilot (P2) recruitment.

How to Apply for AAI Co-Pilot (P2) Recruitment 2026?

Eligible candidates can apply for AAI Co-Pilot (P2) Beechcraft B350/B360 2026 by following these steps:

  1. Download the application format (Annexure-I) from the AAI website as given in the advertisement.
  2. Fill the application form carefully with all required details including personal information, qualifications, license details, flying hours and experience.
  3. Paste a recent color passport size photograph in the designated space.
  4. Attach colored scanned copies of all supporting documents, including:
    • Proof of date of birth and educational qualifications.
    • Licenses/Endorsements and updated flying logbook.
    • Current Class-1 Medical Fitness Certificate issued by DGCA, India.
    • Current valid ATPL/CPL issued by DGCA, India.
    • Current FRTOL issued by DGCA, India.
    • IR Endorsement.
    • Current RTR (A) or RTR (P) or RTR (C) issued by WPC, Ministry of Communication, India.
    • Valid ELP.
    • Valid Passport, or proof of application if passport not yet issued.
  5. Submit the duly filled application along with colored scanned copies of all supporting documents by email to:
    • [email protected]
    • [email protected]
  6. Ensure that the complete application is submitted on or before 11/02/2026. Incomplete, ambiguous or late applications are liable to be rejected.
  7. For queries, candidates may write to [email protected] or [email protected].

Important Dates for AAI Co-Pilot (P2) 2026

Event Date
Age Calculation Reference Date 01/02/2026 (maximum age as per DGCA rules)
Application End Date 11/02/2026
Interview Date To be intimated by email to shortlisted candidates

Instructions & Terms for AAI Co-Pilot (P2) 2026

  • Contract period is 3 years, extendable for another 2 years (year-on-year basis) subject to satisfactory performance and mutual consent.
  • Annual increment of 5% may be allowed on the negotiable monthly package.
  • During training period, stipend of Rs. 50,000 per month will be paid; full remuneration starts from commencement of supervisor line flying (SLF).
  • Aviation Personal Accident (PA) / Loss of License (LOL) insurance premium will be borne by AAI as per guidelines, with current cover of Rs. 50 lakhs each.
  • Co-Pilot must make himself/herself available for license and medical renewals, IR/PPC and simulator checks as scheduled; failure makes the pilot ineligible to draw contracted amount on pro rata basis until currency is restored.
  • AAI will arrange hotel accommodation and transportation at outstations during calibration duties as per entitlement of Joint General Manager, AAI; accommodation at base station (Delhi) is to be arranged by the Co-Pilot.
  • Co-Pilot will be eligible for 12 days casual leave and 18 days sick leave in a calendar year; un-availed leave cannot be carried forward or encashed and excess leave attracts pro rata deduction.
  • No Gratuity, CPF or medical facility will be provided by AAI to Co-Pilot or dependents.
  • Contract can be terminated by either side by giving 6 months’ notice; AAI can also terminate if Co-Pilot remains absent continuously for more than 15 days beyond entitled leave.
  • During contract, Co-Pilot must make himself/herself available for AAI calibration duties and related jobs and cannot engage elsewhere without approval of Executive Director (FIU) for license currency or additional flying hours.

Salary/Stipend & Training for AAI Co-Pilot (P2) 2026

  • Monthly Package: Negotiable, starting from Rs. 2.50 lakhs per month, including assured flying allowance of 50 hours; overtime flying allowance for hours beyond 50 per month as per guidelines.
  • Annual Increment: 5% on negotiable monthly package, subject to AAI policy.
  • Training & Bonds (Initial Currency / Non-rated Pilots):
    • Initial currency training on type and associated expenditure arranged by AAI, subject to execution of a 3-year bond; costs recovered on reducing basis @ Rs. 1 lakh per month.
    • Non-rated co-pilots on type, if selected, will undergo DGCA-approved training arranged by AAI against suitable bank security and must execute a 3-year bond. If training is not successfully completed, repeat training at own cost is required; otherwise AAI recovers expenses from bank security.
    • Training & associated TA/DA expenses recovered @ Rs. 1.5 lakhs per month after attaining initial currency.
    • For IR/PPC simulator training, co-pilot must execute a bond to serve AAI for minimum 1 year from completion of simulator training; fees/charges paid by AAI against bank guarantee/postdated cheque.
    • Stipend during training: Rs. 50,000 per month; full remuneration from start of SLF.
  • Sustenance Allowance: 50% of monthly hiring charges will be paid during suspension period on pro rata basis; in case of adverse outcome, this allowance must be returned by the co-pilot.

  • On successful completion of the transaction, e-receipt and application form will be generated, which may be printed for record.
  • Before applying online, candidates will be required to have a scanned (digital) image of their photograph, signature, left thumb impression, handwritten declaration, and all relevant documents (ID Proof, Date of Birth Proof, Job Profile, Resume, Educational Certificates, Experience Certificate, Form-16, Salary Slip) as per specifications.
  • Candidates should download their call letter (for Online Exam & Interview) by entering their registration number and password/date of birth from the Bank's website. No hard copy of the call letter will be sent by post.
  • Candidates who are called for online exam/interview will be required to bring one photo identity proof such as Passport/Aadhaar/PAN Card/Driving License/Voter's Id Card/Bank Passbook with duly attested Photograph in original as well as a self-attested photocopy thereof.

SAI Performance Analyst 2026 Vacancy Details

The total number of vacancies for SAI Performance Analyst Recruitment 2026 is 48 posts, distributed discipline-wise as follows:

  • Anthropometry: 1 post (UR: 1)
  • Biomechanics: 1 post (UR: 1)
  • Nutrition: 4 posts (UR: 3, OBC: 1)

Note: Initial place of posting or any subsequent posting does not confer any right against transfer; SAI reserves the final decision on postings.

Eligibility Criteria for SAI Performance Analyst 2026

1. Educational Qualification

  • Performance Analyst (Physiotherapy): Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Physiotherapy from any recognized University/Institution; desirable 1 year experience in Sports Physiotherapy.
  • Performance Analyst (Physiology): Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Medical Physiology / Human Physiology / Sports and Exercise Physiology / Biological Sciences; with specified equivalence for B.Sc. (CBZ) and Physiology; desirable 1 year experience in Sports Physiology.
  • Performance Analyst (Anthropometry): Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Anthropology or Human Biology; desirable 1 year experience in Anthropometry in sports science.
  • Performance Analyst (Psychology): Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Psychology / Clinical Psychology / Applied Psychology / Sports Psychology; desirable 1 year experience in Sports Psychology.
  • Performance Analyst (Strength & Conditioning): Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Strength and Conditioning / Sports and Exercise Science / Sports Science; OR Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Sports Coaching / Physical Education / Performance Coaching with specified Strength & Conditioning certifications (ACSM, NSCA-CSCS, ASCA, UKSCA, NCCA USCCA, NSNIS PG Diploma, NSDC Level 4/6/7, government-recognized gym/fitness certifications, EXOS with ACSM credits); desirable 1 year experience in Strength & Conditioning.
  • Performance Analyst (Nutrition): Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Nutrition & Dietetics / Food Science & Nutrition / Sports Nutrition / Nutrition / Food & Nutrition / Food Nutrition & Dietetics / Clinical Nutrition & Dietetics / Home Science with specified Nutrition specializations; desirable 1 year experience in Sports Nutrition.
  • Performance Analyst (Biomechanics): Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Biomechanics / Sports Biomechanics / Sports Biomechanics & Kinesiology / Kinesiology (with Biomechanics) / Exercise & Sports Sciences (with Biomechanics) / Human Movement Sciences / Sports Sciences (with Biomechanics) / Biophysics / Physiotherapy (MPT Sports Biomechanics) with Biomechanics as major subject; with specified equivalent Bachelor’s degrees; desirable 1 year experience in Biomechanics.

2. Age Limit

  • Maximum Age: Up to 30 years as on the opening date for submission of online application forms.
  • SC/ST: Relaxation up to 5 years.
  • OBC (Non-Creamy Layer): Relaxation up to 3 years.
  • Ex-servicemen: Relaxation as per Ex-servicemen (Re-employment in Civil Services and Posts) Rules, 1979.
  • Departmental/SAI contractual employees: Relaxation as per detailed SAI guidelines, including service-based cumulative relaxation.
  • Date of Birth Proof: As recorded in Matriculation/Secondary or equivalent certificates; no other documents accepted for age proof.

3. Nationality

Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply for SAI Performance Analyst posts.

Selection Process for SAI Performance Analyst 2026

The selection process will be based on a Computer-Based Test (CBT) with the following structure:

  • Mode: Computer-Based Test (CBT) in fully proctored environment with biometric authentication.
  • Duration: 2 hours.
  • Total Questions: 100 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs).
  • Negative Marking: 1/4 of the marks assigned to a question for each incorrect answer.

Sections of CBT:

  • Section A (Common for all disciplines):
    • Basic Sports Science Knowledge (Section A1) – 32 marks.
    • General Sports Awareness (Section A2) – 8 marks.
    • Total: 40 marks.
  • Section B (Discipline-specific): Applied Sports Science Knowledge – 40 marks.
  • Section C (Discipline-specific): Sports-related Case Studies (passage/analytical) – 20 marks.

Final Merit List: Prepared solely on total CBT marks (out of 100). No additional weightage or supplementary evaluation is applied. Tie-breaking will follow sequential criteria based on marks in Sections C, B, A, A1, A2, then age (older candidate) and alphabetical order of name.

Application Fee for SAI Performance Analyst 2026

  • UR/EWS/OBC: Rs. 2000/- (including bank charges and service tax).
  • SC/ST/Ex-servicemen/Women: Rs. 1500/- (including bank charges and service tax).
  • Payment Mode: Online only via NEFT/RTGS/Net Banking/UPI etc., as per fee structure.
  • Refund Policy: Application fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.

How to Apply for SAI Performance Analyst Recruitment 2026?

Eligible candidates can apply online for SAI Performance Analyst 2026 by following these steps:

  1. Visit the SAI official website: https://sportsauthorityofindia.nic.in/
  2. Open the online application format available through the specified link.
  3. Ensure you have a valid email ID which remains active till completion of the recruitment process.
  4. Keep scanned copies ready:
    • Recent passport-size colour photograph (JPG/JPEG, max 80 KB).
    • Signature (JPG/JPEG, max 30 KB).
  5. Fill in all details in the online application form carefully.
  6. Upload mandatory documents:
    • Proof of age certificate.
    • Valid Government of India ID proof.
    • Certificates in support of essential educational qualifications.
    • Caste/Category certificates (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/Ex-servicemen etc.) in prescribed format, if applicable.
    • Certificate showing contractual period with SAI (for relaxation), issued by competent authority, if applicable.
  7. Pay the application fee online using NEFT/RTGS/Net Banking/UPI as per category.
  8. Submit the online application form on or before 09.03.2026 (5 P.M.).
  9. Download and safely preserve the registration slip generated by the system containing the unique registration number and password for future reference.

Job Scope & Responsibilities

Data Analyst (Statistics) will perform the following tasks:

  • Data Preparation & Compilation: Prepare, compile, and analyze different types of data and statistics related to tariff determination
  • Air Traffic Statistics: Preparation of monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, yearly air traffic statistics including:
    • Passenger statistics
    • Aircraft movements (ATM)
    • Cargo data
  • Charges Compilation: Compilation of landing, housing, parking charges and User Development Fees (by Year/Airport/Control Period) approved by AERA
  • Capital Expenditure Analysis: Prepare capital expenditure details and reports
  • Statistical Analysis: Conduct statistics analysis and compile various reports from RBI and other agencies for inflation forecasting and other data requirements
  • Debt Funding Analysis: Compile and analyze debt funding patterns from various agencies
  • Data Validation: Take appropriate data validation and error detection initiatives
  • Report Preparation: Prepare reports, data compilations, and summaries
  • Data Presentation: Prepare various data/statistics in suitable presentation and analysis formats
  • Template Review: Periodic review and modification of report formats/templates for improved utility
  • Additional Tasks: Any other work as per AERA requirement

  • Tenure: Initial period of 2 years subject to satisfactory performance review after first year

  • Legal Status: Independent consultant, NOT a staff member or official of AERA
  • Full-Time Requirement: Will not be permitted to take up any other assignment during engagement with AERA
  • No Claim for Regular Employment: Work and days on contract duty do not create any representation or claim for any form of employment

Termination Provisions:

  • By AERA: Can be terminated after 2 months' notice or proportionate payment in lieu of notice
  • By Candidate: Must give 2 months' advance notice or remuneration in lieu
  • Immediate Termination by AERA: AERA reserves right to terminate immediately without notice based on performance or breach of contract terms
  • Public Interest Termination: AERA may terminate without notice if candidate unable to perform satisfactorily
  • Automatic Termination: At end of tenure if not extended
  • No Work Certificate: If terminated before 1 year or candidate resigns before 1 year, no work certificate will be issued

Confidentiality & IPR:

  • Intellectual Property Rights: All IPR of data collected and deliverables produced remain with AERA
  • Confidentiality: Cannot utilize, publish, or share data/statistics/information with third parties without written consent from AERA
  • Document Handover: Must hand over all records to reporting officer before contract expiry and final payment
  • Restricted Use of Name/Emblem: Cannot use AERA name, emblem, or official seal for commercial advantage without permission

Health & Medical Requirements

  • Candidate should be in good health for discharging official duties effectively
  • No Insurance/Compensation: Dependents not entitled to any compensation or claim in case of death, injury, or illness, regardless of cause

How to Apply

  • Application Format: Use prescribed application format (as per Annex-II of advertisement)
  • Required Documents: Attach copies of educational qualifications, experience certificates, and skills documentation
  • Application Mode: Email, Post, or Courier only - NO hand delivery
  • Last Date: Applications must reach by 18-02-2026 at 5:30 PM
  • Late Applications: Any application received after deadline or incomplete/wrong format will be rejected
  • Fresh Application: Applicants who had applied earlier must send fresh application; previous applications will not be considered

Selection Process

  • Final Decision: Competent Authority's decision is final

Selection Process

  • The recruitment methodology is structured into a two-stage process: a Computer based online written test, called Computer Based Test (CBT) and a Coaching Ability Test (CAT).
  • The final composite weightage in the recruitment methodology shall be 60% for the Coaching Ability Test and 40% for the Computer based online written test.
  • The candidates who fulfil the eligibility criteria shall be called for an online written examination called the Computer Based Test (CBT).
  • The candidates appearing in the written examination i.e CBT shall be shortlisted for the Coaching Ability Test (CAT) in the ratio of 1:3 i.e. the number of candidates to be shortlisted for the coaching ability test will be 3 times the number of vacancies in each sport and in each category.
  • The selection will be made on the basis of merit list prepared by the Selection Committee based on the written Computer Based Test (CBT) and Coaching Ability Test (CAT).
  • Written Examination (CBT): The Computer Based Test (CBT) is designed to assess the candidate’s sports-specific knowledge, understanding of sports sciences and familiarity with general awareness, reasoning and aptitude, which are essential competencies for the post of Assistant Coach.
  • The written test (CBT) shall be for two (02) hours with a total of 100 multiple choice questions (MCQs). There shall be negative marking of one-fourth of the marks assigned to a question for each incorrect answer.
  • The written test shall include the following broad topics: Sports-specific knowledge 65 marks, Sports Science 25 marks, General Awareness, Reasoning, Aptitude 10 marks.
  • Coaching Ability Test: The Coaching Ability Test shall have 60 % weightage in the final merit list. The Coaching Ability Test is designed to measure a candidate’s capacity to apply foundational coaching knowledge in a way that builds a positive, effective, and transformative coaching relationship.
  • The candidates appearing in the Computer Based Test (CBT) will be shortlisted for the coaching ability test in the ratio of 1:3 i.e. the number of candidates to be shortlisted for the coaching ability test should be 3 times the number of vacancies in each sport and in each category.
  • The Coaching Ability Test shall have 40 assessment parameters.
  • Candidates must secure the minimum qualifying marks/standards, if any, as prescribed by SAI in the Coaching Ability Test. Failure to do so shall result in disqualification, irrespective of performance in the CBT.

General Information/Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals can apply for the above posts.
  • The online test will be held at the Delhi, Lucknow, Chandigarh, Bhopal, Gandhinagar, Mumbai, Kolkata, Bhubaneswar, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Thiruvananthapuram, Guwahati and Imphal. The number of centres can be reduced or increased, depending upon the number of candidates.
  • Candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC will have to produce the original caste certificate from the competent authority, along with attested copy of the same, at the time of physical verification of documents failing which his candidature shall be cancelled and he will not be admitted for further selection process.
  • OBC Candidates availing reservation will have to produce latest OBC CERTIFICATE with “NON-CREAMY LAYER STATUS” in the prescribed format by the Government of India for Government services at the time of physical verification of the documents.
  • A candidate will be eligible to get the benefit of community reservation only in case the particular caste to which the candidate belongs is included in the list of reserved communities issued by the Central Government.
  • A candidate will be eligible to get the benefit of the Economically Weaker Section reservation only in case the candidate meets the criteria issued by the Central Government and is in possession of the certificate issued anytime during this Financial Year of recruitment shall be treated as valid, but not later than the closing date of the Online Application Form for this recruitment.
  • Candidates seeking reservation/relaxation benefits available for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/Ex-servicemen must ensure that they are entitled to such reservation/relaxation as per eligibility. They should also be in possession of all the requisite certificates in the prescribed format in support of their claim for such benefits by the closing date of the online application.
  • Only those candidates who are fulfilling the eligibility criteria will be allowed to appear in the online test. The candidates shall appear for the Computer Based Test (CBT)/Coaching Ability Test for the above posts at their own expenses.
  • The qualification must be obtained from Govt. Recognized institutions/Universities.
  • Canvassing in any manner and bringing outside influence shall make the candidature liable for rejection.
  • The authority reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates to be called for test and change of exam centre on the basis of any other norms decided by the Authority at a later date.
  • The decision of the selection committee is not liable for challenge and same shall stand final and binding on each candidate.
  • Before applying for the post, the candidate should ensure that he fulfills the eligibility and other norms mentioned in the Advertisement. Furnishing of wrong/false information shall result in disqualification and SAI will not be responsible for any consequence of furnishing of such wrong/false information.
  • The eligibility of new applicants with respect to age, experience etc. will be determined as on the date of advertisement. For Educational qualification, candidates whose result for final year examination is awaited are also allowed to appear in the written examination subject to the condition that they will have to produce the final results before appearing in the further selection process.
  • Candidates employed in Govt. Departments/PSUs/Autonomous bodies must produce No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of verification of documents from their employer. In case, the candidate fails to produce the NOC, his candidature will not be considered.
  • Mere fulfilling of the minimum qualifications and experience will not vest any right on candidates for being called for online exam. No interim correspondence will be entertained.
  • Selected candidates are liable to be posted anywhere in India.
  • Candidature is liable to be cancelled at any stage of recruitment process or after recruitment or joining if any information provided by the candidates is found false or is not found in conformity with eligibility criteria mentioned in the advertisement.
  • Decision of SAI in all matters regarding eligibility of the candidate, the stages at which such scrutiny of eligibility is to be undertaken, the documents is to be produced for the purpose of the conduct of selection and any other matter relating to recruitment will be final and binding on the candidate. SAI reserves the right to fix the standard and specifications for screening and calling the number of candidates for online exam and/or CAT, etc.
  • SAI reserves the right to modify, alter, restrict, enlarge, cancel, or discontinue the recruitment process, without assigning any reason or issuing further notice. No appeal shall lie against such decision.
  • Appointment shall be subject to the candidate being found medically fit as per the standards prescribed by SAI.
  • Inclusion of a candidate’s name in the merit list does not confer any right to appointment unless a formal offer of appointment is issued by SAI.
  • Candidates from Government organisations applying for the post are required to intimate their parent department/office immediately upon submission of the online application, in accordance with the consolidated instructions issued by the Department of Personnel & Training (DoPT).
  • Further notifications/corrigendum in this regard, if any, shall be published on SAI website only. You are advised to visit the SAI website regularly for further updates.
  • All communications, including call letters, examination intimation and selection-related information, shall be made through the registered e-mail ID and/or SAI website only. SAI shall not be responsible for non-receipt of information due to incorrect or inactive e-mail ID.
  • In case of any ambiguity or dispute regarding interpretation of any provision of this notification, the decision of SAI shall be final and binding.
  • Any dispute arising out of or relating to this recruitment shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of courts at Delhi.
  • In case of any dispute, English version of the Employment notice shall prevail and be treated as final.

How to Apply

  • Eligible applicants/candidate are required to apply through ‘online application Format’ to be available on SAI’s website on www.sportsauthorityofindia.nic.in. No application through other mode will be accepted. Candidates are not required to send any hard copy or supporting documents to SAI at the application stage.
  • Before registering/submitting applications on the website the candidates should possess the following: a) Valid E-mail ID: The e-mail ID entered in the online application form should remain active until the recruitment process is completed. No request for change in the e-mail ID shall be entertained once it has been registered. b) While applying online candidate should keep the scanned copy of their passport size color photograph and their signature in digital format for uploading with the online application. The files must be in jpg or jpeg file/format only, with photograph not exceeding 80kb and signature not exceeding 30kb .
  • The candidate can access the online application form at our website. The registration would be open from 1st February, 2026 to 15th February, 2026.
  • After applying online, candidate is required to download the registration slip generated by the System with unique registration number and password, which may be retained for future reference.
  • Following documents are compulsory to be uploaded with the application:- (a) Certificate for the proof of age (b) Any valid ID proof issued by the Government of India (c) Certificates to support the essential qualification (d) Certificates of SC/ST/OBC/Ex-serviceman/EWS/meritorious sports person, etc. issued by Competent Authority for availing relaxation. (e) Certificates showing the period of contract with SAI issued by the Competent Authority.

  • GSEC (GIAC Security Essentials Certification)
  • OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional)
  • CISM (Certified Information Security Manager)

Experience (Essential)

  • Minimum 5 years of relevant cyber security experience in reputed companies/organizations.

Preference

  • Candidates with specialization in Cyber Security at Post Graduate level (M.Tech / MBA) will be given preference.
  • Multiple certifications from the above list will be considered an added advantage.

SPMCIL Young Professional Age Limit

  • Maximum age: 35 years as on 07-02-2026.
  • Candidates born on or after 07-02-1991 are eligible.
  • Age relaxation applicable as per Government of India guidelines for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD categories.

SPMCIL Young Professional Salary & Benefits

Monthly Remuneration Rs. 50,000/- (all inclusive)
Annual Increment 8% annual increase in remuneration
Leave Entitlement 1 day paid leave for every 20 days of work
Mediclaim Reimbursement Up to Rs. 2,00,000/- premium reimbursement for group mediclaim policy (self, spouse, dependent children) for engagement exceeding 6 months
TA/DA for Official Duty As per E-1 level officer standards for out-station deputation (no TA/DA for joining/completion)
Other Benefits No DA, accommodation, telephone, conveyance, transport, personal staff, or other medical reimbursement.

Service Conditions

  • Leave can be availed only after it becomes due and with approval of the controlling officer.
  • No TA/DA for joining or completion of assignment; admissible only for official duty tours.
  • Mediclaim premium reimbursement up to Rs. 2 lakh for self, spouse and dependent children for engagements longer than 6 months.
  • No other allowances or benefits apart from what is mentioned in the notification.

Key Responsibilities & Duties

A. Security Architecture and Design

  • Develop and maintain robust cyber security architecture aligned with NIST, ISO 27001 and other industry best practices.
  • Design and implement secure solutions for network segmentation, threat detection and incident response across IT and OT environments.
  • Collaborate with IT and OT teams to integrate cyber security controls into existing and upcoming systems.
  • Stay updated on emerging threats, vulnerabilities and technologies and recommend necessary infrastructure enhancements.

B. Vulnerability Management

  • Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and penetration testing of IT and OT systems and networks.
  • Develop and monitor remediation plans for identified vulnerabilities.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and vendors for timely patching and system updates.

C. Threat Detection and Incident Response

  • Implement and continuously monitor security tools (IDS/IPS, SIEM) to detect anomalies and potential threats.
  • Lead cyber security incident response activities ensuring prompt containment, mitigation and post-incident analysis.
  • Develop and maintain incident response playbooks and conduct forensic investigations when required.

D. Risk Management and Compliance

  • Perform cyber risk assessments to identify threats and evaluate operational impact.
  • Ensure adherence to national/international standards, guidelines and data protection laws including CERT-In guidelines.
  • Develop, update and enforce cyber security policies, procedures and standards.
  • Lead internal audits and report findings to senior management.

E. Awareness and Training

  • Design and deliver cyber security awareness programs for staff, contractors and third-party vendors.
  • Create security campaigns and materials to promote a security-aware culture across the organization.

F. Collaboration and Reporting

  • Coordinate with IT, OT and functional departments to ensure a secure operational environment.
  • Prepare and present risk posture reports, threat intelligence and mitigation strategies to senior management.

Required Skill Set

  • Strong knowledge of cyber security concepts, principles and frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls).
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • Firewalls, IDS/IPS, Endpoint Protection Platforms
    • SIEM tools (e.g. Forti SIEM, Splunk)
    • Vulnerability scanners (e.g. Nessus, Qualys)
    • Incident response and digital forensics tools
  • Proficiency in risk assessment methodologies and compliance frameworks.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical and incident handling capabilities.
  • Excellent communication skills to convey complex technical details to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of IT and OT environment security.
  • Understanding of CERT-In guidelines and national cyber security frameworks.

Important General Conditions

  • Engagement is purely on fixed-term contract (temporary basis) and does not confer any right to permanent employment.
  • Appointment is on full-time basis; candidates are not permitted to take up any other assignment during the contract period.
  • SPMCIL reserves the right to terminate the contract at any time without assigning any reason.
  • Completion of tenure will not give any claim for future regular appointment in SPMCIL.
  • Tenure is 3 years, extendable based on performance or liable to be terminated earlier.
  • If engagement falls during election period, it will be regulated as per Election Commission of India guidelines.

SPMCIL Young Professional Selection Process

  • Scrutiny of applications for eligibility based on educational qualification, experience and professional certifications.
  • Merit-based shortlisting as per qualification and experience profile.
  • Screening process may consist of written test followed by interview or only interview as decided by the Management.
  • Document verification of all original certificates at the time of screening/interview.
  • Final selection based on interview performance and overall suitability for the role.

How to Apply for SPMCIL Young Professional Recruitment 2026

Application Mode: Online only through SPMCIL website.

Application Period: 07-02-2026 (10:00 AM) to 06-03-2026 (5:00 PM)

Steps to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website: www.spmcil.com.
  2. Click on the “Career” link available on the home page.
  3. Click on the “ONLINE APPLICATION” button for Young Professional – Cyber Security Expert.
  4. Fill in all required details in the online application form carefully.
  5. Upload all required documents (educational certificates, experience certificates, professional certifications, photograph, signature, etc.).
  6. Submit the application form and wait for server confirmation (do not press back or refresh after submission).
  7. Take a printout of the submitted application form for future reference.

Offline/any other mode of application will not be accepted. Candidates are advised to regularly visit the official website for updates on screening, interview schedule and selection list.

Documents Required

  • Proof of 60% marks or equivalent CGPA (conversion to percentage if only CGPA/grades are awarded).
  • Professional certification(s) – CEH/CCSP/CISSP/CompTIA CySA+/GSEC/OSCP/CISM (scanned copies).
  • Experience certificates from all previous and current employers proving minimum 5 years cyber security experience.
  • Updated detailed resume/CV highlighting cyber security expertise and achievements.
  • 10th/12th certificate as proof of date of birth.
  • Valid photo ID proof (Aadhar/PAN/Voter ID/Passport/Driving License).
  • Caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC) or PwBD certificate, if applicable, in prescribed format.
