    • Option A: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time as the case may be exempted from NET/SLET/SET
    • Option B: The Ph.D degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking among top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of the following: (i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) (ii) the Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai)
  • Deputy Librarian: A Master's Degree in library science/information science/documentation science, with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever grading system is followed. Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian. Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library. A Ph.D. Degree in library science/Information science/Documentation Science/Archives and manuscript keeping/computerization of library
  • Assistant Librarian: A Master's Degree in Library Science, Information Science or Documentation Science or an equivalent professional degree, with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A consistently good academic record, with knowledge of computerization of a library. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time

Essential Qualifications

  • Educational qualification, experience, age of retirement on superannuation and pay scales of Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Deputy Librarian and Assistant Librarian will be as per the UGC/NCERT, Government of India norms as amended from time to time and in force at the time of closing date of filling-up online application
  • For Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian positions, NET/SLET/SET shall not be required for such Masters Programmes in disciplines for which NET/SLET/SET is not conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC
  • Candidates registered for the Ph.D. programme prior to July 11, 2009, shall be governed by the provisions of the then existing Ordinances/Bye-laws/Regulations of the Institution awarding the degree and such Ph.D. candidates shall be exempted from the requirement of NET/SLET/SET subject to fulfillment of specific conditions: Ph.D. degree awarded in regular mode, Ph.D. thesis evaluated by at least two external examiners, Open Ph.D. viva voce conducted, Candidate has published two research papers from Ph.D. work (at least one in refereed journal), Candidate has presented at least two papers based on Ph.D work in conferences/seminars sponsored/funded/supported by the UGC/ICSSR/CSIR or any similar agency
  • The fulfillment of these conditions is to be certified by the Registrar or the Dean (Academic Affairs) of the University concerned
  • The Academic score as specified in Appendix II for Universities and Colleges shall be considered for short-listing of the candidates for interview only, and the selections shall be based only on the performance in the interview as per UGC Regulations-2018 and as amended from time to time

Experience

  • Professor: A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate OR ten years experience as an outstanding professional from academic institutions/industry with significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned discipline
  • Associate Professor: A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry
  • Deputy Librarian: Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian with evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library
  • Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian: No specific years of experience required, but must have NET/SLET/SET qualification or Ph.D. degree exemption as per UGC norms

Desirable

  • For Professor positions: Published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120
  • For Associate Professor positions: A minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 75
  • For Deputy Librarian: Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library
  • For Assistant Librarian: A consistently good academic record with knowledge of computerization of a library

Salary/Stipend

  • Professor: Academic level 14 with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,44,200/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.37,400-67,000 with AGP-10,000)
  • Associate Professor/Deputy Librarian: Academic level 13A with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,31,400/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.37,400-67,000 with AGP-9,000)
  • Assistant Professor/Assistant Librarian: Academic level 10 with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 57,700/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.15,600-39,100 with AGP-6,000)
  • All pay scales are as per UGC/NCERT/Government of India norms and will be applicable as amended from time to time
  • Selected candidates will be entitled to other allowances and benefits as per Government of India/NCERT rules applicable from time to time

Age Limit (as on 20/02/2026)

  • Age of retirement on superannuation will be as per the UGC/NCERT, Government of India norms as amended from time to time and in force at the time of closing date of filling-up online application
  • The relaxation in age and percentage of marks to candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS/PWD categories is provided in accordance with the UGC/GOI/NCERT rules
  • Persons with Disability (PWD) having disability less than forty percent will not be considered. The disability certificate shall be from a competent medical board constituted by the central or state Government Hospital
  • Such persons should meet the prescribed criteria of physical disability of the respective category as per the Government of India rules

Application Fee

  • UR/OBC/EWS Candidates: Rs. 1000/- (Rupees One thousand only) through online payment mode only
  • Women applicants and applicants belonging to SC/ST/PWD: Exempted from payment of fee
  • No other mode of payment will be accepted other than online payment mode
  • Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances

Important Dates

Event Date & Time
Advertisement Number 177/2026
Commencement of Online Registration on NCERT website 31/01/2026 (10:00 AM)
Last Date of Online Registration and apply online 20/02/2026 (Up to 05:00 PM)
Closing date for eligibility criteria 20/02/2026

Selection Process

  • For Assistant Professor Posts: Up to 50 candidates (category-wise) for the first vacancy and 05 candidates for every additional vacancy will be called for the interview in order of their rank/merit in the list as prepared by the Shortlisting Committee on the basis of marks scored by the candidates, which should not be less than academic score of 60 (Sixty) in any case. In case of tie of marks at the 50th place for 01 vacancy and tie of marks at 5th place for every additional vacancy, all candidates whose marks tie will be called for interview
  • For Professor and Associate Professor Posts: The existing criterion of minimum academic score as per UGC guidelines will be followed subject to the condition up to 10 candidates (category-wise) for the first vacancy and 05 candidates for every additional vacancy will be called for interview in order of their rank/merit in the list as prepared by the Shortlisting Committee on the basis of marks scored by the candidates. In case of tie of marks at the 10th place for 01 vacancy and tie of marks at 5th place for every additional vacancy, all candidates whose marks tie will be called for interview
  • The Academic score shall be considered for short-listing of the candidates for interview only, and the selections shall be based only on the performance in the interview
  • The list of shortlisted candidates will be displayed on the NCERT website
  • The shortlisted candidates will be allowed to appear for the interview only after verification of their eligibility
  • The registration will be provisional as the eligibility of the shortlisted candidate will be verified at the time of Interview from the original documents
  • All Certificates, Degrees and other documents must be produced in original for verification at the time of interview (if shortlisted), failing which the candidate may not be allowed to appear for the interview
  • Final result of the selected candidates will be displayed on NCERT website
  • The Council will not entertain any correspondence with the candidates about their non-selection in the recruitment
  • The decision of the NCERT in all matters relating to selection and allotment of posts/organizations to selected candidates will be final and binding on the candidates

General Information/Instructions

  • National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT) is an apex organization for Educational Research, Teacher Training and Development of Curriculum and Instructional material in school education
  • Positions are available at NCERT, New Delhi and at its constituent units located at Ajmer, Bhopal, Bhubaneswar, Mysuru and Shillong
  • Only Indian Nationals need to apply
  • Eligible and interested candidates are required to apply online only through the NCERT website www.ncert.nic.in at Announcement-Vacancy-Academic. No other means/mode of submission of applications will be accepted
  • The candidates must have a valid email id and mobile number through which he/she will get registered with the online application portal
  • Candidates should fill in the details to register and then fill the information in the online application form at the appropriate places very carefully
  • Fields with STAR (*) mark are mandatory and essential to be filled in by the candidate
  • After the required information have been provided, click submit button. However, before clicking "Submit" button, candidate must make sure that no changes are required and the information provided is correct and final. After application is submitted, no changes will be entertained
  • Candidates are required to upload their scanned recent/colour passport size photograph, applicant's signature and all the relevant documents. The candidates have to keep a copy of application with documents for record and the same to be produced at the time of verification of document/interview, if shortlisted
  • In case a candidate wishes to apply for more than one post, he/she should submit separate application online along with the requisite fee for each post applied for. All the online applications should be completed in all respects. Only one application for individual post from one applicant will be accepted
  • The candidate should meet the eligibility criteria and provide the information which he/she possesses as on the last date of submission of the application. Candidates who do not possess the requisite educational qualification as on the closing date of receipt of application will not be eligible
  • Candidature of a registered candidate is liable to be rejected at any stage of recruitment process or even after joining, if any information provided by the candidate is found to be false or not in conformity with the eligibility criteria
  • Candidate must indicate his/her caste/category in the appropriate column of the application form (SC, ST, UR, OBC (NCL) & EWS etc). Leaving the caste column blank would not automatically be assumed as an application for un-reserved category and the application will be rejected as incomplete
  • The OBC-Non Creamy Layer candidates will be required to submit a valid caste certificate for purpose of reservation in appointment to posts under Government of India/Central Government from a competent authority along with latest Non Creamy Layer certificate and self-declaration that he/she does not belong to the creamy layer as on the closing date of submission of applications
  • The EWS candidates will be required to submit a valid certificate for purpose of reservation in appointment to posts under Government of India/Central Government from a competent authority and self declaration
  • Number of vacancies may vary depending upon the actual requirement. NCERT reserves the right not to fill up any or all the posts or cancel the whole process of recruitment without assigning any reason
  • Mere fulfilling the minimum eligibility requirements does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. NCERT reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates to be called for interview
  • The certificates, which are neither in English nor in Hindi, need to be translated preferably to either in English or in Hindi and the same shall be submitted along with the copy of the certificate in local language
  • The candidate who have received letter grades or grading points instead of marks, should provide conversion chart and percentage equivalent of their respective letter grades, issued by concerned board/university/institution
  • Any subsequent change of address/Telephone No./Email address should be promptly communicated to the Section Officer, Recruitment-1 Section, Room No. 12, 5th Floor, Zakir Hussain Block, NCERT, New Delhi- 110016
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification and the candidature is liable to be summarily rejected
  • In order to avoid last minute rush, the candidates are advised in their own interest to apply well in time
  • All applicants should submit Self Declaration as per prescribed format
  • Applicants serving under Government, Quasi-Government, Public Sector Undertaking and Autonomous Organizations should apply through proper channel and submit at the time of online application the permission letter from their present employer (No Objection Certificate)
  • The shortlisted non-local candidates will be entitled for reimbursement of Train fare restricted up to 3rd AC (except for Special trains like Rajdhani, Shatabadi, etc.) or the actual fare, whichever is less, on submission of tickets
  • Any litigation in the matter will be subject to the Delhi jurisdiction only
  • Candidates in their own interest are advised to remain updated with the selection/recruitment process by visiting the website www.ncert.nic.in regularly for any further instruction/information
  • In case of any query related to Advt. No. 177/2026, e-mail id of the section is [email protected]
  • Hindi version of this advertisement is also being published separately. In case of any discrepancies are found in Hindi version, English version will be followed

How to Apply

  • Eligible and interested candidates are required to apply online only through the NCERT website www.ncert.nic.in at Announcement-Vacancy-Academic

RRB Group D Recruitment 2025 (CEN 09/2025) – Apply Online for 22,195 Posts

Advertisement

Railway Recruitment Board (RRB)  has released an official notification for the recruitment of 22195 Group D Posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply Online through the official RRB website. The last date to submit the application form is 02-03-2026. In this article, you’ll find the RRB Group D Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Online application form.

Trending Govt Jobs
  • India Post GDS Online Form 2026
  • UPSC CSE Online Form 2026
  • RRB 22000 Group D Online form 2026
  • Yantra India YIL 3979 Trade Apprentices Online Form 2026
  • SBI 2273 CBO Recruitment 2026

RRB Group D Recruitment CEN 09/2025 Overview

Organization Name Railway Recruitment Board (RRB), Ministry of Railways, Government of India
Post Name Various Posts in Level 1 of 7th CPC Pay Matrix (14 different posts across various departments)
Total Vacancies 22,195  Posts (across 16 Railway Zones)
Qualification 10th Pass or ITI or Equivalent or National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) from NCVT
Age Limit 18 to 33 years (as on 01.01.2026)
Application Fee General/EWS/OBC-NCL: Rs. 500/- (Rs. 400/- refundable), SC/ST/PwBD/Female/ExSM/Transgender/Minorities/EBC: Rs. 250/- (refundable on appearing in CBT)
Apply Start Date 31.01.2026 (00:00 Hrs)
Apply Last Date 02.03.2026 (23:59 Hrs)
Fee Payment Last Date 04.03.2026 (23:59 Hrs)
Apply Mode Online Only
Official Website www.indianrailways.gov.in, Official RRB websites (listed in notification)

RRB Group D CEN 09/2025 Post-wise Vacancy Details

Post Name Department Medical Standard
Track Maintainer-IV Engineering (P Way) B1
Pointsman B Traffic A2
Assistant (S & T) Signal & Telecommunication B1
Assistant TRD Electrical (TRD) B1
Assistant Operations (Electrical) Electrical (General Services/Workshop/Diesel Shed) B1/C1
Assistant Carriage & Wagon Mechanical B1
Assistant Track Machine Engineering (Track Machine) A3
Assistant TL & AC Electrical (General Services) B1
Assistant Loco Shed (Electrical) Electrical (Electrical Shed/Diesel Shed) B1
Assistant Bridge Engineering (Bridge) B1
Assistant P.Way Engineering (P Way) B1
Various other Assistant posts Electrical, S&T, Engineering, Mechanical A2/A3/B1/C1
TOTAL VACANCIES: 22195 Posts

Railway Zone-wise Distribution (Sample - Major Zones):

  • Western Railway (Mumbai): 3,166 posts
  • Northern Railway (Delhi): 3,537 posts
  • Central Railway (Mumbai): 2,157 posts
  • Eastern Railway (Kolkata): 1,078 posts
  • Other Zones: Remaining posts distributed across NFR, NER, SCR, SR, SWR, WCR, ECR, ECoR, SECR, NWR, NCR, SER

Note: Detailed Railway Zone-wise and post-wise vacancy table available in Annexure-B of the official notification. Vacancies are provisional and may increase or decrease.

Eligibility Criteria for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Educational Qualification (as on 02.03.2026):

  • 10th Pass (Matriculation/SSC/SSLC) from recognized Board, OR
  • ITI (Industrial Training Institute) certificate from recognized institute, OR
  • Equivalent qualification, OR
  • National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) granted by National Council for Vocational Training (NCVT)
  • Important: Candidates waiting for final results are NOT eligible to apply
  • Diploma/Degree in Engineering will NOT be accepted in lieu of ITI/Course Completed Act Apprenticeship

Medical Standards:

Medical Standard Distant Vision Near Vision
A-2 (e.g., Pointsman B) 6/9, 6/9 without glasses (no fogging test) Sn. 0.6, 0.6 without glasses
A-3 (e.g., Assistant Track Machine) 6/9, 6/9 with/without glasses (power ≤ 2D) Sn. 0.6, 0.6 with/without glasses
B-1 (Most posts) 6/9, 6/12 with/without glasses (power ≤ 4D) Sn. 0.6, 0.6 with/without glasses
C-1 6/12, 6/18 with/without glasses Sn. 0.6, 0.6 with/without glasses

Important Medical Notes:

  • Candidates must ensure they are medically fit as per Indian Railway Medical Manual (IRMM) Vol. I Chapter 5
  • LASIK surgery candidates NOT eligible for A2 & A3 medical standard posts (must submit declaration as per Annexure-VII)
  • Different medical standards for Ex-Servicemen (Para 534 of IRMM)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Age Limit for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025 (as on 01.01.2026)

General Age Limits:

  • Minimum Age: 18 years (Born on or before 01.01.2008)
  • Maximum Age: 33 years for UR & EWS (Born on or after 02.01.1993)
  • Maximum Age: 36 years for OBC-NCL (Born on or after 02.01.1990)
  • Maximum Age: 38 years for SC/ST (Born on or after 02.01.1988)

Age Relaxation:

Category Age Relaxation
OBC-Non Creamy Layer (NCL) 3 years
SC/ST 5 years
PwBD (UR & EWS) 10 years
PwBD (OBC-NCL) 13 years (10+3)
PwBD (SC/ST) 15 years (10+5)
Ex-Servicemen (UR & EWS) 3 years (after deducting military service)
Ex-Servicemen (OBC-NCL) 6 years (after deducting military service)
Ex-Servicemen (SC/ST) 8 years (after deducting military service)
Group C/D Railway Staff (3+ years service) - UR/EWS Up to 40 years
Group C/D Railway Staff (3+ years service) - OBC-NCL Up to 43 years
Group C/D Railway Staff (3+ years service) - SC/ST Up to 45 years
Female candidates (widowed/divorced/judicially separated) - UR Up to 35 years
Female candidates (widowed/divorced/judicially separated) - OBC-NCL Up to 38 years
Female candidates (widowed/divorced/judicially separated) - SC/ST Up to 40 years
Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA) - UR/EWS Maximum 3 years (extent of apprenticeship training)
CCAA - OBC-NCL Maximum 6 years (including category relaxation)
CCAA - SC/ST Maximum 8 years (including category relaxation)
Act Apprentices who commenced before age 25 - UR/EWS Up to 35 years
Act Apprentices who commenced before age 25 - OBC-NCL Up to 38 years
Act Apprentices who commenced before age 25 - SC/ST Up to 40 years

Important Notes:

  • If eligible for multiple relaxations, maximum relaxation will be given (NOT cumulative)
  • SC/ST/OBC-NCL applying against UR vacancies: No age relaxation
  • PwBD applying against UR vacancies: PwBD age relaxation applicable
  • Maximum upper age limit (except Ex-Servicemen): 52 years
  • Matriculation certificate is the ONLY acceptable proof of age

Application Fee for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Category Fee Amount Refund
General, EWS, OBC-NCL (Male candidates not covered in Sl. 2) Rs. 500/- Rs. 400/- (after deducting bank charges) - on appearing in CBT
SC, ST, Ex-Servicemen, PwBD, Female, Transgender, Minorities, Economically Backward Class (EBC) Rs. 250/- Full Rs. 250/- (after deducting bank charges) - on appearing in CBT

Payment Mode: Online only through Internet Banking, Debit/Credit Card, or UPI (all service charges borne by candidate)

Payment Deadline: 04.03.2026 up to 23:59 Hrs

Important Notes on Fee:

  • Fee refund (minus bank charges) will be credited ONLY to Aadhaar-seeded bank account
  • No refund for incomplete/rejected applications or candidates not appearing in CBT
  • Applications without prescribed fee will be summarily rejected
  • Minorities: Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Jains, Zoroastrians (Parsis) - must submit affidavit at DV
  • EBC: Family income < Rs. 50,000/- per annum (valid EBC certificate/BPL card/Izzat MST required)
  • Note: EBC, EWS, and OBC are three DIFFERENT categories. EBC eligible for fee concession only (NOT job reservation)

Important Dates for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Event Date & Time
Indicative Notice in Employment News 27.12.2025
Online Application Start Date 31.01.2026 (00:00 Hrs)
Online Application Closing Date 02.03.2026 (23:59 Hrs)
Fee Payment Last Date 04.03.2026 (23:59 Hrs)
Application Modification Window (with Rs. 250/- fee) 05.03.2026 to 14.03.2026 (23:59 Hrs)
Scribe Details Entry Window (for eligible PwBD candidates) 15.03.2026 to 19.03.2026
Computer Based Test (CBT) - Tentative Will be notified on RRB websites
Physical Efficiency Test (PET) Will be notified on RRC websites
Document Verification (DV) Will be notified on RRC websites
Medical Examination (ME) Will be notified on RRC websites

Selection Process for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

The recruitment consists of 4 successive stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Test (CBT)

Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for candidates using scribe)

Total Questions: 100 (Each of 1 mark)

Subject Number of Questions
General Science 25
Mathematics 25
General Intelligence and Reasoning 30
General Awareness and Current Affairs 20
TOTAL 100 Questions = 100 Marks

Exam Pattern:

  • Objective type with multiple choices
  • Questions available in English, Hindi, and 13 regional languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu)
  • Negative Marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer
  • Section-wise distribution may vary slightly in actual exam

Minimum Qualifying Marks:

  • UR: 40%
  • EWS: 40%
  • OBC-NCL: 30%
  • SC: 30%
  • ST: 30%
  • PwBD: May be relaxed by 2 marks in case of shortage

Syllabus (Indicative):

  • Mathematics: Number system, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Mensuration, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Simple & Compound Interest, Profit & Loss, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics, Square root, Age Calculations, Calendar & Clock, Pipes & Cistern
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding & Decoding, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Conclusions & Decision making, Similarities & Differences, Analytical Reasoning, Classification, Directions, Statement-Arguments & Assumptions
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences of 10th standard level (CBSE)
  • General Awareness & Current Affairs: Science & Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Politics, and other important subjects

Normalization: Marks will be normalized if CBT conducted in multiple sessions

Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

Shortlisting: 3 times the total vacancies (may vary) based on CBT merit

Nature: Qualifying (Mandatory to pass - marks not counted for final merit)

Candidate Type Test 1: Weight Carrying Test 2: Running
Male Candidates Lift and carry 35 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 4 minutes 15 seconds (in one chance)
Female Candidates Lift and carry 20 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 5 minutes 40 seconds (in one chance)
Transgender Candidates Same relaxed standards as Female candidates

Important PET Notes:

  • Two-stage test: First weight carrying, then running (after recovery gap)
  • Failing in weight carrying means elimination (no running test)
  • Weight carrying involves lifting sandbag (without handle) from waist-height bench and carrying without dropping
  • Candidates' responsibility to ensure medical fitness for PET - Railways not responsible for injuries
  • Exemptions from PET:
    • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - must pass medical examination
    • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA)
    • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Pregnant Candidates: Must submit self-declaration. If pregnant, PET deferred till 6 weeks post-confinement. Vacancy kept reserved.

Stage 3: Document Verification (DV)

  • Shortlisting: 1:1 ratio of vacancies based on CBT merit + PET qualification
  • Candidates must produce original certificates
  • No additional time given - absence leads to candidature cancellation
  • Scanned copies to be uploaded before DV at https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv
  • Certificates must be in English/Hindi (translated version required otherwise)
  • Hard copy of signed application form to be brought

Stage 4: Medical Examination (ME)

  • Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities
  • Must pass requisite medical fitness test as per IRMM
  • Visual acuity standards strictly enforced
  • Medical appeal option available (one final opportunity on payment)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Final Merit & Selection

  • Based on CBT marks (after normalization if applicable)
  • Subject to PET qualification, DV clearance, and medical fitness
  • Post/Railway allotment as per candidate's preference, merit, medical fitness, and vacancy
  • In case of tie: Older candidate ranked higher; if age also same, alphabetical order of name (A to Z)
  • No right to appointment - RRB/RRC only recommends; appointment by Railway Administration

Reservation & Relaxation for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Vertical Reservation (Community-wise):

  • SC (Scheduled Caste)
  • ST (Scheduled Tribe)
  • OBC-NCL (Other Backward Classes - Non Creamy Layer)
  • EWS (Economically Weaker Sections)

Horizontal Reservation (across all communities):

  • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA) trained in Railway Establishments
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD)

Important Reservation Rules:

For OBC-NCL Candidates:

  • Must produce OBC-NCL certificate issued on or after 01.04.2025 but not later than 02.03.2026
  • Certificate must be as per central list (http://www.ncbc.nic.in)
  • Must submit self-declaration (Annexure IIA) at DV that they don't belong to Creamy Layer
  • Certificate must mention: "Does NOT belong to Creamy Layer as per DOPT OM 36012/22/93-Estt.(SCT) dated 08.09.93, modified vide OM 36033/1/2013-Estt.(Res.) dated 13.09.2017"
  • OBC in state list but not in central list: NOT eligible for reservation

For EWS Candidates:

  • NOT covered under SC/ST/OBC-NCL
  • Gross annual family income < Rs. 8 lakh for F.Y. 2024-25
  • Family should NOT own:
    • 5 acres or more of agricultural land, OR
    • Residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. or more, OR
    • Residential plot of 100 sq. yards or more (notified municipalities), OR
    • Residential plot of 200 sq. yards or more (other areas)
  • Family: Applicant, parents, siblings <18 years, spouse, children <18 years
  • Must possess valid Income & Asset Certificate (Annexure III) based on F.Y. 2024-25 income/assets

For PwBD Candidates:

  • Minimum 40% benchmark disability required for reservation/relaxation
  • Certificate as per Form V/VI of RPwD Rules 2024 (Annexure V-A/V-B)
  • Must submit Unique Disability Identity (UDID)
  • Suitability for posts indicated in Annexure-A
  • Eligible Disabilities:
    • VI (Visually Impaired): Blindness (B), Low Vision (LV)
    • HI (Hearing Impaired): Deaf (D), Hard of Hearing (HH)
    • LD (Locomotor Disability): OA, OL, OAL, BL, LC, DW, AAV, CP, SD (without neurological/limb dysfunction), SI (without neurological/limb dysfunction)
    • MD (Multiple Disabilities)
  • Temporary disability candidates NOT eligible for reservation (as per DePwD OM dated 17.12.2025)

For Ex-Servicemen (ExSM):

  • Must have valid Ex-Serviceman Certificate from Zila Sainik Board
  • Serving defense personnel expected to be released within 1 year can also apply
  • Must submit NOC with probable discharge date (Annexure VI-A) at DV
  • Declaration/Undertaking (Annexure VI) required at DV
  • ExSM who already secured civil employment using ExSM quota: NOT eligible for ExSM reservation (only age relaxation available)
  • Different medical standards applicable (Para 534 of IRMM)

For CCAA (Railway Establishments):

  • Must have completed Act Apprenticeship by 02.03.2026 (appeared in NCVT exam)
  • National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) from NCVT required at DV
  • Weightage: 1/3rd marks from NCVT examination added to CBT marks for merit
  • If NCVT weightage gives lower score, higher of the two will be considered
  • Exempted from PET
  • Can apply to any RRB (not just training Railway)

General Instructions for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Application Rules:

  • ONE application per candidate - Multiple applications will lead to rejection of ALL applications and debarment from future RRB/RRC exams
  • Choose only ONE RRB/Railway Zone (cannot be changed later)
  • Indicate post preferences within chosen Railway Zone
  • Partial options allowed (will be considered only for opted posts)
  • No change in preferences after submission
  • Online application only through official RRB websites (listed in Para 24.0)

Identity Authentication:

  • Strongly advised to authenticate using DigiLocker or Aadhaar during account creation
  • Aadhaar-seeded bank account mandatory for fee refund
  • Candidates using alternate Photo IDs will face stricter scrutiny at all stages

Account Creation:

  • If already created account for CEN 2024/2025, use same credentials
  • Valid mobile number and email ID mandatory (will remain unchanged throughout recruitment)
  • Details in 'Create an Account' form CANNOT be modified

Application Modification:

  • Allowed from 05.03.2026 to 14.03.2026
  • Fee: Rs. 250/- per modification (non-refundable)
  • Can modify any number of times (except 'Create Account' details and Chosen Railway)
  • If changing from SC/ST to UR/OBC/EWS or from ExSM/Female/PwBD to non-reserved: Pay fee difference (Rs. 250/-) in addition to modification fee
  • No modifications entertained after 14.03.2026

Live Photo & Signature Upload:

  • Live Photo: Captured during application (NOT pre-existing photo)
  • Stand/sit in front of camera at eye level, face centered, neutral expression
  • Non-white clothing (preferably dark colors), no cap/mask/glasses
  • Applications with blurred/non-compliant photos liable for rejection
  • Signature: Running handwriting in black ink on white paper (scanned)
  • NO BLOCK/CAPITAL/DISJOINTED LETTERS
  • JPG/JPEG format, 30-49 KB, 140×60 pixels minimum
  • Signature must match at all stages (CBT/DV/ME/Appointment)

Scribe Facility (for eligible PwBD candidates):

  • Eligible: Blindness, Locomotor Disability (Both Arms - BA), Cerebral Palsy
  • Others: Only with certificate from CMO/Civil Surgeon (Annexure V-G)
  • PwBD <40% with writing difficulty: Certificate as per Annexure V-E required
  • Scribe must register at rrbapply.gov.in (One-Time Registration - OTR)
  • Candidate must enter scribe's OTR number during 15.03.2026 to 19.03.2026 window
  • Scribe qualification: ONE step below candidate's qualification
  • One scribe per candidate; scribe cannot be a candidate in same CEN
  • Compensatory time: 20 minutes per hour of examination

Examination Centers:

  • Allocated based on technical/logistical feasibility
  • Candidates may have to travel to other cities/states
  • No change of center/date/shift allowed

Banned Items at Exam Center:

  • Mobile phones, pagers, watches, earphones, Bluetooth devices, microphones, health bands
  • Calculators, books, pen, paper, pencil, eraser, pouch, scale, writing pad
  • Belts, handbags, caps, purses, cameras, water bottles, food items
  • ONLY e-call letter allowed inside test center
  • Pen will be provided during exam
  • No cloak room - advised not to bring valuables
  • Do not apply henna on hands/feet (obstructs biometric capture)

Important Warnings:

  • Debarment for life if found using unfair means, impersonation, forgery, misbehavior
  • Provisions of "The Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024" applicable
  • Comprehensive post-exam analysis (log analysis, photo/biometric verification, CCTV review)
  • Beware of touts and fake websites - RRBs NEVER appoint agents/coaching centers
  • Selection purely on merit

How to Apply for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Step 1: Create an Account (if not already created)

  • Visit official RRB website from the list at Para 24.0
  • Click on "Create an Account" link
  • Authenticate using DigiLocker/Aadhaar (strongly recommended)
  • Enter valid mobile number and email ID (CANNOT be changed later)
  • Complete OTP verification
  • Create login credentials

Step 2: Fill Online Application

  • Login with created credentials
  • Select CEN 09/2025
  • Choose ONE RRB/Railway Zone (CANNOT be changed)
  • Fill personal details, educational qualifications
  • Select post preferences within chosen Railway
  • Choose examination language (English/Hindi/Regional)
  • Capture live photograph using webcam/mobile camera
  • Upload scanned signature (JPG/JPEG, 30-49 KB, black ink, running handwriting)
  • Upload SC/ST certificate (if claiming free travel pass)
  • Indicate scribe requirement (if applicable)
  • Verify all details carefully

Step 3: Pay Application Fee

  • Select payment mode: Internet Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI
  • Pay Rs. 500/- (General/EWS/OBC-NCL Male) or Rs. 250/- (SC/ST/PwBD/Female/ExSM/Transgender/Minorities/EBC)
  • Complete payment (all service charges borne by candidate)
  • Save payment receipt

Step 4: Final Submission

  • After successful payment, application will be accepted
  • Receive confirmation via SMS and email
  • Download and save final application form
  • Note Application Number for future reference

Step 5: Modification (if required)

  • Window: 05.03.2026 to 14.03.2026
  • Login and modify details (except Create Account info & Chosen Railway)
  • Pay Rs. 250/- per modification
  • Pay additional fee if changing from reserved to unreserved category

Step 6: Enter Scribe Details (if applicable)

  • Window: 15.03.2026 to 19.03.2026
  • Login to application portal
  • Enter scribe's OTR number
  • Enter OTP sent to scribe's mobile to confirm

Documents to Upload:

  1. Live photograph (captured during application)
  2. Signature (scanned - JPG/JPEG, 30-49 KB, running handwriting)
  3. SC/ST certificate (PDF, <400 KB) - if claiming free travel pass

Documents Required at DV (Original + 2 self-attested photocopies):

  • 10th/Matriculation certificate (for age & education)
  • ITI/NAC certificate (if applicable)
  • SC/ST certificate (Annexure-I)
  • OBC-NCL certificate (Annexure-II) - issued on/after 01.04.2025
  • OBC-NCL self-declaration (Annexure-II A)
  • EWS certificate (Annexure-III) - valid for 2025-26, based on F.Y. 2024-25
  • EBC certificate (Annexure-III A) / BPL card / Izzat MST (if claimed fee concession)
  • Minority affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper (Annexure-IV)
  • PwBD certificate (Annexure V-A/V-B) with UDID
  • ExSM certificate from Zila Sainik Board
  • ExSM declaration (Annexure VI)
  • ExSM NOC with probable discharge date (Annexure VI-A) - if serving
  • CCAA - NAC certificate from NCVT
  • LASIK declaration (Annexure-VII) - for A2/A3 posts
  • NOC from employer (if Govt. employee)
  • Caste change certificates (if name differs from 10th certificate)
  • Medical certificates (for scribe eligibility - Annexure V-E/V-F/V-G)

Individual RRB Websites for Online Application:

Indian Army JAG Entry 2026 – Apply Online for 124th Course (Oct 2026)

Advertisement

Indian Army has released the official notification for JAG Entry Scheme 124th Course (October 2026) recruitment. Candidates looking for Indian Army JAG jobs 2026 can apply online for 08 vacancies of Judge Advocate General Branch on Short Service Commission (NT) basis. The Indian Army JAG online form 2026 will be available on the official website from 27-01-2026 (1500 Hrs) to 27-02-2026 (1500 Hrs). This Indian Army JAG vacancy 2026 offers excellent career opportunities with attractive salary of approximately ₹17-18 Lakh per annum CTC after commissioning. Interested unmarried male and unmarried female Law Graduates must check complete details about eligibility criteria, CLAT PG 2025 requirement, SSB process, and selection procedure before applying for Indian Army JAG Entry 124th Course.

Trending Govt Jobs
  • India Post GDS Online Form 2026
  • UPSC CSE Online Form 2026
  • RRB 22000 Group D Online form 2026
  • Yantra India YIL 3979 Trade Apprentices Online Form 2026
  • SBI 2273 CBO Recruitment 2026

Indian Army JAG Entry 2026 – Course Details Overview

Detail Information
Recruitment Name JAG Entry Scheme 124th Course (Oct 2026)
Organization Indian Army - Judge Advocate General Branch
Post Name Short Service Commission (NT) Officer
Total Vacancy 08 Posts (Combined for Men & Women)
Job Category Indian Army JAG Jobs 2026 - Law Graduates
Application Mode Online Only
Course Start October 2026
Training Duration 49 Weeks at OTA Chennai
Rank after Training Lieutenant
CTC after Commissioning Approx. ₹17-18 Lakh per annum
Commission Type Short Service Commission (14 Years)
Last Date 27/02/2026 @ 1500 Hrs
Official Website joinindianarmy.nic.in

Download Indian Army JAG Entry 2026 Notification & Online Form

Candidates can access the official Indian Army JAG 124th Course vacancy 2026 notification and apply through the Indian Army JAG online form 2026 using links below:

  • Indian Army JAG Entry 2026 Notification PDF: [Download from Official Website]
  • Indian Army JAG Online Application Form 2026: [Apply at joinindianarmy.nic.in]
  • Check All Indian Army JAG Jobs 2026: [joinindianarmy.nic.in]

Important Dates for Indian Army JAG Entry 2026

All candidates applying for Indian Army JAG vacancy 2026 must note these important dates:

Event Date/Period
Indian Army JAG 2026 Notification Date January 2026
Indian Army JAG Online Form 2026 Start Date 27/01/2026 @ 1500 Hrs
Last Date to Apply for Indian Army JAG Jobs 2026 27/02/2026 @ 1500 Hrs
SSB Shortlisting (based on CLAT PG Score) Second Week of March 2026
SSB Centre & Date Selection Opens May 2026 (Two weeks option)
SSB Interview Duration Upto 5 days in May/June 2026
Medical Examination After SSB (for recommended candidates)
Indian Army JAG Merit List 2026 After Medical Examination
Joining Letter Issue As per Merit & Vacancies
Training Commencement October 2026
Training Completion After 49 Weeks (Mid-2027)

Indian Army JAG Vacancy 2026 – Details

Total Vacancies: 08 Posts

Details Information
Post Name Short Service Commission Officer (JAG Branch)
Total Vacancy 08 (Combined for Men & Women)
Open For Unmarried Male & Unmarried Female Law Graduates
Primary Service Judge Advocate General (JAG) Branch
Commission Type Short Service Commission (NT)
Initial Tenure 10 Years
Extended Tenure Additional 4 Years (Total 14 Years)
PC Option After 10 Years (if eligible and suitable)

Note: Indian Army publishes/notifies combined vacancies for Men and Women based on operational and administrative needs. The application process, SSB shortlisting (cut-off), selection and merit is purely based on notified vacancies and driven by applications received.

Eligibility Criteria for Indian Army JAG Entry 2026

Before applying for Indian Army JAG online form 2026, candidates must check the following eligibility requirements:

Nationality Requirements

A candidate must be either:

  1. Citizen of India, OR
  2. Subject of Nepal, OR
  3. Person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Myanmar, Sri Lanka and East African countries (Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia, Vietnam) with intention of permanently settling in India

Note: Categories (2) and (3) require certificate of eligibility from Government of India. Nepal Gorkha subjects don't need certificate.

Educational Qualification for Indian Army JAG Vacancy 2026

Essential Qualifications:

  1. LLB Degree:

    • Three years professional after graduation, OR
    • Five years after 10+2
    • Minimum Marks: 55% aggregate in LLB Degree
    • Must be from College/University recognized by Bar Council of India

  2. CLAT PG 2025 Score:

    • MANDATORY for all candidates
    • Must have appeared for CLAT PG Exam 2025
    • Applicable to all candidates including:
      • LLM qualified candidates
      • LLM appearing candidates
      • All LLB degree holders

  3. Bar Council Registration:

    • Must be eligible for registration as advocate with Bar Council of India/State

Important Notes:

  • Only candidates holding LLB degree AND mark sheet are eligible
  • CLAT PG 2025 result verification mandatory at Selection Centre before SSB
  • Candidates unable to verify CLAT PG 2025 result will not be eligible for SSB
  • Candidature will be cancelled without representation
  • No provision for offline applications

Document Proof Requirements:

  • LLB Degree or Provisional Degree (not more than 6 months old at joining)
  • All semester/year mark sheets
  • Graduation Degree/Provisional Degree (for 3-year LLB course)
  • Bar Council of India registration OR College/University certificate of BCI recognition
  • CGPA to percentage conversion certificate
  • CLAT PG 2025 Score Card

Age Limit for Indian Army JAG Jobs 2026

Criteria Age Requirement
As on 01 July 2026 21 to 27 Years
Date of Birth Range Born NOT earlier than 02 Jul 1999 AND NOT later than 01 Jul 2005 (both dates inclusive)

Age Proof:

  • Only Matriculation/Secondary School Examination Certificate or equivalent accepted
  • Date of birth as recorded on application submission date will be final
  • NO subsequent request for change will be considered

Important: No age relaxation mentioned in the notification

Marital Status

  • Men: Unmarried only
  • Women: Unmarried only
  • Marriage during training: Strictly prohibited
  • Marriage after application: Candidature will be cancelled even if SSB cleared
  • Marriage penalty: Discharge + refund of all government expenditure

Indian Army JAG Salary 2026 – Pay Structure

During Training (49 Weeks at OTA Chennai)

Component Amount
Monthly Stipend ₹56,100/- per month
Insurance Coverage ₹1.25 Crore (AGIF)
AGIF Subscription ₹12,500/- per month (advance payment)

Note: Training period not treated as commissioned service. Arrears of allowances paid after commissioning.

After Commissioning (As Lieutenant)

Basic Pay Structure:

Rank Pay Level Pay Range (₹)
Lieutenant Level 10 56,100 - 1,77,500
Captain Level 10B 61,300 - 1,93,900
Major Level 11 69,400 - 2,07,200
Lt Colonel Level 12A 1,21,200 - 2,12,400
Colonel (TS) Level 13 1,30,600 - 2,15,900
Colonel Selection Based -
Brigadier Level 13A 1,39,600 - 2,17,600
Major General Level 14 1,44,200 - 2,18,200

Initial Commissioning Pay: Pay will be fixed in first cell of Level 10 (₹56,100/-)

Approximate CTC: ₹17-18 Lakh per annum (including all allowances)

Allowances & Benefits

Fixed Allowances:

Allowance Amount (₹)
Military Service Pay (MSP) 15,500/- per month (Lt to Brig)
Dearness Allowance (DA) As per Central Govt rates
Transport Allowance (TPTA) - Higher Cities 7,200 + DA
Transport Allowance - Other Places 3,600 + DA
Dress Allowance 20,000/- per year
Children Education Allowance 2,250/- per month per child (first 2)
Hostel Subsidy 6,750/- per month per child (first 2)

Special Allowances (as applicable):

Allowance Amount (₹)
Para Allowance 10,500/-
Para Reserve Allowance 2,625/-
Para Jump Instructor Allowance 10,500/-
Special Forces Allowance 25,000/-
Technical Allowance (Tier-I) 3,000/- per month
Technical Allowance (Tier-II) 4,500/- per month
Project Allowance 3,400/-

Field Area Allowances:

  • Maximum for officers: ₹42,500/-
  • Siachen Allowance as applicable
  • Hardship allowances ranging from ₹1,200 to ₹25,000 based on posting area
  • High Altitude, HAFA, Flying, Submarine, Special Forces allowances as applicable

Additional Benefits:

  • Ration in Kind (Peace & Field Areas)
  • Medical facilities for self and family
  • Leave Travel Concession (LTC)
  • Army Group Insurance (₹1.25 Crore)
  • Post-Graduate Diploma from University of Madras
  • Permanent Commission option after 10 years

Note: Pay and allowances subject to revision from time to time. Allowances enhanced by 25% automatically when DA increases by 50%.

Service Terms & Conditions - Indian Army JAG Entry 2026

Tenure of Engagement

Short Service Commission Structure:

  • Initial Period: 10 Years
  • Extended Period: Additional 4 Years
  • Total Maximum: 14 Years

Permanent Commission (PC) Option:

  • Available after completion of 10 years
  • Subject to eligibility and suitability
  • As per policies issued from time to time
  • Not selected for PC = Option to continue as SSC for 14 years total
  • Released from Army after 14 years if not granted PC

Release Options

1. After 5 Years of Service:

  • Application during 5th year of service
  • Army HQ considers on merits
  • Decision final and irrevocable
  • Released on completion of 5 years
  • Exception: Not applicable if undergone specialized course (cost must be recovered)

2. During Extended Tenure (10-14 Years): Release permitted for:

  • Taking up civil job
  • Pursuing higher education
  • Starting own business/joining family business

3. After 10 Years:

  • Can opt for release if not selected for PC
  • Can continue for full 14 years

4. After 14 Years:

  • Compulsory release if not granted PC

Probation & Terms

  • Probation Period: 6 months from commissioning date
  • Termination Rights: Government can terminate commission anytime for:
    • Misconduct or unsatisfactory service
    • Medical unfitness
    • Services no longer required
    • Failure to qualify in prescribed test/course
    • Compassionate grounds (3 months notice, no terminal gratuity)

Reserve Liability

After release, officers carry reserve liability to serve:

  • Duration: 5 years plus 2 years on voluntary basis
  • Age Limit: Up to 37 years (women) / 40 years (men), whichever is earlier

Bond Requirements

  • No advance bond mentioned
  • Specialized course training cost recovery if leaving early
  • Marriage during training = Discharge + refund of all expenses

Training Details - OTA Chennai

Pre-Commission Training

Training Academy: Officers Training Academy (OTA), Chennai

Training Duration: 49 Weeks (from October 2026)

Training Highlights:

  • Complete government expense
  • No marriage during training
  • No staying with parents/guardians
  • Military training and law-specific subjects
  • Physical fitness requirements mandatory
  • Post-Graduate Diploma awarded

Minimum Physical Standards Required Before Joining:

Activity Men (Officer Cadets) Women (Officer Cadets)
2.4 Km Run 10 Minutes 30 Seconds 13 Minutes
Sit-ups 30 25
Push-ups 40 15
Cross Grip 04-06 02
Squats 2 sets of 30 repetitions 2 sets of 30 repetitions
Lunges 2 sets of 10 reps each leg 2 sets of 10 reps each leg
Swimming Pass 25 mtr with any stroke Pass 25 mtr with any stroke

Post-Training Qualification

Award: Post-Graduate Diploma in Defence Management and Strategic Studies Issued by: University of Madras Eligibility: All candidates who successfully complete training at OTA Chennai

Training Cost

  • Government Expense: Entire training cost
  • Withdrawal Penalty: If withdrawn for personal reasons (not medical/beyond control):
    • Cost recovery: ₹20,482/- per week (as of 2026)
    • Calculated for period of stay at OTA
    • Subject to periodic revision

Post-Training Allocation

  • Arms/Services Allocation: Made before passing out from OTA
  • Primary Allocation: JAG Branch (as per course)
  • Final allocation based on merit, vacancies, and requirements

Selection Process for Indian Army JAG Entry 2026

The selection for Indian Army JAG vacancy 2026 will be conducted through following stages:

Stage 1: Online Application

Application Period: 27 Jan 2026 (1500 Hrs) to 27 Feb 2026 (1500 Hrs)

Application Steps:

  1. Visit www.joinindianarmy.nic.in
  2. Click 'Officer Entry Appln/Login'
  3. Register (if not already registered)
  4. Login and click 'Apply Online' under Dashboard
  5. Select 'Officers Selection - Eligibility'
  6. Click 'Apply' for Short Service Commission JAG Entry Course
  7. Fill all segments carefully
  8. Save & Continue after each segment
  9. Review summary
  10. Submit application
  11. Take 2 printouts with Roll Number

Important: Application closure time is 1500 Hrs on 27 Feb 2026. Submit well in advance.

Stage 2: Shortlisting for SSB

Shortlisting Timeline: Second week of March 2026

Shortlisting Criteria:

  • Based on CLAT PG 2025 scores
  • Vacancy to call-up ratio
  • Integrated HQ of MoD (Army) reserves right to shortlist without assigning reasons

CLAT PG 2025 Verification:

  • Mandatory at Selection Centre before SSB
  • Failure to verify = Candidature cancelled
  • No representation entertained

Stage 3: SSB Centre & Date Selection

Selection Period: Two weeks in May 2026

Process:

  • Login to website after shortlisting
  • Select SSB Centre and Date
  • First come, first serve basis
  • Once selected, cannot be changed
  • No request for change entertained

SSB Centres:

  • Prayagraj (Uttar Pradesh)
  • Bhopal (Madhya Pradesh)
  • Bengaluru (Karnataka)
  • Jalandhar (Punjab)

Stage 4: SSB Interview

SSB Period: May/June 2026

Duration: Up to 5 days

Call-up Letter: Sent on registered email ID and SMS by Selection Centre

SSB Process:

Day 1 - Stage I (Screening):

  • Officer Intelligence Rating (OIR) Test
  • Picture Perception & Description Test (PP&DT)
  • Result: Same day
  • Qualified: Proceed to Stage II
  • Not Qualified: Return same day

Days 2-5 - Stage II (for Stage I qualified candidates):

  • Psychological Tests
  • Group Testing Officer (GTO) Tasks
  • Personal Interview
  • Conference
  • Result: Recommended or Not Recommended

Documents Required at SSB:

  • Application printout (signed, with self-attested photo)
  • Matriculation/SSC certificate & mark sheet (DOB proof)
  • 12th Class certificate & mark sheet
  • Graduation Degree/Provisional Degree
  • LLB Degree/Provisional Degree
  • All semester/year mark sheets
  • Bar Council registration/College certificate
  • CGPA conversion certificate
  • CLAT PG 2025 Score Card (MANDATORY)
  • All originals for verification

Note: DIGILOCKER certificates NOT accepted. Only original certificates or authenticated color printouts with school/college certificate.

Stage 5: Medical Examination

Conducted for: Only SSB recommended candidates

Validity: 270 days (SSB to PCTA joining)

Medical Standards: As per www.joinindianarmy.nic.in

Re-examination:

  • Not required if already declared 'Med FIT' for any SSB of any service within 270 days
  • Valid till 01 Oct 2026 (joining date of this course)

Medical Board: Proceedings confidential, not divulged to anyone

Stage 6: Merit List Preparation

Criteria:

  1. Primary: SSB interview marks
  2. Tie-breaker 1: Older candidate ranked higher
  3. Tie-breaker 2: Higher percentage in qualifying exam (if age also same)

Note: Higher educational qualifications, previous performance have NO role

Stage 7: Joining Letter

Issued to:

  • Candidates in merit list
  • Within stipulated vacancies
  • Medically fit
  • Meeting all eligibility criteria

Reporting: Within 7 days of reporting date Late Reporting: Candidature cancelled, next candidate called

How to Apply for Indian Army JAG Entry 2026?

Follow these steps to complete Indian Army JAG online application 2026:

Step-by-Step Application Guide

Step 1: Registration (if not already registered)

  • Visit www.joinindianarmy.nic.in
  • Click 'Officer Entry Appln/Login'
  • Click 'Registration'
  • Fill registration form carefully
  • Submit and note credentials

Step 2: Login

  • Use registration credentials
  • Click 'Apply Online' under Dashboard

Step 3: Select Course

  • Page 'Officers Selection - Eligibility' opens
  • Click 'Apply' against 'Short Service Commission JAG Entry Course'

Step 4: Fill Application Form

  • Read instructions carefully
  • Click 'Continue'
  • Fill following segments:
    • Personal Information
    • Communication Details
    • Education Details
    • Previous SSB Details (if any)

Step 5: Save & Continue

  • Click 'Save & Continue' after each segment
  • Don't skip any segment

Step 6: Review & Submit

Advertisement

No of Posts 04 (Research Fellow: 01, Research Assistant: 03)
Salary Rs.45,000/- per month for Research Fellow; Rs.30,000/- per month for Research Assistant

Trending Govt Jobs
  • India Post GDS Online Form 2026
  • UPSC CSE Online Form 2026
  • RRB 22000 Group D Online form 2026
  • Yantra India YIL 3979 Trade Apprentices Online Form 2026
  • SBI 2273 CBO Recruitment 2026

Vacancy Details

Name of the Post No. of Vacancies
Research Fellow 01
Research Assistant 03

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualification: Applicant should be a Post Graduate in Law (under 10+2+3+3+2 or 10+2+5+2 pattern) from recognized Universities in the Indian Union and recognized by the Bar Council of India for admission as Advocate or Attorney of an Indian Court, for the post of Research Fellow.
  • Applicant should be a Graduate in Law (under 10+2+3+3 or 10+2+5 pattern) from recognized Universities in the Indian Union and recognized by the Bar Council of India for admission as Advocate or Attorney of an Indian Court, for the post of Research Assistant.
  • Applicants pursuing Post Graduate Degree in Law or any other Degrees or Programmes requiring their compulsory attendance elsewhere are not eligible to apply for the assignment as Research Fellow / Research Assistant.
  • Applicant must be skilled in the usage of computer including retrieval of desired information from various search engines / processes / Online Law Journals, etc.
  • Applicant should not have been involved in any criminal case, whether convicted or against whom criminal trial proceedings are pending. A declaration in this behalf shall be made by the candidate.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Research Fellow: Rs.45,000/- per month (consolidated pay)
  • Research Assistant: Rs.30,000/- per month (consolidated pay)

Age Limit (as on 01 January 2026)

  • Applicant must not have attained the age of 30 years as on 01.01.2026 (i.e. applicant should not have been born before 02.01.1996).

Important Dates

Notification Date 09 January 2026
Last Date for Submission of Online Application 20 February 2026

Selection Process

  • A Committee of Hon’ble Judges / Board of Governors constituted by the Hon’ble The Chief Justice will select the candidates on the basis of academic record, achievement in co-curricular activities and performance in the Viva-voce.
  • If there are large number of applicants, candidates will be shortlisted for Viva-voce on the basis of academic record and achievement in co-curricular activities.
  • Viva-voce will be conducted only in Chennai and no request for change of venue, date and time will be entertained.

General Information / Instructions

  • Research Fellow / Research Assistants will be ad hoc appointees and their engagement shall be initially for a period of one year on contract basis, extendable for a further period of not exceeding one more year based on performance.
  • The assignment may be discontinued even before completion of one year, without notice.
  • Research Fellow / Research Assistant shall not be treated or deemed to be an employee either in the Madras High Court Service or in the Tamil Nadu State Judicial Academy.
  • Any Research Fellow / Research Assistant intended to leave within one year shall give prior notice of three months.
  • No Research Fellow / Research Assistant shall practice as an Advocate in any Court during the assignment and must inform the Bar Council accordingly.
  • Shall not take up any employment or engagement on full-time or part-time basis during the assignment.
  • The decision of the High Court of Madras in respect of all matters pertaining to this Recruitment Process would be final and binding.
  • Candidates are required to keep visiting the websites of the Tamil Nadu State Judicial Academy[](https://www.Madras High Court.tn.nic.in) / Recruitment Portal of the Madras High Court[](https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in) for latest updates.
  • Any application seeking information regarding the selection under RTI will not be entertained till completion of the process.

How to Apply

  • Applications are invited through online mode only.
  • Applicants must visit https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/recruitment_rf/login and register as new applicants (previous registrations are invalid).
  • Enter details: E-mail ID, Mobile No., Name (as in SSLC or Gazette if changed), Create Password, Retype Password, Captcha Code.
  • After successful registration and OTP activation, login and fill the application in 5 steps: Personal Information (upload photo & signature), Educational Qualification details, Additional information (upload required certificates), Declaration, Confirm details & Submit.
  • Photograph: Recent passport size colour .jpg (20-50 KB, 230x200 pixels), white background, no selfie, no dark glasses/hats.
  • Signature: .jpg (<20 KB, 60x140 pixels).
  • Upload certificates (SSLC, HSC, Degrees/Marksheets, Enrolment, Experience, etc.) below 115 KB each.
  • Once submitted, no changes allowed; take printout of filled application for reference (no need to send physically).

  • Engagement of selected candidates is subject to their being declared medically fit as per the requirement of the Corporation.

General Information/Instructions

  • Reservation of seats to SC/ST/OBC (Non Creamy Layer-NCL)/PwBD/Economically Weaker Section (EWS) candidates shall be as per the applicable Government guidelines.
  • The minimum prescribed qualification marks will be relaxed by 5% for candidates belonging to SC/ST/PwBD categories considered against reserved positions.
  • In case of candidates belonging to OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) category, name of OBC caste mentioned in the certificate should fall in the Central List of OBCs of the respective State and Non-Creamy Layer status should be valid as on cut-off date of reckoning eligibility criteria.
  • Candidates are advised to ensure that they are Medically Fit as per IndianOil's pre-engagement medical standard.
  • The trades are suitable for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, with minimum 40% disability.
  • Candidates can apply for one Trade Code ONLY. Candidates applying for more than one Trade Code will not be considered for any post and their applications will be summarily rejected.
  • Only one mobile number and one email ID can be used for applying for the post. The same mobile number and email ID cannot be used by any other candidate for filling online application for this notification.
  • Candidates, who are pursuing higher qualification on the date of final submission of online application but have acquired/completed the same subsequently at the time of document verification, shall also not be eligible for engagement and shall not be allowed to Join.
  • Suppression of information regarding possession or pursuing higher qualification shall render a candidate ineligible for consideration at any stage of selection & termination any time during engagement, if engaged.
  • The terms and conditions of engagement of the apprentices shall be governed by The Apprentices Act, 1961 and Rules 1992 as amended from time to time.
  • Upon completion of the apprenticeship period, the Corporation shall have NO obligation to offer employment to such Apprentices NOR can an Apprentice claim the right for employment on the grounds of completion of Apprenticeship.
  • Candidates are advised to maintain the same registered e-mail ID and mobile number till the completion of apprenticeship training.
  • Candidates are advised to periodically visit the official website https://www.iocl.com/apprenticeships as all future correspondence and latest information shall be shared only on the website.

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Candidates willing to apply must register as a Technician/Trade/Graduate Apprentice online in the following portals under the respective State as per their Trades:
    • Trade Apprentice: Data Entry Operator (Fresher Apprentices)/Domestic Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders) at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
    • Technician Apprentice: (Mechanical/Electrical/Telecommunication & Instrumentation) at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
    • Trade Apprentice (Assistant-Human Resource/Accountant) at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
  • Step 2: Candidates meeting the prescribed eligibility criteria may LOGIN to the respective NATS/NAPS Portal using their User ID/Email ID and APPLY for the apprenticeship Openings/Opportunities with the Establishment ID of Indian Oil Corporation Limited mentioned below:
    • Eastern Region Pipelines (ERPL) - NATS: EWBKOC000079, NAPS: E11181900005
    • Western Region Pipelines (WRPL) - NATS: WGJRAC000006, NAPS: E11182400087
    • Northern Region Pipelines (NRPL) - NATS: NHRPPC000001, NAPS: E12180600006
    • Southern Region Pipelines (SRPL) - NATS: STNCHC000040, NAPS: E12183300008
    • South Eastern Region Pipelines (SERPL) - NATS: EORBBSC000001, NAPS: E02252100002
  • Step 3: Candidates must complete the application for Openings/Opportunities in respective NATS/NAPS Portal from 28/01/2026 to 10/02/2026. Before applying against an opportunity, the candidate MUST ensure that their profile (Personal details, Educational details, Category etc.) along with aggregate percentage are appearing correctly in their application.
  • Step 4: After applying against an opportunity in the respective NAPS/NATS Portal, the candidate must complete their registration/application for apprentice positions in Indian Oil Pipelines portal at https://plapps.indianoilpipelines.in/
  • Step 5: The candidate must use the same e-mail ID and Mobile Number used in respective NAPS/NATS Portal which must be valid for the entire apprenticeship period.
  • Step 6: There are two steps for Registration process (Part-I & Part-II) in Indian Oil Pipelines portal:
    • Part-I Registration: Candidate must fill their basic details like name, category etc. and must create their own password. After successful Part-I registration, system generated registration number is sent to their registered email id/SMS.
    • Part-II Registration: Candidates must upload their scanned photograph (Size: between 20-50 KB in JPG Format) and signature in black ink (Size: between 10-30 KB in JPG Format) and furnish educational qualification, experience details etc. and submit the same. This is the final submission process and after that candidates cannot change the details furnished.
  • Step 7: Candidates must complete the application process in Indian Oil Pipelines portal at https://plapps.indianoilpipelines.in/ from 28/01/2026 to 10/02/2026.
  • Step 8: The candidate must mention the registration/enrolment number of NAPS/NATS Portal while applying for apprentice positions in Indian Oil Pipelines Portal.
  • Step 9: After successfully applying/registration of Online Application in Indian Oil Pipelines Portal, the candidate must take a printout of the filled-in online application for future reference.
  • Important: No other means/mode of application shall be accepted other than what is mentioned above. Candidates to ensure that they have successfully applied for the relevant opportunity through respective NAPS/NATS Portal BEFORE applying/registration in Indian Oil Pipelines Portal.
  • Applications/Registration which are incomplete or are received in any other mode/form or not fulfilling the eligibility criteria and/or those received after the last date of submission of application shall not be considered "Eligible" and treated as "Rejected".

Project Details

Advertisement

Title: Peri-Nature Water Regimes and Nature

Research Centre: Centre for Sustainable Water Research (CSWR), IIT Guwahati

Focus: The project focuses on understanding water regimes in peri-urban and natural settings, examining the intersection of human-nature relationships, environmental sustainability, and water resource governance.

Principal Investigator (P.I): Prof. Anamika Barua

Eligibility Criteria

Essential Qualifications

  • Educational Qualification: PhD in Human Geography from a recognized university.
  • Research Experience: Minimum 3 years of research experience after PhD or equivalent project experience.
  • Publications: Minimum 5 publications in peer-reviewed journals relevant to environmental studies or human geography.

Desirable Skills and Experience

  • Field Research Capabilities: Ability to conduct qualitative and quantitative field research including interviews, Focus Group Discussions (FGDs), transect walks, participatory mapping, and documentation of community practices.
  • GIS & Remote Sensing Expertise: Expertise in GIS and Remote Sensing for analyzing land-use change, drainage networks, canal systems, hydrological pathways, and ecological boundaries.
  • Data Analysis Skills: Demonstrated capability in data analysis, report writing, academic manuscript preparation, and visual representation of research findings.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Experience collaborating with government agencies, local institutions, and community groups on issues related to water, environment, or peri-urban governance.
  • Team Collaboration: Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary, transdisciplinary, and field-oriented research teams.

Salary and Compensation

Particulars Amount (Monthly)
Basic Pay ₹67,000
House Rent Allowance (HRA) @ 18% ₹12,060
Medical Benefits As per IIT norms
Total Monthly Remuneration ₹79,060

Duration and Tenure

  • Initial Contract Duration: 11 months.
  • Probation Period: 3 months.
  • Extension: Based on performance review, the contract can be extended beyond the initial period.
  • Nature of Position: Contractual/Project-based.

Important Dates

Event Date & Time
Application Deadline 18-02-2026 @ 5:00 PM
Shortlist Notification Date 20-02-2026
Online Interview Date 24-02-2026 @ 10:00 AM
Interview Mode Online (Webex)

How to Apply

Application Process

  1. Visit the IIT Guwahati Research & Development Recruitment Portal: https://iitg.ac.in/rndproj/recruitment/.
  2. Search for the project title: "Peri-Nature Water Regimes and Nature".
  3. Register and complete the online application form with all required details.
  4. Follow all instructions and guidelines provided on the portal carefully.
  5. Submit the online application through the portal.

Supporting Documents to Submit

Candidates must also submit a scanned copy of their comprehensive Curriculum Vitae (CV) via email containing the following information:

  • All educational qualifications with marks/grades.
  • Detailed research experience and project involvement.
  • List of publications (peer-reviewed journals, conferences, books).
  • Complete contact address and phone number.
  • Email address.
  • Date of birth.
  • Any other relevant academic or professional certifications.

Selection Process

  • Application Screening: Applications will be reviewed for eligibility and qualifications.
  • Shortlisting: Eligible candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications, experience, and publications.
  • Shortlist Notification: Shortlisted candidates will be informed via email on 20-02-2026.
  • Online Interview: Shortlisted candidates will appear for an online interview on 24-02-2026 at 10:00 AM via Webex.
  • Interview Assessment: Selection will be based on the candidate's performance in the online interview.
  • Final Selection: Final selection will be communicated via email.

Important Note: No separate call letter will be sent. All communication will be through email.

Terms and Conditions

  • This is a contractual position for a research project.
  • The initial contract is for 11 months with a 3-month probation period.
  • Contract extension is possible based on performance review and project funding availability.
  • The position is based at IIT Guwahati campus, Assam.
  • The candidate may be required to participate in field research activities at various locations.
  • Flexibility in working hours and occasional fieldwork during weekends may be required.
  • IIT Guwahati reserves the right to cancel or modify the recruitment process if required.

Responsibilities and Duties

The Project Scientist II will be responsible for:

  • Conducting qualitative and quantitative research in human geography and environmental studies.
  • Designing and executing field research methodologies including interviews, FGDs, and participatory mapping.
  • Analyzing spatial data using GIS and Remote Sensing technologies.
  • Collecting and analyzing primary and secondary data related to water resources and peri-urban environments.
  • Writing academic manuscripts and preparing research reports.
  • Collaborating with community groups, government agencies, and local institutions.
  • Contributing to the dissemination of research findings through publications and presentations.
  • Assisting in data management and documentation.
  • Participating in multidisciplinary team meetings and collaborative discussions.
  • Any other duties assigned by the Principal Investigator or supervisory authority.

Instructions for Applicants

  • Read the notification carefully and understand all eligibility criteria before applying.
  • Ensure you meet all essential qualifications before submitting your application.
  • Prepare a comprehensive CV with all details as requested.
  • Use the exact project title when searching on the R&D portal.
  • Follow all instructions on the online application portal.
  • Submit the application well before the deadline to avoid any issues.
  • Ensure your email is correct and monitored regularly for communication from the institute.
  • Keep your login credentials safe after registering on the portal.
  • Do not miss the shortlist notification email on 20-02-2026.
  • Prepare well for the online interview on 24-02-2026.

Post Details – Senior Engineer (E-III) – Job Code US01

  • Job Focus: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) design and development
  • Posting: PDIC, Bharat Electronics Limited, Bengaluru
  • Type of Engagement: Permanent, full-time

BEL Senior Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

  • Full-time B.E / B.Tech in Aerospace or Aeronautical Engineering from AICTE approved college/institute or recognized university with minimum First Class.
  • OR full-time M.E / M.Tech in Aerospace or Aeronautical Engineering from AICTE approved college/institute or recognized university with minimum First Class.
  • Discipline/specialization mentioned in the degree certificate must match exactly with the prescribed discipline, otherwise candidature may be rejected.

Post-Qualification Experience (as on 01.02.2026)

  • For B.E/B.Tech candidates: Minimum 4 years of relevant post-qualification experience in industry or defence laboratories.
  • For M.E/M.Tech candidates: Minimum 2 years of relevant post-qualification experience in industry or defence laboratories.
  • Experience period is counted from the month following the final examination of the qualifying degree.

Essential Experience Areas

  • Design of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), including modelling, structural analysis and thermal analysis.
  • Design of UAV subsystems, prototyping and evaluation, and system engineering of aerial vehicles.
  • Design of composite and metal structures, including manufacturing processes and structural testing.
  • Design of control systems for aerial vehicles and thermal analysis of aerospace structures.
  • Experience in aero-modelling or hardware projects related to aerial platforms.
  • Schematic diagram generation, PCB design and testing.
  • Ability to interface with evolving product requirements and airframe design revisions.

Desirable Experience

  • End-to-end solution development starting from high-level system requirements to final product realization.
  • Planning design activities and delivering functionalities through multi-stage design and review processes.
  • Design document review, guidance system and autopilot design and analysis for aerial vehicles.
  • Knowledge of communication systems used in aerospace/UAV applications.
  • Programming experience in C/C++, Python, ROS, ML and AI.
  • Simulator development for terrain generation, mission simulation and path planning.

Age Limit (as on 01.02.2026)

  • Upper Age Limit: 32 years for General category.
  • SC candidates: Relaxation of 5 years (maximum age 37 years).
  • Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD): 10 years relaxation, plus applicable category-wise relaxation, for disability of minimum 40%.
  • Ex-Servicemen: Relaxation as per Government of India guidelines.
