Application fee is non-refundable. Candidates must pay through SBI Collect, either online or via SBI branch, and mention the SBI Collect reference number in the application form.

How to Pay Application Fee via SBI Collect

  • Visit www.onlinesbi.com and select “State Bank Collect”.
  • Accept the terms and conditions and click “Proceed”.
  • Select “All India” as State and choose “PSU – Public Sector Undertaking”.
  • Select “Bharat Electronics Limited” as the corporation/PSU.
  • Select payment category: “Senior Engineer (E-III) Post”.
  • Enter required details, complete payment and save/print the SBI Collect reference number and receipt.
  • Write the SBI Collect reference number in the relevant field of the application form and attach the payment receipt copy.

BEL Senior Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Selection Process

Step 1: Application Screening

  • Applications will be screened based on eligibility criteria, educational qualifications, experience and supporting documents.
  • All details filled in the application form must match exactly with the attached documents.
  • Incomplete applications or those without required enclosures are liable to be rejected without further notice.

Step 2: Written Test

  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for a Written Test at BEL, Bengaluru.
  • Passing marks in Written Test: 35% for General category, 30% for SC/PwBD candidates.
  • Weight of the written test will be considered for final selection alongside interview marks.

Step 3: Interview

  • Candidates will be shortlisted for interview in the ratio of 1:7 (category-wise) based on written test performance.
  • Interview will carry 15 marks with passing marks 35% for General and 30% for SC/PwBD candidates.
  • Interview will be conducted at BEL, Bengaluru, and outstation candidates will be reimbursed III Tier AC train fare as per rules.

Final Selection Criteria

  • Final merit list will be prepared category-wise combining Written Test and Interview scores.
  • List of candidates shortlisted for Written Test and Interview will be uploaded on BEL website only; no individual call letters by post.
  • Fulfilling minimum eligibility criteria does not guarantee selection or shortlisting for further stages.

Important Notes on Experience

  • Only relevant experience from industry or defence laboratories will be considered for eligibility and shortlisting.
  • Academic, teaching, apprenticeship, internship or purely research experience will not be counted as relevant experience.
  • Trainee, fixed-tenure, contractual or temporary engagements in BEL or other PSUs will not be treated as qualifying experience.
  • Experience without proper documentary proof (appointment letters, relieving letters, experience certificates, pay slips) may be rejected.
  • The decision of the BEL Selection Committee regarding experience relevance and calculation will be final and binding.

How to Apply for BEL Senior Engineer Recruitment 2026

  1. Download the application form: Visit the BEL careers section at https://bel-india.in/ and download the prescribed application format for Senior Engineer (E-III) – Job Code US01.
  2. Fill the form carefully: Enter personal details, educational qualifications, total experience, current employment, category and contact details neatly. Ensure all entries match your certificates.
  3. Pay the application fee: If applicable, pay the fee through SBI Collect under “Bharat Electronics Limited – Senior Engineer (E-III) Post”, then note the reference number and attach the payment receipt.
  4. Attach self-attested documents: Enclose photocopies of SSLC/Matriculation, PUC/12th/Diploma, degree marks cards, final degree certificate, CGPA conversion certificate (if any), experience certificates, appointment and relieving letters, latest pay slip, ID proof and category/disability certificates as applicable.
  5. Prepare detailed experience write-up: Attach a separate sheet describing your roles, responsibilities and experience relevant to UAV design, aerospace systems and other required skills.
  6. Prepare and superscribe the envelope: Place the filled form and all enclosures in an A4-size envelope and clearly superscribe: “Application for the post of Senior Engineer (Job Code No. US01)”.
  7. Send by Registered Post only: Dispatch the envelope through Indian Post (Registered Post) so that it reaches the below address on or before 24.02.2026; applications received after the cut-off date will be rejected.

Warning: Applications without fee (where applicable), incomplete information, missing documents, or not sent through Registered Post are liable to be summarily rejected without any further communication.

Bharat Electronics Limited

Important Instructions for BEL Senior Engineer Recruitment 2026

  • Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply for this recruitment.
  • Internal candidates of BEL are not eligible to apply for the advertised posts.
  • Candidates must be willing to travel extensively across India for project and customer-related work.
  • PSU/Government employees must produce a valid No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of interview.
  • Change of category (e.g., General to SC/OBC) once declared in the application will not be permitted at any stage.
  • PwBD candidates must submit a Disability Certificate in the prescribed format available on the BEL website.
  • All communications regarding written test, interview and results will be sent by e-mail; a valid and active e-mail ID is mandatory.
  • Candidates must disclose any past litigation with previous or current employers in the application form.
  • Canvassing in any manner will result in disqualification of the candidature.
  • Number of vacancies may increase or decrease depending on organisational requirements, and BEL reserves the right to cancel the recruitment wholly or partially.

RRB Group D Recruitment 2025 (CEN 09/2025) – Apply Online for 22,195 Posts

Advertisement

Railway Recruitment Board (RRB)  has released an official notification for the recruitment of 22195 Group D Posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply Online through the official RRB website. The last date to submit the application form is 02-03-2026. In this article, you’ll find the RRB Group D Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Online application form.

RRB Group D Recruitment CEN 09/2025 Overview

Organization Name Railway Recruitment Board (RRB), Ministry of Railways, Government of India
Post Name Various Posts in Level 1 of 7th CPC Pay Matrix (14 different posts across various departments)
Total Vacancies 22,195  Posts (across 16 Railway Zones)
Qualification 10th Pass or ITI or Equivalent or National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) from NCVT
Age Limit 18 to 33 years (as on 01.01.2026)
Application Fee General/EWS/OBC-NCL: Rs. 500/- (Rs. 400/- refundable), SC/ST/PwBD/Female/ExSM/Transgender/Minorities/EBC: Rs. 250/- (refundable on appearing in CBT)
Apply Start Date 31.01.2026 (00:00 Hrs)
Apply Last Date 02.03.2026 (23:59 Hrs)
Fee Payment Last Date 04.03.2026 (23:59 Hrs)
Apply Mode Online Only
Official Website www.indianrailways.gov.in, Official RRB websites (listed in notification)

RRB Group D CEN 09/2025 Post-wise Vacancy Details

Railway Zone-wise Distribution (Sample - Major Zones):

  • Western Railway (Mumbai): 3,166 posts
  • Northern Railway (Delhi): 3,537 posts
  • Central Railway (Mumbai): 2,157 posts
  • Eastern Railway (Kolkata): 1,078 posts
  • Other Zones: Remaining posts distributed across NFR, NER, SCR, SR, SWR, WCR, ECR, ECoR, SECR, NWR, NCR, SER

Note: Detailed Railway Zone-wise and post-wise vacancy table available in Annexure-B of the official notification. Vacancies are provisional and may increase or decrease.

Eligibility Criteria for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Educational Qualification (as on 02.03.2026):

  • 10th Pass (Matriculation/SSC/SSLC) from recognized Board, OR
  • ITI (Industrial Training Institute) certificate from recognized institute, OR
  • Equivalent qualification, OR
  • National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) granted by National Council for Vocational Training (NCVT)
  • Important: Candidates waiting for final results are NOT eligible to apply
  • Diploma/Degree in Engineering will NOT be accepted in lieu of ITI/Course Completed Act Apprenticeship

Medical Standards:

Medical Standard Distant Vision Near Vision
A-2 (e.g., Pointsman B) 6/9, 6/9 without glasses (no fogging test) Sn. 0.6, 0.6 without glasses
A-3 (e.g., Assistant Track Machine) 6/9, 6/9 with/without glasses (power ≤ 2D) Sn. 0.6, 0.6 with/without glasses
B-1 (Most posts) 6/9, 6/12 with/without glasses (power ≤ 4D) Sn. 0.6, 0.6 with/without glasses
C-1 6/12, 6/18 with/without glasses Sn. 0.6, 0.6 with/without glasses

Important Medical Notes:

  • Candidates must ensure they are medically fit as per Indian Railway Medical Manual (IRMM) Vol. I Chapter 5
  • LASIK surgery candidates NOT eligible for A2 & A3 medical standard posts (must submit declaration as per Annexure-VII)
  • Different medical standards for Ex-Servicemen (Para 534 of IRMM)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Age Limit for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025 (as on 01.01.2026)

General Age Limits:

  • Minimum Age: 18 years (Born on or before 01.01.2008)
  • Maximum Age: 33 years for UR & EWS (Born on or after 02.01.1993)
  • Maximum Age: 36 years for OBC-NCL (Born on or after 02.01.1990)
  • Maximum Age: 38 years for SC/ST (Born on or after 02.01.1988)

Age Relaxation:

Category Age Relaxation
OBC-Non Creamy Layer (NCL) 3 years
SC/ST 5 years

Ex-Servicemen (UR & EWS) 3 years (after deducting military service)
Ex-Servicemen (OBC-NCL) 6 years (after deducting military service)

Group C/D Railway Staff (3+ years service) - UR/EWS Up to 40 years
Group C/D Railway Staff (3+ years service) - OBC-NCL Up to 43 years
Group C/D Railway Staff (3+ years service) - SC/ST Up to 45 years
Female candidates (widowed/divorced/judicially separated) - UR Up to 35 years
Female candidates (widowed/divorced/judicially separated) - OBC-NCL Up to 38 years
Female candidates (widowed/divorced/judicially separated) - SC/ST Up to 40 years

CCAA - OBC-NCL Maximum 6 years (including category relaxation)
CCAA - SC/ST Maximum 8 years (including category relaxation)
Act Apprentices who commenced before age 25 - UR/EWS Up to 35 years
Act Apprentices who commenced before age 25 - OBC-NCL Up to 38 years
Act Apprentices who commenced before age 25 - SC/ST Up to 40 years

Important Notes:

  • If eligible for multiple relaxations, maximum relaxation will be given (NOT cumulative)
  • SC/ST/OBC-NCL applying against UR vacancies: No age relaxation
  • PwBD applying against UR vacancies: PwBD age relaxation applicable
  • Maximum upper age limit (except Ex-Servicemen): 52 years
  • Matriculation certificate is the ONLY acceptable proof of age

Application Fee for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Category Fee Amount Refund
General, EWS, OBC-NCL (Male candidates not covered in Sl. 2) Rs. 500/- Rs. 400/- (after deducting bank charges) - on appearing in CBT
SC, ST, Ex-Servicemen, PwBD, Female, Transgender, Minorities, Economically Backward Class (EBC) Rs. 250/- Full Rs. 250/- (after deducting bank charges) - on appearing in CBT

Payment Mode: Online only through Internet Banking, Debit/Credit Card, or UPI (all service charges borne by candidate)

Payment Deadline: 04.03.2026 up to 23:59 Hrs

Important Notes on Fee:

  • Fee refund (minus bank charges) will be credited ONLY to Aadhaar-seeded bank account
  • No refund for incomplete/rejected applications or candidates not appearing in CBT
  • Applications without prescribed fee will be summarily rejected
  • Minorities: Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Jains, Zoroastrians (Parsis) - must submit affidavit at DV
  • EBC: Family income < Rs. 50,000/- per annum (valid EBC certificate/BPL card/Izzat MST required)
  • Note: EBC, EWS, and OBC are three DIFFERENT categories. EBC eligible for fee concession only (NOT job reservation)

Important Dates for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Event Date & Time
Indicative Notice in Employment News 27.12.2025
Online Application Start Date 31.01.2026 (00:00 Hrs)
Online Application Closing Date 02.03.2026 (23:59 Hrs)
Fee Payment Last Date 04.03.2026 (23:59 Hrs)
Application Modification Window (with Rs. 250/- fee) 05.03.2026 to 14.03.2026 (23:59 Hrs)
Scribe Details Entry Window (for eligible PwBD candidates) 15.03.2026 to 19.03.2026
Computer Based Test (CBT) - Tentative Will be notified on RRB websites
Physical Efficiency Test (PET) Will be notified on RRC websites
Document Verification (DV) Will be notified on RRC websites
Medical Examination (ME) Will be notified on RRC websites

Selection Process for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

The recruitment consists of 4 successive stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Test (CBT)

Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for candidates using scribe)

Total Questions: 100 (Each of 1 mark)

Subject Number of Questions
General Science 25
Mathematics 25
General Intelligence and Reasoning 30
General Awareness and Current Affairs 20
TOTAL 100 Questions = 100 Marks

Exam Pattern:

  • Objective type with multiple choices
  • Questions available in English, Hindi, and 13 regional languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu)
  • Negative Marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer
  • Section-wise distribution may vary slightly in actual exam

Minimum Qualifying Marks:

  • UR: 40%
  • EWS: 40%
  • OBC-NCL: 30%
  • SC: 30%
  • ST: 30%
  • PwBD: May be relaxed by 2 marks in case of shortage

Syllabus (Indicative):

  • Mathematics: Number system, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Mensuration, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Simple & Compound Interest, Profit & Loss, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics, Square root, Age Calculations, Calendar & Clock, Pipes & Cistern
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding & Decoding, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Conclusions & Decision making, Similarities & Differences, Analytical Reasoning, Classification, Directions, Statement-Arguments & Assumptions
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences of 10th standard level (CBSE)
  • General Awareness & Current Affairs: Science & Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Politics, and other important subjects

Normalization: Marks will be normalized if CBT conducted in multiple sessions

Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

Shortlisting: 3 times the total vacancies (may vary) based on CBT merit

Nature: Qualifying (Mandatory to pass - marks not counted for final merit)

Candidate Type Test 1: Weight Carrying Test 2: Running
Male Candidates Lift and carry 35 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 4 minutes 15 seconds (in one chance)
Female Candidates Lift and carry 20 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 5 minutes 40 seconds (in one chance)
Transgender Candidates Same relaxed standards as Female candidates

Important PET Notes:

  • Two-stage test: First weight carrying, then running (after recovery gap)
  • Failing in weight carrying means elimination (no running test)
  • Weight carrying involves lifting sandbag (without handle) from waist-height bench and carrying without dropping
  • Candidates' responsibility to ensure medical fitness for PET - Railways not responsible for injuries
  • Exemptions from PET:
    • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - must pass medical examination
    • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA)
    • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Pregnant Candidates: Must submit self-declaration. If pregnant, PET deferred till 6 weeks post-confinement. Vacancy kept reserved.

Stage 3: Document Verification (DV)

  • Shortlisting: 1:1 ratio of vacancies based on CBT merit + PET qualification
  • Candidates must produce original certificates
  • No additional time given - absence leads to candidature cancellation
  • Scanned copies to be uploaded before DV at https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv
  • Certificates must be in English/Hindi (translated version required otherwise)
  • Hard copy of signed application form to be brought

Stage 4: Medical Examination (ME)

  • Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities
  • Must pass requisite medical fitness test as per IRMM
  • Visual acuity standards strictly enforced
  • Medical appeal option available (one final opportunity on payment)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Final Merit & Selection

  • Based on CBT marks (after normalization if applicable)
  • Subject to PET qualification, DV clearance, and medical fitness
  • Post/Railway allotment as per candidate's preference, merit, medical fitness, and vacancy
  • In case of tie: Older candidate ranked higher; if age also same, alphabetical order of name (A to Z)
  • No right to appointment - RRB/RRC only recommends; appointment by Railway Administration

Reservation & Relaxation for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Vertical Reservation (Community-wise):

  • SC (Scheduled Caste)
  • ST (Scheduled Tribe)
  • OBC-NCL (Other Backward Classes - Non Creamy Layer)
  • EWS (Economically Weaker Sections)

Horizontal Reservation (across all communities):

  • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA) trained in Railway Establishments
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD)

Important Reservation Rules:

For OBC-NCL Candidates:

  • Must produce OBC-NCL certificate issued on or after 01.04.2025 but not later than 02.03.2026
  • Certificate must be as per central list (http://www.ncbc.nic.in)
  • Must submit self-declaration (Annexure IIA) at DV that they don't belong to Creamy Layer
  • Certificate must mention: "Does NOT belong to Creamy Layer as per DOPT OM 36012/22/93-Estt.(SCT) dated 08.09.93, modified vide OM 36033/1/2013-Estt.(Res.) dated 13.09.2017"
  • OBC in state list but not in central list: NOT eligible for reservation

For EWS Candidates:

  • NOT covered under SC/ST/OBC-NCL
  • Gross annual family income < Rs. 8 lakh for F.Y. 2024-25
  • Family should NOT own:
    • 5 acres or more of agricultural land, OR
    • Residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. or more, OR
    • Residential plot of 100 sq. yards or more (notified municipalities), OR
    • Residential plot of 200 sq. yards or more (other areas)
  • Family: Applicant, parents, siblings <18 years, spouse, children <18 years
  • Must possess valid Income & Asset Certificate (Annexure III) based on F.Y. 2024-25 income/assets

For PwBD Candidates:

  • Minimum 40% benchmark disability required for reservation/relaxation
  • Certificate as per Form V/VI of RPwD Rules 2024 (Annexure V-A/V-B)
  • Must submit Unique Disability Identity (UDID)
  • Suitability for posts indicated in Annexure-A
  • Eligible Disabilities:
    • VI (Visually Impaired): Blindness (B), Low Vision (LV)
    • HI (Hearing Impaired): Deaf (D), Hard of Hearing (HH)
    • LD (Locomotor Disability): OA, OL, OAL, BL, LC, DW, AAV, CP, SD (without neurological/limb dysfunction), SI (without neurological/limb dysfunction)
    • MD (Multiple Disabilities)
  • Temporary disability candidates NOT eligible for reservation (as per DePwD OM dated 17.12.2025)

For Ex-Servicemen (ExSM):

  • Must have valid Ex-Serviceman Certificate from Zila Sainik Board
  • Serving defense personnel expected to be released within 1 year can also apply
  • Must submit NOC with probable discharge date (Annexure VI-A) at DV
  • Declaration/Undertaking (Annexure VI) required at DV
  • ExSM who already secured civil employment using ExSM quota: NOT eligible for ExSM reservation (only age relaxation available)
  • Different medical standards applicable (Para 534 of IRMM)

For CCAA (Railway Establishments):

  • Must have completed Act Apprenticeship by 02.03.2026 (appeared in NCVT exam)
  • National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) from NCVT required at DV
  • Weightage: 1/3rd marks from NCVT examination added to CBT marks for merit
  • If NCVT weightage gives lower score, higher of the two will be considered
  • Exempted from PET
  • Can apply to any RRB (not just training Railway)

General Instructions for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Application Rules:

  • ONE application per candidate - Multiple applications will lead to rejection of ALL applications and debarment from future RRB/RRC exams
  • Choose only ONE RRB/Railway Zone (cannot be changed later)
  • Indicate post preferences within chosen Railway Zone
  • Partial options allowed (will be considered only for opted posts)
  • No change in preferences after submission
  • Online application only through official RRB websites (listed in Para 24.0)

Identity Authentication:

  • Strongly advised to authenticate using DigiLocker or Aadhaar during account creation
  • Aadhaar-seeded bank account mandatory for fee refund
  • Candidates using alternate Photo IDs will face stricter scrutiny at all stages

Account Creation:

  • If already created account for CEN 2024/2025, use same credentials
  • Valid mobile number and email ID mandatory (will remain unchanged throughout recruitment)
  • Details in 'Create an Account' form CANNOT be modified

Application Modification:

  • Allowed from 05.03.2026 to 14.03.2026
  • Fee: Rs. 250/- per modification (non-refundable)
  • Can modify any number of times (except 'Create Account' details and Chosen Railway)
  • If changing from SC/ST to UR/OBC/EWS or from ExSM/Female/PwBD to non-reserved: Pay fee difference (Rs. 250/-) in addition to modification fee
  • No modifications entertained after 14.03.2026

Live Photo & Signature Upload:

  • Live Photo: Captured during application (NOT pre-existing photo)
  • Stand/sit in front of camera at eye level, face centered, neutral expression
  • Non-white clothing (preferably dark colors), no cap/mask/glasses
  • Applications with blurred/non-compliant photos liable for rejection
  • Signature: Running handwriting in black ink on white paper (scanned)
  • NO BLOCK/CAPITAL/DISJOINTED LETTERS
  • JPG/JPEG format, 30-49 KB, 140×60 pixels minimum
  • Signature must match at all stages (CBT/DV/ME/Appointment)

Scribe Facility (for eligible PwBD candidates):

  • Eligible: Blindness, Locomotor Disability (Both Arms - BA), Cerebral Palsy
  • Others: Only with certificate from CMO/Civil Surgeon (Annexure V-G)
  • PwBD <40% with writing difficulty: Certificate as per Annexure V-E required
  • Scribe must register at rrbapply.gov.in (One-Time Registration - OTR)
  • Candidate must enter scribe's OTR number during 15.03.2026 to 19.03.2026 window
  • Scribe qualification: ONE step below candidate's qualification
  • One scribe per candidate; scribe cannot be a candidate in same CEN
  • Compensatory time: 20 minutes per hour of examination

Examination Centers:

  • Allocated based on technical/logistical feasibility
  • Candidates may have to travel to other cities/states
  • No change of center/date/shift allowed

Banned Items at Exam Center:

  • Mobile phones, pagers, watches, earphones, Bluetooth devices, microphones, health bands
  • Calculators, books, pen, paper, pencil, eraser, pouch, scale, writing pad
  • Belts, handbags, caps, purses, cameras, water bottles, food items
  • ONLY e-call letter allowed inside test center
  • Pen will be provided during exam
  • No cloak room - advised not to bring valuables
  • Do not apply henna on hands/feet (obstructs biometric capture)

Important Warnings:

  • Debarment for life if found using unfair means, impersonation, forgery, misbehavior
  • Provisions of "The Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024" applicable
  • Comprehensive post-exam analysis (log analysis, photo/biometric verification, CCTV review)
  • Beware of touts and fake websites - RRBs NEVER appoint agents/coaching centers
  • Selection purely on merit

How to Apply for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Step 1: Create an Account (if not already created)

  • Visit official RRB website from the list at Para 24.0
  • Click on "Create an Account" link
  • Authenticate using DigiLocker/Aadhaar (strongly recommended)
  • Enter valid mobile number and email ID (CANNOT be changed later)
  • Complete OTP verification
  • Create login credentials

Step 2: Fill Online Application

  • Login with created credentials
  • Select CEN 09/2025
  • Choose ONE RRB/Railway Zone (CANNOT be changed)
  • Fill personal details, educational qualifications
  • Select post preferences within chosen Railway
  • Choose examination language (English/Hindi/Regional)
  • Capture live photograph using webcam/mobile camera
  • Upload scanned signature (JPG/JPEG, 30-49 KB, black ink, running handwriting)
  • Upload SC/ST certificate (if claiming free travel pass)
  • Indicate scribe requirement (if applicable)
  • Verify all details carefully

Step 3: Pay Application Fee

  • Select payment mode: Internet Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI
  • Pay Rs. 500/- (General/EWS/OBC-NCL Male) or Rs. 250/- (SC/ST/PwBD/Female/ExSM/Transgender/Minorities/EBC)
  • Complete payment (all service charges borne by candidate)
  • Save payment receipt

Step 4: Final Submission

  • After successful payment, application will be accepted
  • Receive confirmation via SMS and email
  • Download and save final application form
  • Note Application Number for future reference

Step 5: Modification (if required)

  • Window: 05.03.2026 to 14.03.2026
  • Login and modify details (except Create Account info & Chosen Railway)
  • Pay Rs. 250/- per modification
  • Pay additional fee if changing from reserved to unreserved category

Step 6: Enter Scribe Details (if applicable)

  • Window: 15.03.2026 to 19.03.2026
  • Login to application portal
  • Enter scribe's OTR number
  • Enter OTP sent to scribe's mobile to confirm

Documents to Upload:

  1. Live photograph (captured during application)
  2. Signature (scanned - JPG/JPEG, 30-49 KB, running handwriting)
  3. SC/ST certificate (PDF, <400 KB) - if claiming free travel pass

Documents Required at DV (Original + 2 self-attested photocopies):

  • 10th/Matriculation certificate (for age & education)
  • ITI/NAC certificate (if applicable)
  • SC/ST certificate (Annexure-I)
  • OBC-NCL certificate (Annexure-II) - issued on/after 01.04.2025
  • OBC-NCL self-declaration (Annexure-II A)
  • EWS certificate (Annexure-III) - valid for 2025-26, based on F.Y. 2024-25
  • EBC certificate (Annexure-III A) / BPL card / Izzat MST (if claimed fee concession)
  • Minority affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper (Annexure-IV)
  • PwBD certificate (Annexure V-A/V-B) with UDID
  • ExSM certificate from Zila Sainik Board
  • ExSM declaration (Annexure VI)
  • ExSM NOC with probable discharge date (Annexure VI-A) - if serving
  • CCAA - NAC certificate from NCVT
  • LASIK declaration (Annexure-VII) - for A2/A3 posts
  • NOC from employer (if Govt. employee)
  • Caste change certificates (if name differs from 10th certificate)
  • Medical certificates (for scribe eligibility - Annexure V-E/V-F/V-G)

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualifications (Any ONE)

Option 1: 12th Pass with DOEACC A Level Course

Required Experience

Preferred Experience

Nature of Employment

  • Department: Endocrinology, PGIMER Chandigarh.
  • Principal Investigator: Dr. Sanjay Kumar Bhadada, Professor & Head of Department.
  • The ICMR Young Diabetes Registry is a multi-centre research initiative to understand diabetes prevalence, risk factors and outcomes in young population in India.
  • Phase-III focuses on longitudinal follow-up and data collection from registered participants.

Role of Data Entry Operator

  • Data entry of research participant information into designated databases.
  • Maintenance and regular updating of project database.
  • Ensuring accuracy and quality of entered data.

Naval Air Operations Officer (Observers) 20 Men and Women (maximum of 03 vacancies for women)
Air Traffic Controller (ATC) 18 Men and Women
Logistics 10 Men and Women (maximum of 01 vacancies for women)
Education 07 Men and Women
Engineering Branch (General Service (GS)) 42 Men and Women (maximum of 07 vacancies for women)
Submarine Tech Engineering 08 Only for Men
Electrical Branch (General Service (GS)) 38 Men and Women (maximum of 07 vacancies for women)
Submarine Tech Electrical 08 Only for Men

Eligibility Criteria

  • Executive Branch (GS(X)/ Hydro Cadre): BE/ B.Tech in any discipline with minimum 60% marks.
  • Pilot: BE/ B.Tech in any discipline with minimum 60% marks. (Candidate must have 60% aggregate marks in class X and XII and minimum 60% marks in English in class X or class XII).
  • Naval Air Operations Officer (Observers): BE/ B.Tech in any discipline with minimum 60% marks. (Candidate must have 60% aggregate marks in class X and XII and minimum 60% marks in English in class X or class XII).
  • Air Traffic Controller (ATC): BE/ B.Tech in any discipline with minimum 60% marks. (Candidate must have 60% aggregate marks in class X and XII and minimum 60% marks in English in class X or class XII).
  • Logistics: BE/ B.Tech in any discipline with First Class or MBA with First Class, or B.Sc/ B.Com/ B.Sc.(H) with First class along with PG Diploma in Finance / Logistics / Supply Chain Management / Material Management or MCA/ M.Sc.(H) with First Class.
  • Education: MSc/MA with minimum 60% marks in Maths/ Operational Research (with Physics in BSc) or MSc/MA with minimum 60% marks in Physics/ Applied Physics (with Maths in BSc)/ Meteorology/ Oceanography/ Atmospheric Sciences (with Physics and Maths in BSc) or BE/ B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in Mechanical/ Production Engineering or BE/ B.Tech/ M.Tech with minimum 60% marks in Computer Science Engineering/ MCA (with either Physics or Mathematics in graduation level) or BE/ B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in Electrical/ Electronics and Communication/ Electronics and Instrumentation or ME/ M.Tech with minimum 60% marks in Electronics & Communication/ Controls/ Radar and Microwave/ Optical Fibre Communication/ Digital Signal Processing/ Wireless Communication/ Laser and Electro Optics/ VLSI/ Power Systems/ Communications Systems/ Electronics & Instrumentation or ME/ M.Tech with minimum 60% marks in Thermal/ Production Engineering/ Machine Design/ System and Controls/ Manufacturing/ Mechatronics/ Meteorology/ Oceanography/ Atmospheric Sciences (with Physics and Maths at graduation level). Candidates applying for the Education entry must have scored minimum of 60% marks in class X or class XII.
  • Engineering Branch (General Service (GS)): BE/ B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in the following streams :- Marine Engineering, Aero Space Engineering, Metallurgy Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Automobiles Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering.
  • Submarine Tech Engineering: BE/ B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in the following streams :- Production Engineering, Control Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, Industrial Engineering & Management, Instrumentation & Control, Mechanical/Mechanical with Automation.
  • Electrical Branch (General Service (GS)): BE/ B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in the following streams :- Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, Power Electronics, Electronics Engineering, Tele Communication, Power Engineering.
  • Submarine Tech Electrical: BE/ B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in the following streams :- Electrical & Electronics, Electronics & Tele Communication, Applied Electronics and Communication (AEC).

Salary/Stipend

  • The initial gross salary of Sub Lieutenant starts from Rs 1,25,000/- (approximately) per month alongwith other allowances as applicable.
  • Pilot/ NAOO allowance of Rs 31,250/- will be admissible to candidates post successful completion of training.
  • Submarine allowance of Rs 31,250/- will be admissible to candidates post successful completion of training.
  • Submarine allowance will be admissible to candidates post successful completion of submarine training in accordance with extant rules.

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2027)

  • Executive Branch (GS(X)/ Hydro Cadre): Born Between 02 Jan 2002 to 01 Jul 2007
  • Pilot: Born Between 02 Jan 2003 to 01 Jan 2008
  • Naval Air Operations Officer (Observers): Born Between 02 Jan 2003 to 01 Jan 2008
  • Air Traffic Controller (ATC): Born Between 02 Jan 2002 to 01 Jan 2006
  • Logistics: Born Between 02 Jan 2002 to 01 Jun 2007
  • Education: Born Between 02 Jan 2002 to 01 Jan 2006
  • Engineering Branch (General Service (GS)): Born Between 02 Jan 2002 to 01 Jul 2007
  • Electrical Branch (General Service (GS)): Born Between 02 Jan 2002 to 01 Jul 2007

Important Dates

Event Date
Apply Online from 24 Jan 2026
Last date for Online Application 24 Feb 2026
Course commencing Jan 2027
Inform final result to Indian Navy prior 20 Dec 2026

Selection Process

  • Shortlisting of application will be based on normalised marks obtained by the candidates in the qualifying degree. Marks obtained by the candidates in the qualifying degree will be normalised using formulae mentioned in Join Indian Navy website (URL: - https://www.joinindiannavy.gov.in/files/normalisation.pdf)
  • BE/ B.Tech. For candidates who have completed or are in final year of BE/ B.Tech, marks obtained upto fifth semester will be considered for SSB shortlisting.
  • Post-Graduate Degree Programme. For candidates who have completed MSc, MCA, MBA, M.Tech, marks obtained in all semesters will be considered. For candidates who are in final year, shortlisting will be based on pre-final year performance.
  • Candidates selected in the final merit list will be required to submit the proof of completing the qualifying degree with minimum 60% marks by sending an email at the address [email protected]. Candidates failing to meet the criteria will not be permitted to join the Academy.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be informed about their selection for SSB interview through e-mail or SMS (provided by candidates in their application form). Candidates are advised not to change their e-mail/ mobile number till selection process is over and check their inbox and spam folder periodically.
  • Change of SSB Centre for interview is not permissible under any circumstances.
  • Any correspondence regarding change of SSB dates be addressed to the call up officer of the concerned SSB on receipt of call up letter. Candidates are to download the call up letter on receiving intimation from Naval Headquarters through SMS/ email (provided by candidates in their application).
  • No compensation is admissible in case of any injury sustained as a result of tests during SSB interviews.
  • AC 3 tier rail fare is admissible for the SSB interview, if appearing for the first time for particular type of commission. Candidates are required to bring photocopy of the first page of pass book or cheque leaf where the name, A/C No. & IFSC details are mentioned, while appearing for SSB.
  • Details of SSB procedure are available on Indian Navy website www.joinindiannavy.gov.in
  • Merit list will be prepared based on SSB marks for all entries as per availability of vacancies and medical clearance for respective entry. Candidates declared fit in medical examination would be appointed as per availability of vacancies in the entry.

General Information/Instructions

  • Vacancies mentioned in para 2 are tentative and may be changed depending on availability of training slots.
  • Only one application can be filled by a candidate. In case of multiple applications, candidature will be cancelled.
  • Male Candidates shortlisted for GS(X) are also eligible to volunteer for submarine arm subject to medical fitness, vacancies and service requirements. Candidates exercising option for this branch will have to additionally indicate option for submarine specialisation while filling the online application form.
  • Eventual selection/ nomination to undergo submarine specialisation will be subject to clearing submarine medicals (after joining INA) and service requirements.
  • Submarine allowance will be admissible to candidates post successful completion of submarine training in accordance with extant rules.
  • Candidates selected under GS(X) may be nominated to undergo specialisation in RPA (after completion of training at INA), subject to medical fitness and service requirements.
  • Candidates having Government of India, Ministry of Shipping & Transport Certificate of Competency (Foreign going) either as a Second Mate, Mate or Master and born between 02 Jan 1997 to 01 Jul 2007 (both dates inclusive) can apply for Executive Branch entry (General Service) as per stipulations stated at Para 2(1).
  • Candidates having Government of India, Ministry of Shipping & Transport Certificate of Competency as 1st class Engineer and born between 02 Jan 1997 to 01 Jul 2007 (both dates inclusive) can apply for Technical Branch entry (SSC Engineering) as per stipulations stated at Para 2(7) and 2(8).
  • Candidates having valid CPL issued by DGCA (India) and born between 02 Jan 2002 to 01 Jan 2008 (both dates inclusive) can apply for Pilot entry as per eligibility criteria stated at Para 2(2).
  • NCC 'C' certificate holders will be given relaxation of 5% in cut off marks towards shortlisting for SSB subject to meeting following criteria: Having NCC 'C' certificate of Naval/Army/Air Wing with minimum 'B' Grade. Not served less than two academic years in the Senior Division, Naval/Army/Air Wing of the NCC. 'C' certificate should not be dated prior to 01 Jan 2024.
  • The final selection will be subject to verification of the certificate by DG(NCC) concerned NCC unit for its validity. Candidature of individual will be cancelled at any stage of selection/ training/ post-commissioning, in case of false declaration, misinformation or concealing of information.
  • The candidate will be required to fulfil the educational qualification stipulated above before joining INA, Ezhimala by Jan 2027.
  • The candidate failing to meet stipulated educational criteria will not be permitted to join INA, Ezhimala.
  • All SSB recommended candidates would be required to inform their final result of respective degree to Indian Navy at the email ID [email protected] prior 20 Dec 2026.
  • Specified number of candidates based on service requirement, who have chosen SSC (Pilot) entry will be considered for SSB/ CPSS/ Aviation Medical Examination and are advised to check physical/ medical standards (Height, leg length etc) for this entry prior selecting this option. Remaining candidates will be considered for other preferences opted by them.
  • Candidates must indicate their preference for other branches/ cadres also, if they wish to be considered for those branches/ cadres.
  • Candidates will not be considered for branches/ cadres that they have not selected.
  • Candidates are advised to ascertain their eligibility for branches/ cadres, with respect to applicable medical standards, prior to indicating their preference.
  • No equivalent stream of BE/ B.Tech qualifications other than those mentioned in para 2(5), 2(6), 2(7), 2(8), 2(9) and 2(10) above, will be considered valid for selection process at any stage.
  • Candidates will be denied to appear SSB if any backlog in any subject is pending at the time of document verification at SSB centers.
  • Medical standards/ Relaxation in Height and Weight/ Tattoo. Please visit website www.joinindiannavy.gov.in for information. SSB recommended candidates are required to undergo medical examination as applicable to their entry. Change of medical hospital/ centre is not permissible under any circumstances.
  • Selected candidates will be granted Short Service Commission initially for 12 years extendable by maximum 02 years, subject to service requirement, performance, medical eligibility and willingness of candidates
  • Candidates will be inducted in the rank of Sub Lieutenant subject to clearing of induction medical examination at INA, Ezhimala post reporting.
  • Only unmarried candidates are eligible for training. Any candidate who is found to be married or marries while under training will be discharged from service and shall be liable to refund full pay and allowances drawn by him/ her and other expenditure incurred on the candidate by the Government.
  • If the officer voluntarily withdraws from initial training or resigns during the probationary period, he/ she shall be required to refund the cost of training in whole or in part, as may be determined by Govt and all money received by him/ her as pay and allowances from the Govt together with the interest on the said money calculated at the rate in force for Govt loans.
  • Probation period for all branches/cadres is two years. The probation period will commence from the date of grant of the rank of Sub Lieutenant and will terminate after two years or on completion of initial training (whichever is later). During probation the officers are liable to be discharged in case of unsatisfactory performance at any stage.
  • All officers/ cadets would be compulsorily members of the Naval Group Insurance Scheme (NGIS) as received and approved for insurance cover on contribution basis. The cover would be applicable whilst in service and post retirement as per extant regulations.
  • Mere inclusion of candidates in the Select List/Merit list does not confer upon them a vested right to appointment.
  • Candidates may also note that mere empanelment is under no circumstances be treated as final selection and is not an enforceable claim to the post applied for.
  • All vacancies are to be filled as per service requirement and as per statutory guidelines issued in this regard from time to time.
  • Please read the instructions given on the website carefully before finally submitting your online application.
  • Your candidature will be cancelled if any declaration is found wrong at any stage of selection.
  • Use/ possession of narcotics is banned. Candidate may be tested for presence of drugs in the body during SSB selection/ medical/ training and subsequently during service. If candidate is found to be using/ in-possession of narcotics during any time of selection/ medical/ training/ service, candidate would be debarred from joining the Indian Navy or be removed from service if already joined.
  • Your application is subject to subsequent scrutiny and the application can be rejected, if found INELIGIBLE/ INVALID at any point of time.

How to Apply

  • Candidates are to register and fill application on Indian Navy website www.joinindiannavy.gov.in. To save time during the application submission window, candidates can fill in their details and upload documents in advance.
  • Whilst filling up the e-application, it is advisable to keep the relevant documents readily available to enable the following: Correct filling up of personal particulars. Details are to be filled up as given in the Matriculation Certificate. Fields such as e-mail address, mobile number are mandatory fields and need to be filled.
  • All relevant documents (preferably in original), marks sheets upto 5th & 7th semester for regular and integrated BE/ B.Tech courses respectively and all semesters for other degree examination, date of birth proof (as per 10th & 12th certificate), CGPA conversion formula for BE/ B.Tech, Merchant Navy certificate issued by Government of India, Ministry of Shipping and Transport, NCC 'C' certificate issued by National Cadet Corps and a recent passport size colour photograph should be scanned in original JPG/TIFF format, for attaching the same while filling up the application.
  • If any scanned document is not legible/readable for any reason, the application will be rejected. Candidates are to take print out of application and carry it while appearing for SSB interview.
  • The application once submitted will be final and no request for amendments/change will be entertained.

Cochin Shipyard (CSL)  has released an official notification for the recruitment of 260 Fabrication Assistants, Outfit Assistants Posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply Online through the official CSL website. The last date to submit the application form is 16-02-2026. In this article, you’ll find the CSL Fabrication Assistants, Outfit Assistants Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Online application form.

CSL Fabrication Assistants, Outfit Assistants Recruitment 2026 Overview

Advertisement

CSL Fabrication Assistants, Outfit Assistants Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

A. Fabrication Assistants on Contract

Post Name & Trade Total
Sheet Metal Worker 64
Welder 49
Sub Total (A) 113

B. Outfit Assistants on Contract

Post Name & Trade Total
Fitter 39

Grand Total (A+B) 260

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification and Experience for Fabrication Assistants

  • Sheet Metal Worker:
    • Qualification: Pass in SSLC and ITI – NTC (National Trade Certificate) in the trade of Sheet Metal Worker
    • Experience: Minimum of three years post qualification experience/training in fabrication, i.e. cutting, fit up and welding process
  • Welder:
    • Qualification: Pass in SSLC and ITI – NTC (National Trade Certificate) in the trade of Welder/Welder (Gas & Electric)
    • Experience: Minimum of three years post qualification experience/training in the relevant trade

Educational Qualification and Experience for Outfit Assistants

  • Fitter: Pass in SSLC and ITI – NTC in the trade of Fitter with minimum of three years post qualification experience/training in the relevant trade
  • Electrician: Pass in SSLC and ITI – NTC in the trade of Electrician with minimum of three years post qualification experience/training in the relevant trade
  • Mechanic Diesel: Pass in SSLC and ITI – NTC in the trade of Mechanic Diesel with minimum of three years post qualification experience/training in the relevant trade
  • Mechanic Motor Vehicle: Pass in SSLC and ITI – NTC in the trade of Mechanic Motor Vehicle with minimum of three years post qualification experience/training in the relevant trade
  • Electronic Mechanic: Pass in SSLC and ITI – NTC in the trade of Electronic Mechanic with minimum of three years post qualification experience/training in the relevant trade
  • Painter: Pass in SSLC and ITI – NTC in the trade of Painter with minimum of three years post qualification experience/training in the relevant trade
  • Machinist: Pass in SSLC and ITI – NTC in the trade of Machinist with minimum of three years post qualification experience/training in the relevant trade
  • Crane Operator: Pass in SSLC and ITI-NTC in the trade of Electrician or Electronic Mechanic or Instrument Mechanic with minimum of three years post qualification experience/training in operation of cranes (Electrical)
  • Instrument Mechanic: Pass in SSLC and ITI – NTC in the trade of Instrument Mechanic with minimum of three years post qualification experience/training in the relevant trade
  • Plumber: Pass in SSLC and ITI – NTC in the trade of Plumber with minimum of three years post qualification experience/training in the relevant trade
  • Shipwright Wood: Pass in SSLC and ITI – NTC in the trade of Shipwright Wood or Carpenter with minimum of three years post qualification experience/training in the relevant trade

Important Points on Experience

  • Experience acquired after the date of passing of the qualification stipulated as per the above requirements shall only be considered
  • Period of post qualification experience shall be reckoned as on 07 February 2026
  • The period of completed Apprenticeship Training in the relevant trade under the Apprentices Act 1961 and any training with remuneration shall be treated as experience for the purpose of meeting eligibility requirements for the posts
  • However, such training shall not be considered as experience for fixation of the consolidated remuneration per month

Salary/Stipend

  • Basic Consolidated Pay: Rs. 23,300/- per month for candidates meeting the minimum experience requirement (i.e. 3 years)
  • Additional Compensation: Eligible for compensation for extra hours of work up to Rs. 5,830/- per month
  • Total Maximum Remuneration: Up to Rs. 29,130/- per month (Rs. 23,300 + Rs. 5,830)
  • Higher Pay Provision: For completed year of on roll experience in CSL or other similar Shipyards, over and above the minimum required experience, higher pay may be offered to the candidates

Age Limit (as on 07.02.2026)

  • Maximum Age Limit: Shall not exceed 45 years as on 07 February 2026, i.e. applicants should be born on or after 08 February 1981
  • Age Relaxation for OBC (Non Creamy Layer): 3 years relaxation in posts reserved for them
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST: 5 years relaxation in posts reserved for them
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD & Ex-servicemen: As per Government of India guidelines subject to a maximum age of 50 years

Application Fee

Category Fee Amount
General/OBC/EWS Candidates Rs. 300/- (Non refundable, plus bank charges extra)
SC/ST/PwBD Candidates NIL (Exempted from payment)
  • Application fee should be remitted using the Online payment options (Debit card/Credit card/Internet Banking) which can be accessed through the Online application facility from 21 January 2026 to 07 February 2026
  • No other mode of payment shall be accepted
  • Candidature shall be considered only on receipt of application fee for applicable categories

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 20 January 2026
Commencement of Online Application 21 January 2026
Last Date of Online Application 07 February 2026
Last date Extended   16 February 2026
Age, Experience & Qualification Reckoning Date 07 February 2026

Selection Process

  • The method of selection shall be through Practical Test (100 Marks)
  • Depending upon the number of online applications received, CSL reserves the right to scrutinise applications for various posts and prepare shortlist of candidates based on meeting eligibility requirements
  • Candidates who successfully complete the certificate verification shall be shortlisted to attend the Practical Test, which shall be held at CSL, Kochi
  • Minimum Pass Marks for Practical Test:
    • For unreserved posts & for EWS candidates: 50% of Total Marks of Practical Test
    • For OBC candidates: 45% of Total Marks of Practical Test only for vacancies reserved for OBC
    • For SC/ST candidates: 40% of Total Marks of Practical Test only for vacancies reserved for SC/ST
    • For PwBD candidates: 40% of Total Marks of Practical Test
  • CSL may relax the minimum pass mark, if the number of qualified candidates are insufficient
  • The selection shall be subject to verification of eligibility requirements (age, educational qualification, experience, reservation etc.)
  • Candidates should produce the original certificates in proof of age, educational qualification, experience and certificates for reservation categories along with self-attested copies at the time of Certificate Verification
  • Rank list for each posts shall be prepared based on the marks secured by the candidates meeting the notified eligibility requirements and who pass in Practical Test
  • In case, same marks are secured by more than one candidate, relative merit shall be decided based on seniority in age

General Information/Instructions

  • Period of Contract: The contract tenure of all posts are for a maximum period of five years subject to project requirements and individual performance
  • Place of Posting: The posting shall be at CSL/any other CSL units/project sites as desired by CSL. Candidates are liable to be transferred within different units of CSL
  • The appointment carries the obligation to serve in any department of CSL or on-board ships or in any of the units/work sites/projects undertaken in any part of India or abroad
  • The minimum qualification stipulated for all the posts must be from an Institute/Examination Board recognized by AICTE/appropriate statutory authority/State/Central Government
  • Those applicants having qualifications equivalent to any of the prescribed qualifications should submit Equivalency Certificate issued by the competent authority
  • Reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) shall be as per Govt. of India Guidelines
  • Government of India Directives on reservation shall apply
  • In the case of Persons with Benchmark Disabilities, the degree of disability should be a minimum of 40%
  • CSL reserves the right to increase/decrease the number of vacancies or not to fill up any of the vacancies or cancel the recruitment process, as per its requirement
  • No TA/DA shall be paid to the candidates for attending the selection process
  • Call letters shall not be sent to short-listed candidates by post. They shall be informed by e-mail/through CSL website to download call letter from www.cochinshipyard.in
  • The candidates short-listed for appointment should undergo a medical examination in the hospitals as prescribed by CSL
  • Rank lists shall be maintained for the post and the validity period of the rank list shall be up to 18 months from the date of reporting of the last candidate
  • The selected candidate is required to give an undertaking to comply with CSL policy on usage of smart phones at work place
  • Those who are currently working as Fabrication Assistants and Outfit Assistants, on rolls of CSL, as on date of this vacancy notification are not eligible to apply
  • Any legal proceedings can be instituted only in the Courts/Tribunals/Forums at Ernakulam and such Courts/Authorities shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification
  • Only Indian Nationals need apply

How to Apply

  • Applicants should go through the User Manual and FAQ published in the link www.cochinshipyard.in (Career page → CSL, Kochi) before filling the online application
  • Applicants meeting the notified requirements may do the One time Registration in the SAP Online portal and submit their application
  • The facility to submit application can be accessed through website www.cochinshipyard.in (Career page → CSL, Kochi) from 21 January 2026 to 07 February 2026
  • Application submitted direct or by any other mode shall not be accepted
  • Applicants should ensure that all certificates towards proof of age, educational qualification, experience, caste etc. and a recent passport size colour photograph are uploaded in the SAP online application portal
  • Ensure that all the entries in the online application have been correctly filled in and application submitted successfully
  • Change in the data provided in the application after final submission through online will not be considered
  • Incomplete applications/withdrawn applications/applications in draft status shall not be considered
  • On successful submission of the application, the status shall be shown as "In process"
  • After applying through online, retain a soft copy/printout of the online application containing the unique registration number generated by the system
  • Applicants need not send the online application print out/certificates/application fee in the form of DD/Challan/Cheque by post to Cochin Shipyard Ltd
  • Applicants are advised to submit applications well in advance before the last date to avoid heavy traffic on the website
  • Those who apply on the last date may not get any troubleshooting assistance/technical support in SAP application portal by email/phone after 1600 hrs on the last date
  • For any further clarification related to the advertisement and conduct of selection, please contact via e-mail [email protected] or Land Line Number 0484 – 250 1221

Eligibility Criteria

  • Age: Not more than 50 years as on 01.01.2026. Usual relaxation in upper age limit is admissible to candidates as per rules. Three years relaxation in upper age limit is admissible for those regular teachers presently employed in Universities, Aided and Government colleges in Kerala.
  • Qualifications: As per UGC Regulations 2018.
  • A-i) A Master's Degree in Physical Education and Sports or Physical Education or Sports Science with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed).
  • A-ii) Record of having represented the university/ college at the inter-university / inter-collegiate competitions or the State and/ or national championships.
  • A-iii) Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET), conducted by the UGC or CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET, or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in Physical Education or Physical Education and Sports or Sports Science, in accordance with the University Grants Commission (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phil/Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time.
  • Provided that, candidates registered for the Ph.D. degree prior to July 11, 2009, shall be governed by the provisions of the then existing Ordinances/ Bye-laws/Regulations of the Institutions awarding the degree and such Ph.D. degree holders shall be exempted from the requirement of NET/SLET/SET for recruitment and appointment of Assistant Professor or equivalent positions in Universities/Colleges/Institutions, subject to the fulfilment of specified conditions in the notification.
  • NET/SLET/SET shall also not be required for such Masters Programmes in disciplines for which NET/SLET/SET is not conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC like SLET/SET.
  • Passed the physical fitness test conducted in accordance with the Regulations.
  • OR B. An Asian game or commonwealth games medal winner who has a degree at least at Post-Graduation level.
  • Physical Fitness Test Norms for women: 8 minutes run/walk test – Up to 30 years: 1000 metres, Up to 40 years: 800 metres, Up to 45 years: 600 metres, Up to 50 years: 400 metres.

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay Band: Academic Level 10 with Rationalized Entry pay of Rs.57,700/-.

Age Limit

  • Maximum age: Not more than 50 years as on 01.01.2026.
  • Usual relaxation in upper age limit is admissible to candidates as per rules.
  • Three years relaxation in upper age limit is admissible for those regular teachers presently employed in Universities, Aided and Government colleges in Kerala.

Application Fee

  • Candidates shall remit an amount of Rs. 2000/- as Registration Fee.
  • Fee should be remitted only through online payment, the facility for which is provided in the online application form.
  • Copy of the receipt shall be submitted along with the hard copy of the online application.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 14.01.2026
Start date for submitting Online Application 15.01.2026
Last date for submitting Online Application 16.02.2026

Cochin Port Reserves the right to fix qualifying cut-off marks and limit the number of candidates for shortlisting, if deemed necessary. Candidates shortlisted or scoring above the prescribed cutoff marks at this stage will be required to make a presentation before a Board of Selectors on a topic given by them, which will carry 20% weightage.   • He/ she will maintain absolute integrity and devotion to duty and will be liable for penal action for misconduct or causing loss to Port property attributable to him/her during the period of contractual engagement.
  • He/ She will be governed by the Official Secrets Act, 1923, as amended from time to time and will not disclose any information/data available during their engagement to any unauthorized person(s).
  • It is advised that the Employees working in Central State Government/Semi-Govt. Autonomous Bodies/CPSEs shall get approval from their competent authority to apply. They shall be required to submit No Objection Certificate, if shortlisted.
  • The crucial date for determining the qualification and age shall be 16.02.2026 (closing date of on-line registration in the OAP). For any enquiries, candidates may contact the office of Secretary, Cochin Port Authority (Ph.No.0484-258-2113) or email ID provided herein during office hours (0930 hrs to 1700 hrs).

  • Eligible and willing candidates have to submit their applications through the online application portal (OAP) in the link mentioned below, and which is published in career page of website of Cochin Port Authority (www.cochinport.gov.in), which will be opened from 16.01.2026 Link :- https://career.itiltd.in/careers_cochin_port/login_form.php?id=MTg=
  • This online application process is the only valid method. No other application modes will be accepted.
  • Online registration on the portal will close on 16.02.2026 at 17:00 hrs. Candidates are advised to regularly check the website/ OAP for any updates regarding the selection process. Candidates are advised to keep the essential documents ready by the time of start of online registration. CoPA shall not be responsible for any omission on part of the candidates to keep themselves informed of the updates provided through the website/ portal/e-mail.
  • While applying for the post, the applicant should ensure that he/she fulfills the eligibility and other norms mentioned above. In case, it is detected at any stage of recruitment that a candidate does not fulfill the eligibility norms and /or that he/she has furnished any incorrect/false information or has suppressed any material fact(s), his/her candidature will stand rejected. If any of the above shortcoming(s) is/are detected even after contract engagement, his/her services are liable to be terminated without any notice.
  • The mere fact that a candidate has submitted the application against the advertisement would not bestow upon him/her the right to be considered for the contract engagement.
  • Cochin Port reserves the right to shortlist the number of candidates for interview out of eligible candidates.

  • Test centres in Kerala only
  • Candidates can choose test centres while completing online application

Minimum Pass Marks for Phase-I

  • Unreserved posts & EWS candidates: 50% of total marks
  • OBC Candidates: 45% of total marks (only for vacancies reserved for OBC)
  • SC/ST Candidates: 40% of total marks (only for vacancies reserved for SC/ST)
  • PwBD Candidates (HR & Finance posts): 40% of total marks

Certificate Verification

  • Candidates who score minimum pass marks shall be shortlisted for certificate verification
  • Minimum ratio of 6 candidates against one post in order of merit/reservation
  • Only candidates who successfully complete certificate verification shall be allowed to attend Phase II

Phase-II: Group Discussion, Writing Skills and Personal Interview (40 marks)

  • Group Discussion (GD): 10 marks
  • Writing Skills: 10 marks
  • Personal Interview: 20 marks
  • Venue: CSL, Kochi

Final Selection

  • Total marks: 100 (Phase-I: 60 marks + Phase-II: 40 marks)
  • Rank lists prepared based on total marks secured in Phase I & Phase II
  • In case of tie: marks scored in discipline part of Objective test shall be basis
  • If tie persists: relative merit decided based on seniority in age

General Information/Instructions

Posting Location

  • CSL, Kochi
  • CSL Mumbai Ship Repair Unit (CMSRU), Mumbai
  • CSL Kolkata Ship Repair Unit (CKSRU), Kolkata
  • CSL AN Ship Repair Unit (CANSRU), Sri Vijaya Puram, Andaman & Nicobar Islands
  • Candidates liable to be transferred within different units of CSL
  • May be posted in any department or on-board ships or any units/work sites/projects in India or abroad

Service Agreement

  • Selected candidates required to execute Service Agreement to serve CSL for at least 3 years after successful completion of training
  • During training and service agreement period, application for outside employment shall not be forwarded
  • No Objection Certificate for outside employment will not be issued

Reservation Policy

  • Government of India Directives on reservation shall apply
  • EWS candidates should produce valid Income and Asset Certificate in prescribed format
  • SC/ST/OBC (Non Creamy Layer) candidates should produce valid community certificate issued by Revenue Authority not below rank of Thahsildar
  • PwBD candidates: minimum 40% disability required (for HR & Finance posts)
  • Valid Certificate of disability in prescribed format as per Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules, 2017 required

PwBD Categories Identified (HR & Finance Posts Only)

  • Low vision
  • Deaf and hard of hearing
  • One Arm, One Leg, Both Leg
  • Leprosy Cured without functional impairment
  • Dwarfism
  • Acid Attack Victims without other functional disability

Important Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals need to apply
  • Applicants should apply for only one post as online exams for various posts will be conducted simultaneously
  • Application once submitted shall be final - no changes allowed
  • Applicants in regular Government service should upload declaration that they have informed their employer
  • Original certificates will be verified at time of joining or at any other stage as decided by CSL
  • Biometric/photograph will be captured at time of online examination
  • No travelling allowance for objective type test
  • SC/ST/PwBD candidates appearing for certificate verification shall be reimbursed single to & fro third AC rail fare
  • Call letters shall not be sent by post - will be available for download from website
  • Candidates should frequently check CSL website for updates
  • Medical examination required at hospitals prescribed by CSL
  • CSL reserves right to increase/decrease vacancies or cancel recruitment process
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification
  • Documents related to selection preserved for 2 years from date of publication of results
  • Legal jurisdiction: Courts/Tribunals/Forums at Ernakulam only

How to Apply

  • Visit official website www.cochinshipyard.in
  • Go to Career page CSL, Kochi
  • Click on the link for online application
  • Complete Registration phase first
  • Fill in all details correctly in the online application
  • Ensure you meet the notified requirements before applying
  • Upload required documents:
    • Certificates towards proof of age, qualification, caste, disability etc
    • Recent passport size colour photograph
    • Signature
    • Educational qualification certificates/mark sheets
    • Declaration (for Government employees as per Annexure-I)
  • Submit the application online
  • Pay application fee of ₹1,000 using online payment options (Debit card/Credit card/Internet Banking/Wallets/UPI)
  • Note down the unique registration number generated by the system
  • Retain soft copy/printout of online application for reference
  • Do not submit more than one application
  • Do not send application printout/certificates/fee by post
  • Submit application well in advance to avoid last minute rush
  • Last date for submission: 20 February 2026
  • Quote Registration Number for any correspondence with CSL
  • Check CSL website regularly for updates and selection schedule

Technical Support

  • For technical queries related to online application: [email protected]
  • For clarification related to advertisement and conduct of selection: [email protected]
  • Note: Technical support may not be available after 1600 hrs on last date of application

  11. Other conditions of service will be governed by relevant rules and orders issued by Govt. of India from time to time with regard to adhoc employees.
  12. If any declaration given or information furnished by him/her proves false or if he/she is found to have willfully suppressed any material information, he/she will be liable for removal from service and also such other action as the Institute may deem necessary.
  13. The appointee shall not be entitled to avail any allowances/facilities being extended to the regular/permanent faculty members of AIIMS, Rae Bareli (UP).
  14. Director, AIIMS, Raebareli reserves the right to cancel the advertisement at any point of time without assigning any reason there of or fill up less/more number of posts as advertised depending upon the Institutional requirement.
  15. The candidates must ensure that they fulfil eligibility criteria. If at any stage, it is found that the candidate has furnished any incorrect information his/her candidature will stand cancelled. If any of these shortcoming(s) is/are detected even after the appointment, his/her services will be summarily terminated.
  16. The candidates should bring their application/bio-data along with all the documents/certificates in support of their claim and photocopies of each document including passport size latest photographs.
  17. All the original certificates/documents will be verified at the time of interview.
  18. The candidates should also bring their original documents/testimonials on the date of interview.
  19. The period of experience wherever prescribed shall be counted after obtaining the prescribed qualification.

The candidates are also required to produce the original certificates/testimonials at the time of walk-in-interview.
