Trade-wise Vacancy Distribution

Trade Name Qualification Required
Technician Apprentice (Mechanical) Three years full time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering / Automobile Engineering
Technician Apprentice (Electrical) Three years full time Diploma in Electrical Engineering / Electrical & Electronics Engineering
Technician Apprentice (Telecommunication & Instrumentation) Three years full time Diploma in Electronics & Communication / Electronics & Telecommunication / Electronics & Radio Communication / Instrumentation & Control / Instrumentation & Process Control / Electronics Engineering
Trade Apprentice (Assistant-Human Resource) Full Time Bachelor degree (Graduation) from a Govt. recognized Institute/University
Trade Apprentice (Accountant) Full Time Bachelor degree (Graduation) in Commerce from a Govt. recognized Institute/University
Data Entry Operator (Fresher Apprentices) Minimum 12th Pass (but below Graduate)
Domestic Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders) Minimum 12th Pass (but below Graduate) with Skill Certificate of Domestic Data Entry Operator

Eligibility Criteria

Qualification Requirements

  • Technician Apprentice (Mechanical): Three years full time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Automobile Engineering. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Technician Apprentice (Electrical): Three years full time Diploma in Electrical Engineering or Electrical & Electronics Engineering. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Technician Apprentice (Telecommunication & Instrumentation): Three years full time Diploma in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering, Electronics & Radio Communication Engineering, Instrumentation & Control Engineering, Instrumentation & Process Control Engineering, or Electronics Engineering from a Government recognized Institute. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Trade Apprentice (Assistant-Human Resource): Full Time Bachelor degree (Graduation) from a Government recognized Institute/University.
  • Trade Apprentice (Accountant): Full Time Bachelor degree (Graduation) in Commerce from a Government recognized Institute/University.
  • Data Entry Operator (Fresher Apprentices): Minimum 12th Pass (but below Graduate).
  • Domestic Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders): Minimum 12th Pass (but below Graduate). Additionally, candidates should possess Skill Certificate of Domestic Data Entry Operator for training of less than one year issued by an awarding body recognized under National Skill Qualifications Framework or any other authority recognized by the Central Government.

Essential Qualifications

  • Candidate should have already passed the prescribed qualification on the date of reckoning eligibility criteria which is 31/01/2026.
  • Candidates whose result of the qualifying examination is awaited on the date of reckoning eligibility criteria are not eligible to apply.
  • The prescribed qualification for Graduate/Diploma holders shall be from a recognized University/Institute as a regular full-time course in the relevant trade/discipline with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate (45% for SC/ST and PwBD category candidates for the posts reserved for them).
  • Candidates holding a qualification acquired through part-time/correspondence/distance education mode are not eligible.
  • Candidates possessing higher professional qualifications such as BE/B.Tech., MBA, CA, LLB, MCA, or any such equivalent qualification or pursuing higher qualification and having completed the same on or before joining apprenticeship training, shall not be eligible.
  • Wherever CGPA/OGPA or Letter Grade is awarded in the ITI/Degree/Diploma examinations, its equivalent aggregate percentage of marks must be indicated by the candidates in the Online Application as per the norms adopted by Board/University/Institute.

Experience

  • Candidates having job experience for a period of one year or more after the attainment of the qualification shall not be eligible to be engaged as Apprentice.
  • Candidates who have completed five years after acquiring the prescribed qualification as on date of reckoning eligibility criteria shall also not be eligible for engagement as Apprentices.
  • A Candidate may undergo maximum two apprenticeship training and the second training shall not be in the same trade. There shall be minimum one year gap between two apprenticeship training, provided that the previous training is completed.

Salary/Stipend

  • Rate of stipend payable to apprentices per month shall be as prescribed under Apprentices Act, 1961/1973.
  • The stipend will be in accordance with The Apprenticeship Rules, 1992 read with The Apprenticeship (Amendment) Rules, 2019 & 2025 as amended from time to time and Corporation's guidelines.
  • During the period of Apprenticeship, apart from monthly stipend as prescribed above, no other monetary or non-monetary benefit/facility such as accommodation, HRA, conveyance, medical facility etc. shall be admissible to apprentices.
  • Candidates have to make their own arrangement for accommodation, conveyance, medical etc.
  • Duration of Apprenticeship Training: 12 months from the date of engagement.

Age Limit (as on 31/01/2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 24 years
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST: Relaxation in upper age up to 5 years to SC/ST candidates considered against reserved positions will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for OBC (NCL): Relaxation in upper age up to 3 years to OBC (NCL) candidates considered against reserved positions will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD: Relaxation in upper age up to 10 years for PwBD candidates will be allowed irrespective of reservation of posts to them.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD-SC/ST: Further, upper age relaxation of 5 years to PwBD candidates belonging to SC/ST category will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD-OBC(NCL): Upper age relaxation of 3 years to PwBD-OBC(NCL) candidates will be allowed.

Application Fee

  • No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 23/01/2026
Date of Opening of Online Application 28/01/2026
Last Date of Submission of Online Application 10/02/2026, 11:59 PM (IST)
Cut-off Date for Age, Qualification etc. 31/01/2026

Selection Process

  • Candidates registered in the NAPS/NATS Portal and applying against the notification shall be considered for selection.
  • Panel cum Merit List of all the candidates, who have applied against a respective post in the portal and meeting the notified eligibility criteria, shall be prepared based on the percentage of marks in descending order obtained in the essential qualification applicable to the trade applied for.
  • Aggregate of marks of all subjects of all years/semesters will be considered for eligibility.
  • In case of a similar rank in merit based on the percentage of marks obtained in the essential qualifying examination, a candidate with an earlier date of birth (older in age) shall be considered. In case of same date of birth, candidates having a higher percentage of marks in Matriculation shall be considered.
  • There shall be No Written Test or Personal Interview.
  • In case a reserved seat remains unfilled, the same shall be reallocated in the following order of priority: first to SC, then to ST, thereafter to OBC, followed by EWS, and finally to UR.
  • Verification of the original documents shall be done before joining of the candidate as an Apprentice.
  • Engagement of selected candidates is subject to their being declared medically fit as per the requirement of the Corporation.

General Information/Instructions

  • Reservation of seats to SC/ST/OBC (Non Creamy Layer-NCL)/PwBD/Economically Weaker Section (EWS) candidates shall be as per the applicable Government guidelines.
  • The minimum prescribed qualification marks will be relaxed by 5% for candidates belonging to SC/ST/PwBD categories considered against reserved positions.
  • In case of candidates belonging to OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) category, name of OBC caste mentioned in the certificate should fall in the Central List of OBCs of the respective State and Non-Creamy Layer status should be valid as on cut-off date of reckoning eligibility criteria.
  • Candidates are advised to ensure that they are Medically Fit as per IndianOil's pre-engagement medical standard.
  • The trades are suitable for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, with minimum 40% disability.
  • Candidates can apply for one Trade Code ONLY. Candidates applying for more than one Trade Code will not be considered for any post and their applications will be summarily rejected.
  • Only one mobile number and one email ID can be used for applying for the post. The same mobile number and email ID cannot be used by any other candidate for filling online application for this notification.
  • Candidates, who are pursuing higher qualification on the date of final submission of online application but have acquired/completed the same subsequently at the time of document verification, shall also not be eligible for engagement and shall not be allowed to Join.
  • Suppression of information regarding possession or pursuing higher qualification shall render a candidate ineligible for consideration at any stage of selection & termination any time during engagement, if engaged.
  • The terms and conditions of engagement of the apprentices shall be governed by The Apprentices Act, 1961 and Rules 1992 as amended from time to time.
  • Upon completion of the apprenticeship period, the Corporation shall have NO obligation to offer employment to such Apprentices NOR can an Apprentice claim the right for employment on the grounds of completion of Apprenticeship.
  • Candidates are advised to maintain the same registered e-mail ID and mobile number till the completion of apprenticeship training.
  • Candidates are advised to periodically visit the official website https://www.iocl.com/apprenticeships as all future correspondence and latest information shall be shared only on the website.

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Candidates willing to apply must register as a Technician/Trade/Graduate Apprentice online in the following portals under the respective State as per their Trades:
    • Trade Apprentice: Data Entry Operator (Fresher Apprentices)/Domestic Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders) at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
    • Technician Apprentice: (Mechanical/Electrical/Telecommunication & Instrumentation) at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
    • Trade Apprentice (Assistant-Human Resource/Accountant) at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
  • Step 2: Candidates meeting the prescribed eligibility criteria may LOGIN to the respective NATS/NAPS Portal using their User ID/Email ID and APPLY for the apprenticeship Openings/Opportunities with the Establishment ID of Indian Oil Corporation Limited mentioned below:
    • Eastern Region Pipelines (ERPL) - NATS: EWBKOC000079, NAPS: E11181900005
    • Western Region Pipelines (WRPL) - NATS: WGJRAC000006, NAPS: E11182400087
    • Northern Region Pipelines (NRPL) - NATS: NHRPPC000001, NAPS: E12180600006
    • Southern Region Pipelines (SRPL) - NATS: STNCHC000040, NAPS: E12183300008
    • South Eastern Region Pipelines (SERPL) - NATS: EORBBSC000001, NAPS: E02252100002
  • Step 3: Candidates must complete the application for Openings/Opportunities in respective NATS/NAPS Portal from 28/01/2026 to 10/02/2026. Before applying against an opportunity, the candidate MUST ensure that their profile (Personal details, Educational details, Category etc.) along with aggregate percentage are appearing correctly in their application.
  • Step 4: After applying against an opportunity in the respective NAPS/NATS Portal, the candidate must complete their registration/application for apprentice positions in Indian Oil Pipelines portal at https://plapps.indianoilpipelines.in/
  • Step 5: The candidate must use the same e-mail ID and Mobile Number used in respective NAPS/NATS Portal which must be valid for the entire apprenticeship period.
  • Step 6: There are two steps for Registration process (Part-I & Part-II) in Indian Oil Pipelines portal:
    • Part-I Registration: Candidate must fill their basic details like name, category etc. and must create their own password. After successful Part-I registration, system generated registration number is sent to their registered email id/SMS.
    • Part-II Registration: Candidates must upload their scanned photograph (Size: between 20-50 KB in JPG Format) and signature in black ink (Size: between 10-30 KB in JPG Format) and furnish educational qualification, experience details etc. and submit the same. This is the final submission process and after that candidates cannot change the details furnished.
  • Step 7: Candidates must complete the application process in Indian Oil Pipelines portal at https://plapps.indianoilpipelines.in/ from 28/01/2026 to 10/02/2026.
  • Step 8: The candidate must mention the registration/enrolment number of NAPS/NATS Portal while applying for apprentice positions in Indian Oil Pipelines Portal.
  • Step 9: After successfully applying/registration of Online Application in Indian Oil Pipelines Portal, the candidate must take a printout of the filled-in online application for future reference.
  • Important: No other means/mode of application shall be accepted other than what is mentioned above. Candidates to ensure that they have successfully applied for the relevant opportunity through respective NAPS/NATS Portal BEFORE applying/registration in Indian Oil Pipelines Portal.
  • Applications/Registration which are incomplete or are received in any other mode/form or not fulfilling the eligibility criteria and/or those received after the last date of submission of application shall not be considered "Eligible" and treated as "Rejected".

2. What is the last apply date for NMMC Recruitment 2026?

Ans: Last apply date is 19/02/2026

Ans: Eligibility varies by post. For Junior Engineer posts, Diploma in relevant engineering is required. For medical posts, MBBS with respective post-graduate qualification is mandatory. For administrative posts, Graduate degree with relevant qualifications is required.

Ans: Details about negative marking will be mentioned in the exam pattern section of the official notification. Candidates should check the detailed notification before appearing for the exam.

Selection Process

  • The applications received shall be scrutinized and shortlisted.
  • Candidates will be shortlisted in the light of their qualification, experience and other details provided in the application form.
  • Shortlisted candidates may be called for test/ interview etc. before selection.

General Information / Instructions

  • The initial period of engagement shall be 2 years which can be extended to additional 2 years on the basis of performance with no further extension. There shall be a performance review after every 6 months of engagement of the professional.
  • The appointment of professionals will be on Full Time Basis and they would not be permitted to take up any other assignment during the period of appointment as Jr. Professional Intern with MbPA.
  • A certificate regarding successful completion of engagement shall be issued by the concerned Department/ Division in the enclosed format (Annexure III). Professionals not completing a period of 1 (one) Year will not be issued any experience certificate.
  • Jr. Professional Intern engaged on contractual basis shall not be entitled to any kind of allowance e.g. Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Transport Allowance, Transport Facility, Personal Staff, CGHS, Medical Reimbursement etc.
  • Jr. Professional Intern shall not be entitled to TA/DA for joining the assignment or on its completion. For any travel if required, compensation will be as per norms laid down by MbPA at the time of travel.
  • TDS as admissible shall be deducted from the monthly remuneration of Jr. Professional Interns . A TDS certificate shall be issued by the concerned department on demand.
  • Jr. Professional Intern shall be eligible for Casual Leave of 20 Days in a calendar year on pro- rata basis. His/her absence beyond 20 days in a Year (On pro-rata basis) shall lead to deductions in remuneration. Any un-availed leave cannot be carried over to next calendar Year. MbPA would be free to terminate the services of Jr. Professional Intern in case of absence of more than 15 days beyond the entitled leave. No carry forward of the unconsumed leave as also no encashment of leave would be allowed.
  • As regards accommodation facility, accommodation at MbPA quarters can be provided, subject to availability of accommodation in the category of Class III B quarters and on the personnel engaged. The rent payable for accommodation will be @10% of consolidated remuneration and single licence fees per month. In addition, electricity & water charges would be recovered on actual consumption basis. In case accommodation at MbPA Quarters is availed, a Security Deposit of amount equivalent to two times of rent payable per month, will have to be paid as a security against Rent, electricity, water charges and damages, if any. The deposit will be refunded after receiving No Dues Certificate from competent Authorities of concerned Departments.
  • As regards, Medical facility, since MbPA has its own Hospital, OPD as well as IPD facility will be provided to contractual personnel at MbPA hospital/ dispensary along with medicines. However, the Jr. Professional Intern will not be referred outside for treatment. No medical facilities would be available to family/ dependent of the Jr. Professional Intern.
  • A candidate can apply for engagement only once during a financial year. The applicants who do not fulfill the eligibility conditions, their applications shall be rejected.
  • Applicants must clearly indicate their area(s) of interest.
  • Mere fulfillment of qualification or shortlisting shall not confer any right to be engaged as Jr. Professional Intern .

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates may submit their application(s) in the prescribed format (Application form) by:
  • Downloading the application format (Annexure –IV-B) from website www.mumbaiport.gov.in (‘People & Career/Jobs’ menu).
  • Filling the application format with the required details and declaration.
  • The filled in application form along with required documents for determining eligibility is to be dropped in the drop box kept at the below mentioned address on or before the last date of application i.e. 10.02.2026 by superscribing on the envelope as “Application for engagement of Jr. Professional Interns on contract basis” in Mechanical and Electrical Engineering Department. Trade Name Qualification Required
Technician Apprentice (Mechanical) Three years full time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering / Automobile Engineering

Eligibility Criteria

Qualification Requirements

  • Technician Apprentice (Mechanical): Three years full time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Automobile Engineering. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Technician Apprentice (Electrical): Three years full time Diploma in Electrical Engineering or Electrical & Electronics Engineering. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Technician Apprentice (Telecommunication & Instrumentation): Three years full time Diploma in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering, Electronics & Radio Communication Engineering, Instrumentation & Control Engineering, Instrumentation & Process Control Engineering, or Electronics Engineering from a Government recognized Institute. Lateral entry candidates after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course are also eligible.
  • Trade Apprentice (Assistant-Human Resource): Full Time Bachelor degree (Graduation) from a Government recognized Institute/University.
  • Trade Apprentice (Accountant): Full Time Bachelor degree (Graduation) in Commerce from a Government recognized Institute/University.
  • Data Entry Operator (Fresher Apprentices): Minimum 12th Pass (but below Graduate).
  • Domestic Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders): Minimum 12th Pass (but below Graduate). Additionally, candidates should possess Skill Certificate of Domestic Data Entry Operator for training of less than one year issued by an awarding body recognized under National Skill Qualifications Framework or any other authority recognized by the Central Government.

Essential Qualifications

  • Candidate should have already passed the prescribed qualification on the date of reckoning eligibility criteria which is 31/01/2026.
  • Candidates whose result of the qualifying examination is awaited on the date of reckoning eligibility criteria are not eligible to apply.
  • The prescribed qualification for Graduate/Diploma holders shall be from a recognized University/Institute as a regular full-time course in the relevant trade/discipline with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate (45% for SC/ST and PwBD category candidates for the posts reserved for them).
  • Candidates holding a qualification acquired through part-time/correspondence/distance education mode are not eligible.
  • Candidates possessing higher professional qualifications such as BE/B.Tech., MBA, CA, LLB, MCA, or any such equivalent qualification or pursuing higher qualification and having completed the same on or before joining apprenticeship training, shall not be eligible.
  • Wherever CGPA/OGPA or Letter Grade is awarded in the ITI/Degree/Diploma examinations, its equivalent aggregate percentage of marks must be indicated by the candidates in the Online Application as per the norms adopted by Board/University/Institute.

Experience

  • Candidates having job experience for a period of one year or more after the attainment of the qualification shall not be eligible to be engaged as Apprentice.
  • Candidates who have completed five years after acquiring the prescribed qualification as on date of reckoning eligibility criteria shall also not be eligible for engagement as Apprentices.
  • A Candidate may undergo maximum two apprenticeship training and the second training shall not be in the same trade. There shall be minimum one year gap between two apprenticeship training, provided that the previous training is completed.

Salary/Stipend

  • Rate of stipend payable to apprentices per month shall be as prescribed under Apprentices Act, 1961/1973.
  • The stipend will be in accordance with The Apprenticeship Rules, 1992 read with The Apprenticeship (Amendment) Rules, 2019 & 2025 as amended from time to time and Corporation's guidelines.
  • During the period of Apprenticeship, apart from monthly stipend as prescribed above, no other monetary or non-monetary benefit/facility such as accommodation, HRA, conveyance, medical facility etc. shall be admissible to apprentices.
  • Candidates have to make their own arrangement for accommodation, conveyance, medical etc.
  • Duration of Apprenticeship Training: 12 months from the date of engagement.

Age Limit (as on 31/01/2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 24 years
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST: Relaxation in upper age up to 5 years to SC/ST candidates considered against reserved positions will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for OBC (NCL): Relaxation in upper age up to 3 years to OBC (NCL) candidates considered against reserved positions will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD: Relaxation in upper age up to 10 years for PwBD candidates will be allowed irrespective of reservation of posts to them.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD-SC/ST: Further, upper age relaxation of 5 years to PwBD candidates belonging to SC/ST category will be allowed.
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD-OBC(NCL): Upper age relaxation of 3 years to PwBD-OBC(NCL) candidates will be allowed.

Application Fee

  • No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 23/01/2026
Date of Opening of Online Application 28/01/2026
Last Date of Submission of Online Application 10/02/2026, 11:59 PM (IST)
Cut-off Date for Age, Qualification etc. 31/01/2026

Selection Process

  • Candidates registered in the NAPS/NATS Portal and applying against the notification shall be considered for selection.
  • Panel cum Merit List of all the candidates, who have applied against a respective post in the portal and meeting the notified eligibility criteria, shall be prepared based on the percentage of marks in descending order obtained in the essential qualification applicable to the trade applied for.
  • Aggregate of marks of all subjects of all years/semesters will be considered for eligibility.
  • In case of a similar rank in merit based on the percentage of marks obtained in the essential qualifying examination, a candidate with an earlier date of birth (older in age) shall be considered. In case of same date of birth, candidates having a higher percentage of marks in Matriculation shall be considered.
  • There shall be No Written Test or Personal Interview.
  • In case a reserved seat remains unfilled, the same shall be reallocated in the following order of priority: first to SC, then to ST, thereafter to OBC, followed by EWS, and finally to UR.
  • Verification of the original documents shall be done before joining of the candidate as an Apprentice.
  • Engagement of selected candidates is subject to their being declared medically fit as per the requirement of the Corporation.

General Information/Instructions

  • Reservation of seats to SC/ST/OBC (Non Creamy Layer-NCL)/PwBD/Economically Weaker Section (EWS) candidates shall be as per the applicable Government guidelines.
  • The minimum prescribed qualification marks will be relaxed by 5% for candidates belonging to SC/ST/PwBD categories considered against reserved positions.
  • In case of candidates belonging to OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) category, name of OBC caste mentioned in the certificate should fall in the Central List of OBCs of the respective State and Non-Creamy Layer status should be valid as on cut-off date of reckoning eligibility criteria.
  • Candidates are advised to ensure that they are Medically Fit as per IndianOil's pre-engagement medical standard.
  • The trades are suitable for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, with minimum 40% disability.
  • Candidates can apply for one Trade Code ONLY. Candidates applying for more than one Trade Code will not be considered for any post and their applications will be summarily rejected.
  • Only one mobile number and one email ID can be used for applying for the post. The same mobile number and email ID cannot be used by any other candidate for filling online application for this notification.
  • Candidates, who are pursuing higher qualification on the date of final submission of online application but have acquired/completed the same subsequently at the time of document verification, shall also not be eligible for engagement and shall not be allowed to Join.
  • Suppression of information regarding possession or pursuing higher qualification shall render a candidate ineligible for consideration at any stage of selection & termination any time during engagement, if engaged.
  • The terms and conditions of engagement of the apprentices shall be governed by The Apprentices Act, 1961 and Rules 1992 as amended from time to time.
  • Upon completion of the apprenticeship period, the Corporation shall have NO obligation to offer employment to such Apprentices NOR can an Apprentice claim the right for employment on the grounds of completion of Apprenticeship.
  • Candidates are advised to maintain the same registered e-mail ID and mobile number till the completion of apprenticeship training.
  • Candidates are advised to periodically visit the official website https://www.iocl.com/apprenticeships as all future correspondence and latest information shall be shared only on the website.

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Candidates willing to apply must register as a Technician/Trade/Graduate Apprentice online in the following portals under the respective State as per their Trades:
    • Trade Apprentice: Data Entry Operator (Fresher Apprentices)/Domestic Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders) at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
    • Technician Apprentice: (Mechanical/Electrical/Telecommunication & Instrumentation) at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
    • Trade Apprentice (Assistant-Human Resource/Accountant) at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
  • Step 2: Candidates meeting the prescribed eligibility criteria may LOGIN to the respective NATS/NAPS Portal using their User ID/Email ID and APPLY for the apprenticeship Openings/Opportunities with the Establishment ID of Indian Oil Corporation Limited mentioned below:
    • Eastern Region Pipelines (ERPL) - NATS: EWBKOC000079, NAPS: E11181900005
    • Western Region Pipelines (WRPL) - NATS: WGJRAC000006, NAPS: E11182400087
    • Northern Region Pipelines (NRPL) - NATS: NHRPPC000001, NAPS: E12180600006
    • Southern Region Pipelines (SRPL) - NATS: STNCHC000040, NAPS: E12183300008
    • South Eastern Region Pipelines (SERPL) - NATS: EORBBSC000001, NAPS: E02252100002
  • Step 3: Candidates must complete the application for Openings/Opportunities in respective NATS/NAPS Portal from 28/01/2026 to 10/02/2026. Before applying against an opportunity, the candidate MUST ensure that their profile (Personal details, Educational details, Category etc.) along with aggregate percentage are appearing correctly in their application.
  • Step 4: After applying against an opportunity in the respective NAPS/NATS Portal, the candidate must complete their registration/application for apprentice positions in Indian Oil Pipelines portal at https://plapps.indianoilpipelines.in/
  • Step 5: The candidate must use the same e-mail ID and Mobile Number used in respective NAPS/NATS Portal which must be valid for the entire apprenticeship period.
  • Step 6: There are two steps for Registration process (Part-I & Part-II) in Indian Oil Pipelines portal:
    • Part-I Registration: Candidate must fill their basic details like name, category etc. and must create their own password. After successful Part-I registration, system generated registration number is sent to their registered email id/SMS.
    • Part-II Registration: Candidates must upload their scanned photograph (Size: between 20-50 KB in JPG Format) and signature in black ink (Size: between 10-30 KB in JPG Format) and furnish educational qualification, experience details etc. and submit the same. This is the final submission process and after that candidates cannot change the details furnished.
  • Step 7: Candidates must complete the application process in Indian Oil Pipelines portal at https://plapps.indianoilpipelines.in/ from 28/01/2026 to 10/02/2026.
  • Step 8: The candidate must mention the registration/enrolment number of NAPS/NATS Portal while applying for apprentice positions in Indian Oil Pipelines Portal.
  • Step 9: After successfully applying/registration of Online Application in Indian Oil Pipelines Portal, the candidate must take a printout of the filled-in online application for future reference.
  • Important: No other means/mode of application shall be accepted other than what is mentioned above. Candidates to ensure that they have successfully applied for the relevant opportunity through respective NAPS/NATS Portal BEFORE applying/registration in Indian Oil Pipelines Portal.
  • Applications/Registration which are incomplete or are received in any other mode/form or not fulfilling the eligibility criteria and/or those received after the last date of submission of application shall not be considered "Eligible" and treated as "Rejected".

Eligibility Criteria

  • Consultant (Administration): Officials retired from Level - 8 (as per 7th CPC) or above from Central Government Service / Central Autonomous bodies and having experience in General Administration, GFR, FRSR, RTI, GeM, CCS (Conduct) Rules, Purchase, Stores, Legal matters etc.

  • In case of Retired employees who are not drawing pension (as per CCS Pension Rules), the fixed monthly remuneration shall be arrived at by taking 50% of their Basic Pay drawn at the time of retirement plus Transport Allowance (TA) including DA on TA as was applicable to the appointee at the time of retirement.

  • The retired employee engaged as consultant shall continue to draw their existing pension and Dearness Relief on pension from their parent organisation during the period of his/her engagement as consultant.
  • Paid leave of absence shall be allowed at the rate of 1.5 days for each completed month of service. Accumulation of leave beyond the contract period shall not be allowed.
  • The consultant shall be required to observe the normal office timing and may also be called upon to attend the office on Saturday, Sunday or any holiday in case of urgency and mark his/her attendance mandatorily, failing which it may result in deduction of remuneration.

  • Other terms & conditions of the engagement will be governed as per Government of India guidelines.

How to Apply

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications

  • Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: An eminent scholar having a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, and published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per UGC Regulations-2018. A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate
    • Option B: An outstanding professional, having a Ph.D. degree in the relevant/allied/applied disciplines, from any academic institutions/industry, who has made significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, supported by documentary evidence provided he/she has ten years experience
  • Associate Professor: A good academic record, with a Ph.D. Degree in the concerned/allied/relevant disciplines. A Master's Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry with a minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of Seventy five (75) as per UGC Regulations-2018
  • Assistant Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time as the case may be exempted from NET/SLET/SET
    • Option B: The Ph.D degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking among top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of the following: (i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) (ii) the Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai)
  • Deputy Librarian: A Master's Degree in library science/information science/documentation science, with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever grading system is followed. Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian. Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library. A Ph.D. Degree in library science/Information science/Documentation Science/Archives and manuscript keeping/computerization of library
  • Assistant Librarian: A Master's Degree in Library Science, Information Science or Documentation Science or an equivalent professional degree, with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A consistently good academic record, with knowledge of computerization of a library. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time

Essential Qualifications

  • Educational qualification, experience, age of retirement on superannuation and pay scales of Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Deputy Librarian and Assistant Librarian will be as per the UGC/NCERT, Government of India norms as amended from time to time and in force at the time of closing date of filling-up online application
  • For Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian positions, NET/SLET/SET shall not be required for such Masters Programmes in disciplines for which NET/SLET/SET is not conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC
  • Candidates registered for the Ph.D. programme prior to July 11, 2009, shall be governed by the provisions of the then existing Ordinances/Bye-laws/Regulations of the Institution awarding the degree and such Ph.D. candidates shall be exempted from the requirement of NET/SLET/SET subject to fulfillment of specific conditions: Ph.D. degree awarded in regular mode, Ph.D. thesis evaluated by at least two external examiners, Open Ph.D. viva voce conducted, Candidate has published two research papers from Ph.D. work (at least one in refereed journal), Candidate has presented at least two papers based on Ph.D work in conferences/seminars sponsored/funded/supported by the UGC/ICSSR/CSIR or any similar agency
  • The fulfillment of these conditions is to be certified by the Registrar or the Dean (Academic Affairs) of the University concerned
  • The Academic score as specified in Appendix II for Universities and Colleges shall be considered for short-listing of the candidates for interview only, and the selections shall be based only on the performance in the interview as per UGC Regulations-2018 and as amended from time to time

Experience

  • Professor: A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate OR ten years experience as an outstanding professional from academic institutions/industry with significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned discipline
  • Associate Professor: A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry
  • Deputy Librarian: Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian with evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library
  • Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian: No specific years of experience required, but must have NET/SLET/SET qualification or Ph.D. degree exemption as per UGC norms

Desirable

  • For Professor positions: Published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120
  • For Associate Professor positions: A minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 75
  • For Deputy Librarian: Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library
  • For Assistant Librarian: A consistently good academic record with knowledge of computerization of a library

Salary/Stipend

  • Professor: Academic level 14 with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,44,200/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.37,400-67,000 with AGP-10,000)
  • Associate Professor/Deputy Librarian: Academic level 13A with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,31,400/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.37,400-67,000 with AGP-9,000)
  • Assistant Professor/Assistant Librarian: Academic level 10 with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 57,700/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.15,600-39,100 with AGP-6,000)
  • All pay scales are as per UGC/NCERT/Government of India norms and will be applicable as amended from time to time
  • Selected candidates will be entitled to other allowances and benefits as per Government of India/NCERT rules applicable from time to time

Age Limit (as on 20/02/2026)

  • Age of retirement on superannuation will be as per the UGC/NCERT, Government of India norms as amended from time to time and in force at the time of closing date of filling-up online application
  • The relaxation in age and percentage of marks to candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS/PWD categories is provided in accordance with the UGC/GOI/NCERT rules
  • Persons with Disability (PWD) having disability less than forty percent will not be considered. The disability certificate shall be from a competent medical board constituted by the central or state Government Hospital
  • Such persons should meet the prescribed criteria of physical disability of the respective category as per the Government of India rules

Application Fee

  • UR/OBC/EWS Candidates: Rs. 1000/- (Rupees One thousand only) through online payment mode only
  • Women applicants and applicants belonging to SC/ST/PWD: Exempted from payment of fee
  • No other mode of payment will be accepted other than online payment mode
  • Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances

Event Date & Time

Last Date of Online Registration and apply online 20/02/2026 (Up to 05:00 PM)
Closing date for eligibility criteria 20/02/2026

Selection Process

  • For Assistant Professor Posts: Up to 50 candidates (category-wise) for the first vacancy and 05 candidates for every additional vacancy will be called for the interview in order of their rank/merit in the list as prepared by the Shortlisting Committee on the basis of marks scored by the candidates, which should not be less than academic score of 60 (Sixty) in any case. In case of tie of marks at the 50th place for 01 vacancy and tie of marks at 5th place for every additional vacancy, all candidates whose marks tie will be called for interview
  • For Professor and Associate Professor Posts: The existing criterion of minimum academic score as per UGC guidelines will be followed subject to the condition up to 10 candidates (category-wise) for the first vacancy and 05 candidates for every additional vacancy will be called for interview in order of their rank/merit in the list as prepared by the Shortlisting Committee on the basis of marks scored by the candidates. In case of tie of marks at the 10th place for 01 vacancy and tie of marks at 5th place for every additional vacancy, all candidates whose marks tie will be called for interview
  • The Academic score shall be considered for short-listing of the candidates for interview only, and the selections shall be based only on the performance in the interview
  • The list of shortlisted candidates will be displayed on the NCERT website
  • The shortlisted candidates will be allowed to appear for the interview only after verification of their eligibility
  • The registration will be provisional as the eligibility of the shortlisted candidate will be verified at the time of Interview from the original documents
  • All Certificates, Degrees and other documents must be produced in original for verification at the time of interview (if shortlisted), failing which the candidate may not be allowed to appear for the interview
  • Final result of the selected candidates will be displayed on NCERT website
  • The Council will not entertain any correspondence with the candidates about their non-selection in the recruitment
  • The decision of the NCERT in all matters relating to selection and allotment of posts/organizations to selected candidates will be final and binding on the candidates

General Information/Instructions

  • National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT) is an apex organization for Educational Research, Teacher Training and Development of Curriculum and Instructional material in school education
  • Positions are available at NCERT, New Delhi and at its constituent units located at Ajmer, Bhopal, Bhubaneswar, Mysuru and Shillong
  • Only Indian Nationals need to apply
  • Eligible and interested candidates are required to apply online only through the NCERT website www.ncert.nic.in at Announcement-Vacancy-Academic. No other means/mode of submission of applications will be accepted
  • The candidates must have a valid email id and mobile number through which he/she will get registered with the online application portal

  • Fields with STAR (*) mark are mandatory and essential to be filled in by the candidate
  • After the required information have been provided, click submit button. However, before clicking "Submit" button, candidate must make sure that no changes are required and the information provided is correct and final. After application is submitted, no changes will be entertained
  • Candidates are required to upload their scanned recent/colour passport size photograph, applicant's signature and all the relevant documents. The candidates have to keep a copy of application with documents for record and the same to be produced at the time of verification of document/interview, if shortlisted
  • In case a candidate wishes to apply for more than one post, he/she should submit separate application online along with the requisite fee for each post applied for. All the online applications should be completed in all respects. Only one application for individual post from one applicant will be accepted
  • The candidate should meet the eligibility criteria and provide the information which he/she possesses as on the last date of submission of the application. Candidates who do not possess the requisite educational qualification as on the closing date of receipt of application will not be eligible
  • Candidature of a registered candidate is liable to be rejected at any stage of recruitment process or even after joining, if any information provided by the candidate is found to be false or not in conformity with the eligibility criteria
  • Candidate must indicate his/her caste/category in the appropriate column of the application form (SC, ST, UR, OBC (NCL) & EWS etc). Leaving the caste column blank would not automatically be assumed as an application for un-reserved category and the application will be rejected as incomplete
  • The OBC-Non Creamy Layer candidates will be required to submit a valid caste certificate for purpose of reservation in appointment to posts under Government of India/Central Government from a competent authority along with latest Non Creamy Layer certificate and self-declaration that he/she does not belong to the creamy layer as on the closing date of submission of applications
  • The EWS candidates will be required to submit a valid certificate for purpose of reservation in appointment to posts under Government of India/Central Government from a competent authority and self declaration
  • Number of vacancies may vary depending upon the actual requirement. NCERT reserves the right not to fill up any or all the posts or cancel the whole process of recruitment without assigning any reason
  • Mere fulfilling the minimum eligibility requirements does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. NCERT reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates to be called for interview
  • The certificates, which are neither in English nor in Hindi, need to be translated preferably to either in English or in Hindi and the same shall be submitted along with the copy of the certificate in local language
  • The candidate who have received letter grades or grading points instead of marks, should provide conversion chart and percentage equivalent of their respective letter grades, issued by concerned board/university/institution
  • Any subsequent change of address/Telephone No./Email address should be promptly communicated to the Section Officer, Recruitment-1 Section, Room No. 12, 5th Floor, Zakir Hussain Block, NCERT, New Delhi- 110016
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification and the candidature is liable to be summarily rejected
  • In order to avoid last minute rush, the candidates are advised in their own interest to apply well in time

Odisha.contentHtml:
Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Berhampur (IISER Berhampur)  has released an official notification for the recruitment of 14 Non Teaching Posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply Online through the official IISER Berhampur website. The last date to submit the application form is 02-03-2026. In this article, you’ll find the IISER Berhampur Non Teaching Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Online application form.

IISER Berhampur Non-Teaching Recruitment 2026 – Important Details

Advertisement
Details Information
Organization Name Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Berhampur (IISER Berhampur)
Post Name Deputy Registrar, Private Secretary, Junior Assistant (MS), Senior Superintendent (Deputation), Senior Technical Officer (IT), Technical Officer (Lab), Junior Technical Assistant (Lab), Assistant Engineer (Civil), Junior Engineer (Electrical), Medical Officer, Nurse, Junior Library Superintendent, Physical Education Instructor, Junior Translator (Rajbhasha)
Total Vacancies 14 Posts
Advt No NT-01/2025
Salary/Pay Scale Group A/B/C posts across Pay Levels 3, 5, 6, 7, 10, 11, 12 (7th CPC) as per post
Educational Qualification Post-wise Master’s / Bachelor’s / MBBS / B.E/B.Tech / Diploma with required experience
Age Limit Upper age limits vary by post (30, 33, 35, 38, 40, 50, 56 years) as on 02/03/2026
Application Start Date 31/01/2026 (09:00 hrs)
Application End Date 02/03/2026 (17:30 hrs)
Application Mode Online only; no need to send hard copy
Official Website www.iiserbpr.ac.in
Trending Govt Jobs
  • India Post GDS Online Form 2026
  • UPSC CSE Online Form 2026
  • RRB 22000 Group D Online form 2026
  • Yantra India YIL 3979 Trade Apprentices Online Form 2026
  • SBI 2273 CBO Recruitment 2026

IISER Berhampur Non-Teaching 2026 Vacancy Details

The advertisement invites applications for the following sanctioned regular non-teaching posts with indicated reservation and mode of recruitment.

Post Name Mode of Recruitment Total
Deputy Registrar Direct Recruitment 01
Private Secretary Direct Recruitment 01
Junior Assistant (Multi Skill) Direct Recruitment 01
Senior Superintendent Deputation 01
Technical Officer (Lab) Direct Recruitment 01
Junior Technical Assistant (Lab) Direct Recruitment 01
Senior Technical Officer (IT) Direct Recruitment 01
Assistant Engineer (Civil) Direct Recruitment 01
Junior Engineer (Electrical) Direct Recruitment 01
Medical Officer Direct Recruitment 01
Nurse Direct Recruitment 01
Junior Library Superintendent Direct Recruitment 01
Physical Education Instructor Direct Recruitment 01
Junior Translator (Rajbhasha) Direct Recruitment 01
Total 14

Eligibility Criteria

Post-wise Qualifications, Experience & Age Limits

  • Deputy Registrar (Group A, Level 12, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 50 years.
    • Qualification: Master’s Degree with at least 55% marks or equivalent grade.
    • Experience: 5 years administrative experience as Assistant Registrar in Level 10 or equivalent in Govt./Govt. research establishments/universities/statutory organizations/organizations of high repute.
  • Private Secretary (Group B, Level 7, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 38 years.
    • Qualification: I. Master’s Degree with 50% marks with excellent command over English. II. Computer key depression speed equivalent to 60 wpm. III. One-year Diploma/Proficiency Certificate in Computer and office applications from recognised institution.
    • Experience: 5 years relevant experience in Govt. organisations in Pay Level 6. Desirable: English stenography/shorthand speed 100 wpm.
  • Junior Assistant (Multi Skill) (Group C, Level 3, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 30 years.
    • Qualification: Bachelor’s Degree with 50% marks in any discipline with excellent computer proficiency in office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint etc.).
    • Experience: 3 years relevant experience in office practices / hospitality and catering services.
  • Senior Superintendent (Group B, Level 7, UR-01) – Deputation
    • Upper Age Limit: Not exceeding 56 years (as per DoPT OM).
    • Qualification: Master’s Degree in any discipline with at least 50% marks or equivalent grade.
    • Experience: At least 5 years in Pay Level 6 or above as Junior Superintendent or equivalent, handling Admin/Finance & Accounts/Academic/Legal/Statutory/Audit/Stores & Purchase/Establishment in Central/State Govt., funded institutes, universities or comparable institutions.
  • Senior Technical Officer (IT) (Group A, Level 11, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 50 years.
    • Qualification: B.E./B.Tech in relevant field with first class or equivalent (6.5/10 CGPA) and consistently excellent academic record.
    • Experience: 5 years relevant ICT experience in a post carrying Pay Level 10 or equivalent.
  • Technical Officer (Lab) (Group A, Level 10, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 40 years.
    • Qualification: M.Sc./BS-MS Degree in Instrumentation/Physical Science with first class or equivalent (6.5/10) and consistently excellent academic record.
    • Experience: 5 years proven research/laboratory experience in operation of scientific/technical equipment and support to academic/research framework in premier institutes, with total 5 years post-master’s lab/research experience.
  • Junior Technical Assistant (Lab) (Group C, Level 5, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 33 years.
    • Qualification: Bachelor’s Degree in Geology with at least 55% marks.
    • Experience: 5 years relevant experience in laboratory/academic/research establishments of national/international repute, handling equipment related to Earth & Environmental Sciences labs.
  • Assistant Engineer (Civil) (Group B, Level 7, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 38 years.
    • Qualification & Experience: Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering with first class and 3 years relevant experience in Level 6 as Junior Engineer or above in institutional building construction/maintenance/design & planning as per CPWD norms. OR Diploma in Civil Engineering with first class and 5 years relevant experience in Level 6 as Junior Engineer or above in similar CPWD-norm based works.
  • Junior Engineer (Electrical) (Group B, Level 6, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 35 years.
    • Qualification & Experience: Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical/HVAC Engineering with first class and at least 5 years field experience in electrical/HVAC construction/maintenance works, preferably as per CPWD/PWD/Govt. norms. OR Diploma in Electrical/HVAC Engineering with first class and at least 8 years similar field experience.
  • Medical Officer (Group A, Level 10 + NPA, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 40 years.
    • Qualification: MBBS or equivalent included in any Schedule to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956, registered in State/Indian Medical Register.
    • Experience: At least 5 years post-qualification experience after internship in a recognised large/multi-speciality hospital of good repute. Desirable: MD in General Medicine or equivalent, registered in State/Indian Medical Register.
  • Nurse (Group B, Level 7, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 38 years.
    • Qualification: Master’s Degree with 50% marks in Nursing from recognised University/Institution OR First Class B.Sc. (Nursing) 4-year Degree from recognised University/Institute, registered as Nurse & Midwife with Indian/State Nursing Council.
    • Experience: 5 years clinical experience in minimum 50-bedded hospital recognised by Central/State Govt./MCI.
  • Junior Library Superintendent (Group B, Level 6, 01 post reserved for PwBD – OA/OL/HH)
    • Upper Age Limit: 35 years.
    • Qualification: Master’s Degree in Library Science/Library & Information Science with 55% marks OR First class Bachelor’s Degree in Library Science/Library & Information Science.
    • Desirable: Diploma/Certificate in Computer Application/Digital Library Management/Library Automation or sufficient experience in library digitisation and networking.
    • Experience: 5 years in Library & Information Science in digital library management/automation/networking in Central/State Govt., autonomous bodies, universities, or higher education institutes.
  • Physical Education Instructor (Group B, Level 7, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 38 years.
    • Qualification: I. Master’s Degree in Physical Education and Sports/Sports Science with first class or 50% marks. II. Diploma in Coaching from NIS or equivalent. III. Must qualify prescribed physical fitness test as per UGC regulations.
    • Experience: I. 5 years in Central/State educational institutes/organisations of repute. II. Demonstrated meritorious performance in national/international events (at least twice in past 4 years). III. Representation at University/College/State/National level competitions. IV. Evidence of organising competitions and coaching camps of at least 2 weeks. V. Evidence of having produced good team/athlete performances at State/National/Inter-University level.
  • Junior Translator (Rajbhasha) (Group B, Level 6, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 35 years.
    • Qualification: Master’s Degree from recognised University in:
      • Hindi with English as compulsory/elective or medium at degree level, OR
      • English with Hindi as compulsory/elective or medium at degree level, OR
      • Any subject with Hindi medium and English as compulsory/elective or medium, OR
      • Any subject with English medium and Hindi as compulsory/elective or medium, OR
      • Any subject with both Hindi and English as compulsory/elective or one as medium and other as compulsory/elective at degree level.
    • Experience: At least 5 years office environment experience with Hindi/English typing skills, excellent computer skills for correspondence/files, and knowledge of translation (Hindi–English and vice versa).

Application Fee

  • Application Fee: Rs. 500 per post (non-refundable) to be paid online.
  • Exempted Categories: Women, SC, ST, Ex-servicemen, PwD and Transgender candidates (on uploading relevant self-attested certificates/ID).
  • Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.
  • Separate applications and separate fees are required for each post applied.

How To Apply

  • Applications must be submitted online only through IISER Berhampur website: www.iiserbpr.ac.in (online link under recruitment section).
  • No hard copy of application is required to be sent at the time of online submission.
  • During online application, candidates must upload legible self-attested copies (where applicable) of:
    • Educational qualifications and marksheets.
    • Experience certificates.
    • Caste/Community certificate, PwD/Transgender certificate, Ex-servicemen discharge certificate, etc.
    • Valid ID proof issued by State/Central Government.
  • Scan and upload photograph and signature as per specified guidelines:
    • Photo: Recent colour passport size, 200x230 px, 10–100 KB, .jpg/.jpeg, light background.
    • Signature: On white paper with black/blue pen, 140x60 px, 10–100 KB, .jpg/.jpeg; signature in CAPITAL letters not accepted.
  • All communication, including recruitment schedule, shortlist/rejection lists and updates, will be made via email and institute website; candidates must provide an active email ID and check the website regularly.
  • Candidates currently in Government/Semi-Government/Autonomous/PSU service must upload NOC-cum-Vigilance-cum-Experience Certificate in prescribed format at online submission stage.

Important Dates

Event Date / Time
Notification Date 31/12/2025
Opening date for online application 31/01/2026 – 09:00 hrs
Closing date for online application 02/03/2026 – 17:30 hrs
Crucial date for age, qualification & experience 02/03/2026

Instructions

  • IISER Berhampur promotes gender equality and encourages women applicants.
  • Eligibility regarding age, qualification and experience is reckoned as on 02/03/2026; degrees must be from recognised universities/institutes.
  • Age relaxation will be as per Government of India norms; SC/ST/OBC relaxations apply only against reserved vacancies and require valid community certificates issued before the advertisement date; no relaxation for these categories against UR posts.
  • For existing regular IISER Berhampur employees, there is no upper age limit, provided at least one year of service remains before superannuation on last date of application.
  • Deputation posts will follow DoPT guidelines; deputation term generally three years, extendable as per rules.
  • Institute may conduct written and/or trade tests, fix additional shortlisting criteria, and alter number of positions (including consequential vacancies) based on requirements.
  • Mere fulfilment of eligibility does not guarantee being called for test; shortlisting will be as per institute’s criteria and decision will be final; canvassing will lead to disqualification.
  • All documents and antecedents will be verified; submission of fake documents or suppression of information will lead to termination.
  • Probation period for regular positions is one year.
  • PWD eligibility and suitable disability categories/physical requirements are defined post-wise in the notification; minimum 40% disability is required for PwD reservation.
  • Interviews are dispensed with for Group C and Group B Non-Gazetted posts; selection will be based on written/trade tests as per DoPT OMs.
  • Any dispute with recruitment/selection will fall under jurisdiction of Courts/Tribunals at Berhampur, Ganjam, Odisha.
  • For technical issues during online application, candidates may write to: [email protected].

  • M.A. in English with minimum 50% marks and M.Ed. with minimum 50% marks for Teacher Educator in English.
  • Master Degree in Physical Education (M.P.Ed) with minimum 50% marks for Physical Education Instructor.
  • Master Degree in Fine Arts(Visual Arts with minimum 50% marks) or Master Degree in Performing Arts(Music/Dance/Theatre) with minimum 50% marks for Art Education Instructor.

Salary/Stipend

  • 35,400-1,12,400 Level-9, Cell-1 (as per ORSP Rules, 2017)

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2025)

  • Minimum Age: 21 years
  • Maximum Age: 42 years
  • However, the upper age limit is relaxable by 5 years for candidates belonging to SEBC, SC, ST and all Women candidates, 10 years for candidates belonging to PwD category and the total period of service rendered in defence service in case of Ex-servicemen. PwD candidates in the ST and SC category shall be entitled to cumulative age relaxation of ten years over and above the normal relaxation specified for the category. However, a candidate who comes under more than one category shall be eligible for only one benefit of age relaxation as per rule which will be most beneficial to her/him.

Application Fee

  • The candidates other than SC, ST and PwD category shall deposit the examination fee amounting to Rupees Five hundred (₹ 500/-) only through online mode in Odisha Treasury portal linked with the online application form.
  • SC/ST/PwD: Exempted

Important Dates

Event Date
Online Registration 12.01.2026 to 11.02.2026
Submission of Online Application Form 12.01.2026 to 14.02.2026
Date of Editing of Online Application Form 12.01.2026 to 17.02.2026
Preliminary examination During March/April, 2026

Selection Process

  • Stage - I: Preliminary Examination- 150 marks
  • Stage - II: (a) Main Written Examination: Technical paper(s)- 200 Marks.
  • Stage - III: Certificate Verification

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates must possess a valid e-Mail ID and Mobile number while applying for the post and keep the same active till the completion of this recruitment process to receive important messages from the Commission.
  • The appointment will be only against one of the posts carrying the corresponding pay as indicated in the above table and candidates need to give option for the posts/services.
  • The candidates other than SC, ST and PwD category shall have to pay the Examination fee of Rupees Five Hundred (₹ 500/-) only. The examination fee paid shall be refunded to the candidates who actually appear in the recruitment examination.
  • Appointments shall be on a regular basis, carrying the level of pay as mentioned in the table above.
  • Candidates should ensure that they fulfill all the eligibility criteria prescribed for the post as laid down in the advertisement. Admission of a candidate to the written examination and other tests shall be provisional and based on the information furnished by her/him in the Online Application Form.
  • Online applications submitted to OSSC found to be incomplete in any respect are liable for rejection without entertaining any correspondence with the applicants on that matter.
  • If at any stage of recruitment or thereafter, it is found that any information furnished by the candidate in her/his Online Application Form is false/incorrect or the candidate has suppressed any relevant information or the candidate otherwise does not satisfy the eligibility criteria prescribed for the post, her/his candidature for the posts shall be cancelled. She/ He may further be debarred either temporarily or permanently from the recruitment examination(s) conducted by the Commission.
  • Commission will adopt a “Normalisation Formula” published in Commission’s website vide Notice No.2444/ OSSC dated 02.09.2021 for processing the result if any examination is conducted through CBRE (Computer Based Recruitment Examination)/OMR in multiple batches using different sets of question papers so as to offset the difficulty level that may arise in such use of multiple sets of question papers in the said examination, and such normalized score will be used to determine the last selection marks of different categories. The Commission at its discretion will conduct the examination either through OMR or through CBRE mode.
  • No Admission Letter for recruitment at any stage shall be sent by post. The candidates are therefore advised to be in touch with the Commission's website www.ossc.gov.in regularly to know updates regarding the status of application, downloading of Admission Letter and the date of examination etc.
  • The candidates are advised to submit the Online Application Form well in advance without waiting for the closing date to avoid the last-hour rush.
  • As regards the candidates applying for more than one post/ service as per their eligibility, the Commission will make the final allotment to a post/ service on the basis of merit-cum-preference of post/ service given by the candidate. Once a post is allotted, no change of posts will be made by the Commission due to non-fulfilment of any post-specific requirements of Physical/medical/educational standards, etc. Candidates thus must ensure that they fulfil all the requirements of the posts before giving their preference/options for any post/ service.
  • The candidate has to fill/confirm in the OMR answer sheet or CBRE Screen, as the case may be, correct Roll Number and other data as required in the place(s) indicated therein and darken the appropriate circles properly in Blue or Black Ball Point Pen only in case of OMR-based examination. If the information so furnished is incomplete or different from the application form or if appropriate circle is not darkened properly, then zero marks will be awarded.
  • There shall be no provision for re-evaluation/ re-checking of scores in the Examination. No correspondence in this regard shall be entertained.
  • Sharing of marks with the candidates: Marks obtained by an applicant in Preliminary Examination and Main Examination are proposed to be shared with her/him after final merit list is published.
  • All the posts are State Cadre posts. The candidate, on selection, may be asked to serve anywhere in Odisha.
  • If a candidate scoring more than the last selection mark at any stage of the examination is not qualified for the subsequent stage/ final selection due to any reason, he must represent to the Commission within 05 days of the declaration of the said result through e-mail [email protected].
  • Applicants who are Government servants or working under PSUs of the State Govt. or Central Govt. should obtain a “No Objection Certificate” from their controlling authority and upload the same with the Online Application form. In case a standing order of NOC is issued by any Department of Govt the same should be uploaded. At the certificate verification stage they must produce the “No Objection certificate” or “Standing order of NOC issued by the concerned Department of Govt.”. Those who are not Government Servants/working in PSUs at the time of submission of application but became Government Servants subsequently should have to submit “No Objection Certificate” or “Standing order of NOC” at the stage of certificate verification. If any candidate hides her/ his Govt. servant/PSU Employees status, and found to be a Govt. servant or a PSU Employee during Certificate Verification may not be considered for recommendation.

How to Apply

  • The applicants should go through the detail advertisement before filling up the online application form.
  • The candidate may apply for the post as per her/his eligibility as per terms of the advertisement.
  • All eligible candidates have to register themselves by clicking on "APPLY ONLINE" button on the home page of the Commission's website www.ossc.gov.in.
  • Those candidates who are applying for the first time have to register for the post by clicking on "NEW USER" button shown on the screen. On submitting the registration form a User Id and Password will be generated.
  • On clicking "New user" or "Registered User", instruction for filling up the Online Registration/ Re-registration and Application Forms shall appear on the computer screen. These instructions should be read carefully before proceeding with filling up the Application Form.
  • Step-by-step procedure for registration/ re-registration can be viewed by clicking on "Instruction to fill up Online Application Form".

  • The number of vacancies (including Reserve Panel) may increase or decrease depending on actual requirement at the time of engagement.
  • Candidates must ensure they fulfil eligibility criteria; furnishing false/incorrect information or suppression of material facts will lead to termination of candidature/services.
  • Selected candidates must furnish a security deposit of Rs. 25,000/- in the form of Demand Draft payable to IRCTC Ltd., Mumbai.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending the walk-in interview.
  • Knowledge of computer (MS Office) and report preparation, and ability to solve problems and make rational decisions, are desirable.
  • Candidates can appear for interview at any one convenient place only.

How to Apply

  • Submit the application form and documents at the venue for verification before the interview.
  • Attend the personal interview as per the schedule; latecomers beyond the stated time window will not be entertained.
  • Keep checking the IRCTC website (www.irctc.com) for any corrigendum/clarification including changes in date/place of interview.
