Who is Eligible for ISRO SAC Recruitment 2026?

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply for all posts.
  • Scientist/Engineer ‘SD’ (Post Code 01 – RF and Microwave): PhD in fields related to RF and Microwave Engineering, with essential qualifications including M.E./M.Tech/MSc (Engg)/MS/MSc or equivalent with aggregate minimum 60% or CGPA 6.5; and/or B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc (Engg) or equivalent with aggregate minimum 65% or CGPA 6.84; and/or B.Sc with 60% marks or CGPA 6.5 on a 10 point scale, in relevant fields.
  • Scientist/Engineer ‘SD’ (Post Code 02 – Wireless/Satellite/Digital Communication): PhD in fields related to Electronics and Communication/Wireless Communication/Satellite Communication/Digital Communication, with essential M.E./M.Tech/MSc (Engg)/MS/MSc or equivalent with minimum 60% or CGPA 6.5 and/or B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc (Engg) or equivalent with minimum 65% or CGPA 6.84 and/or B.Sc with 60% or CGPA 6.5, in related disciplines.
  • Scientist/Engineer ‘SD’ (Post Code 03 – Agricultural Physics/Agricultural Meteorology): PhD in Agricultural Physics/Agricultural Meteorology or related fields, with essential MSc/MS/M.E./M.Tech/MSc (Engg) or equivalent with minimum 60% or CGPA 6.5 and/or B.Sc/B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc (Engg) with minimum 65% or CGPA 6.84 and/or B.Sc with 60% or CGPA 6.5, in relevant fields.
  • Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’ (Post Code 04 – Electronics and Communication): M.E./M.Tech in RF Engineering/Microwave Engineering/Radar Engineering/Electronics/Electronics & Communication/Electronics & Electrical Engineering or equivalent with minimum 60% or CGPA/CPI 6.5; and B.E./B.Tech in Electronics/Electronics & Communication/Electronics & Electrical Engineering/Electronics and Instrumentation/Electrical Engineering or equivalent with minimum 65% or CGPA/CPI 6.84.
  • Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’ (Post Code 05 – Electronics and Communication): M.E./M.Tech in Microelectronics/VLSI Design/Embedded Systems/VLSI and Embedded Systems/Integrated Circuits and Systems/Semiconductor Technologies or equivalent with minimum 60% or CGPA/CPI 6.5; and B.E./B.Tech in Electronics/Electronics & Communication/Electronics & Electrical Engineering/Electrical Engineering or equivalent with minimum 65% or CGPA/CPI 6.84.
  • Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’ (Post Code 06 – Electronics and Communication – Wireless/Satellite/Digital Communication): M.E./M.Tech in Wireless Communication/Satellite Communication/Digital Communication or equivalent with minimum 60% or CGPA/CPI 6.5; and B.E./B.Tech in Electronics/Electronics & Communication/Electronics & Electrical Engineering/Electrical Engineering or equivalent with minimum 65% or CGPA/CPI 6.84.
  • Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’ (Post Codes 07 and 08 – Computer Science Engineering): M.E./M.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering/Computer Engineering/Information Technology/AI & ML/Computer Vision/Data Science/Cyber Security (and for Post Code 08 also M.E./M.Tech in Computer Science/Information Technology/Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning) or equivalent with minimum 60% or CGPA/CPI 6.5; and B.E./B.Tech in corresponding Computer Science/IT related disciplines with minimum 65% or CGPA/CPI 6.84.
  • Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’ (Post Code 09 – Power Electronics): M.E./M.Tech in Power Electronics/Power System Engineering/Power Electronics & Drives/Power Control & Drives/Power & Industrial Drives/Electronics & Communication Engineering/Electronics and Electrical Engineering/Instrumentation & Control/Electrical Engineering or equivalent with minimum 60% or CGPA/CPI 6.5; and B.E./B.Tech in the corresponding disciplines with minimum 65% or CGPA/CPI 6.84.
  • Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’ (Post Code 10 – Applied Optics/Optical Engineering/Optics & Photonics/Optics & Optoelectronics): M.E./M.Tech in Applied Optics/Optical Engineering/Optics & Photonics/Optics and Optoelectronics or equivalent with minimum 60% or CGPA/CPI 6.5; and B.E./B.Tech in Applied Optics/Optics and Optoelectronics/Optical Engineering/Optics & Photonics Engineering/Engineering Physics or equivalent, or M.Sc (Physics), with minimum 65% or CGPA/CPI 6.84.
  • Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’ (Post Code 11 – Civil/Agricultural Engineering/Hydrology): M.E./M.Tech in Civil Engineering/Agricultural Engineering/Hydrology with specialization in Water Resources Engineering or Soil/Land and Water Engineering or Surface/Ground Water Hydrology or equivalent with minimum 60% or CGPA/CPI 6.5; and B.E./B.Tech in Civil/Agricultural Engineering or equivalent with minimum 65% or CGPA/CPI 6.84.
  • Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’ (Post Code 12 – Agriculture): M.Sc in Agronomy/Horticulture/Agricultural Statistics/Agricultural Physics/Agricultural Meteorology or equivalent with minimum 65% or CGPA 6.84; and B.Sc/B.Sc (Hons.) in Agricultural Sciences or equivalent with minimum 60% or CGPA 6.5.
  • Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’ (Post Code 13 – Statistics/Mathematics/Applied Mathematics): M.Sc in Statistics/Mathematics/Applied Mathematics or equivalent with minimum 65% or CGPA 6.84; and B.Sc in Statistics/Mathematics/Applied Mathematics or equivalent with minimum 60% or CGPA 6.5.
  • Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’ (Post Code 14 – Physical Oceanography): M.Sc in Physics/Mathematics/Physical Oceanography/Oceanography/Oceanic Science/Ocean and Atmospheric Sciences or equivalent with minimum 65% or CGPA 6.84; and B.Sc in Physics/Mathematics/Chemistry or equivalent with minimum 60% or CGPA 6.5.
  • Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’ (Post Code 15 – Marine Biology/Marine Science): M.Sc in Marine Biology/Marine Biology and Oceanography/Marine Biology and Fisheries/Fisheries Sciences or equivalent with minimum 65% or CGPA 6.84; and B.Sc with minimum 60% or CGPA 6.5.
  • Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’ (Post Code 16 – Atmospheric Science and Oceanography): M.Sc in Physics/Atmospheric Science/Meteorology and related specialization/Physical Oceanography/Oceanography or equivalent with minimum 65% or CGPA 6.84; and B.Sc with Physics/Mathematics or equivalent with minimum 60% or CGPA 6.5.
  • Candidates who have pursued professional courses through Open and Distance Learning (ODL) are not eligible. It is a pre-requisite that prescribed qualifications are completed within the stipulated duration of the course as prescribed by the university, and CGPA/percentage must meet ISRO/DOS norms without conversion beyond what is stated.

What is the Salary for ISRO SAC Scientist/ Engineer Posts?

  • Scientist/Engineer ‘SD’ (Post Codes 01-03): Pay Level 11 in the Pay Matrix (₹67,100–₹2,08,700).
  • Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’ (Post Codes 04-16): Pay Level 10 in the Pay Matrix (₹56,100–₹1,77,500).
  • In addition, Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA) and Transport Allowance are payable as per extant rules.
  • Employees will be governed by the National Pension System/Unified Pension Scheme.
  • Other admissible benefits as per DOS/Central Government orders include medical facilities for self and dependents, subsidised canteen, quarters facility in lieu of HRA, Leave Travel Concession, Group Insurance, House Building Advance etc.

Age Limit (as on 12-02-2026)

  • Scientist/Engineer ‘SD’ (Post Codes 01-03): 18–35 years as on 12.02.2026.
  • Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’ (Post Codes 04-11, M.E./M.Tech based recruitment): 18–30 years as on 12.02.2026.
  • Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’ (Post Codes 12-16, M.Sc based recruitment): 18–28 years as on 12.02.2026.
  • Serving Central Government Employees, Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBDs) and Ex-Servicemen etc. are eligible for upper age relaxation as per extant Government of India rules/orders.

Application Fee

  • There is no application fee for the post of Scientist/Engineer ‘SD’ (Post Codes 01-03).
  • For all applicants for other posts, an application fee of ₹750/- has to be paid uniformly at the initial stage.
  • Refund of application fee is available only to candidates who appear in the written test: full refund for candidates exempted from fee (women, SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen), and refund of ₹500 (after deducting ₹250 as application fee) for other candidates.
  • Candidates must provide correct bank account details for receipt of refund; SAC (ISRO) will not be responsible for non-receipt due to incorrect details.
  • Application fee must be paid only through the Bharatkosh payment portal using permitted modes such as net banking, UPI, credit/debit cards; payment by cash, cheque, draft, money order, IPO, etc. is not allowed.

Important Dates

Event Date & Time
Opening date for online registration and applications on website 23.01.2026 (from 1000 hrs)
Closing date for online registration, submission of application, payment of application fees and printing of application summary 12.02.2026 (till 1700 hrs)
Cut-off date for all purposes like computation of age and acquiring essential qualification(s) 12.02.2026

What is the Selection Process for ISRO SAC Jobs?

  • For Scientist/Engineer ‘SD’ (Post Codes 01-03): Initial screening based on online applications through ISRO Live Register portal to shortlist candidates for interview; prescribed qualifications are minimum requirements and do not automatically ensure eligibility; final selection based on performance in interview only.
  • For Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’ (Post Codes 04-16): Two level recruitment process consisting of a Written Test and a Personal Interview.
  • Written Test pattern includes Part-A (Area/Discipline Specific MCQs), Part-B (Aptitude/Ability MCQs) for all relevant post codes, and Part-C (Descriptive technical questions) additionally for M.E./M.Tech-based recruitment (Post Codes 04-11), with specified duration, marks, and negative marking rules.
  • Candidates are shortlisted for Interview in ratio 1:5 based on Written Test performance, with a minimum of 10 candidates; for reserved vacancies, candidates are shortlisted in 1:5 ratio independently of UR shortlisting.
  • Qualifying criteria specify minimum percentage marks in each part of the Written Test and aggregate marks in the Interview, with different thresholds for UR and reserved candidates as given in the advertisement.
  • For final panel generation for Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’, 50% weightage is given to Written Test marks and 50% to Interview marks.
  • Tie-breaking in panel for Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’ posts uses, in order, marks in Written Test, marks in essential qualification, and date of birth (older candidates placed higher).

General Information/Instructions

  • Only online applications will be entertained; physical applications will not be accepted. Posts are temporary but likely to continue; number of vacancies is provisional and may change depending on organisational requirements.
  • ISRO/DOS/Centres/Autonomous Bodies reserve the right to cancel recruitment at any stage, and to post candidates to any ISRO Centre/Unit situated anywhere in India as and when required.
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. No interim correspondence/phone calls will be entertained regarding details already provided in the advertisement.
  • Candidates must ensure they fulfil eligibility criteria and comply with instructions in the advertisement and application form; any incorrect information at any stage will lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • Vacancies for Computer Science Engineering under Post Code 07 are for ISRO Centres/Units, while vacancy under Post Code 08 is for NESAC (Autonomous body under DOS); separate applications and fee payment are required if candidates apply for both.
  • Candidates can apply for more than one post; SAC reserves the right to conduct examination for two or more posts simultaneously as per administrative exigency; candidates applying for multiple posts should select the same city for the written test.
  • The online recruitment portal will be available on SAC website (https://www.sac.gov.in or https://careers.sac.gov.in) from 23.01.2026 (1000 hrs) to 12.02.2026 (1700 hrs). ISRO Live Register portal at https://www.isro.gov.in (Career tab) must be used for registration/update for Scientist/Engineer ‘SD’ posts.
  • Application once submitted online cannot be edited. After submission and successful payment, withdrawal is not permitted, and no refund will be granted on grounds of withdrawal.
  • PwBD candidates must produce original disability certificate in prescribed format, issued by a duly constituted Medical Board, indicating at least 40% benchmark disability, in accordance with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.
  • Important contact numbers for technical queries during online application are 079-2691 5512/10, and for general queries 079-2691 3022/24; email address is [email protected], available between 10:00 AM to 05:00 PM, except Saturday, Sunday and National Holidays.

How to Apply for ISRO SAC Scientist/ Engineer Posts 2026?

  • Applications will be received online only through ISRO Live Register portal and SAC’s recruitment portal. Candidates must register or update their registration in ISRO’s Live Register portal at https://www.isro.gov.in (Career tab) on or before 12.02.2026 (1700 hrs).
  • For online registration and application, the link will be hosted on SAC website https://www.sac.gov.in or https://careers.sac.gov.in from 23.01.2026 (1000 hrs) to 12.02.2026 (1700 hrs.); only online mode of applications will be accepted.
  • Upon online registration, an online Registration Number will be generated, which must be carefully preserved for future reference. After registration, candidates must proceed to complete the online application, verify all details, and then submit.
  • Applicants must provide a valid and correct e-mail ID in the online application compulsorily, as e-Admit Cards for Written Test/Personal Interview will be sent only through e-mail; no separate hard copy will be sent.
  • Candidates must upload clear images/scanned copies of their recent colour passport size photograph (not older than 6 months), signature, essential/pre-requisite qualification certificates, and applicable caste/PwBD/ESM certificates in specified formats and sizes, failing which their applications will be rejected.
  • Photograph must be in .jpg/.jpeg format (maximum 1MB, 500x500 pixels), signature in .jpg/.jpeg format (maximum 1MB, 700x200 pixels), and certificates in .pdf format (maximum 1MB). Selfies, blurred photos, black and white photos, or unclear signatures will lead to rejection.
  • After filling all details and uploading documents, candidates will be redirected to Bharatkosh payment portal for application fee payment, where they must select a payment aggregator and mode (net banking, UPI, credit/debit card), complete payment, and retain SMS/email confirmation.
  • In case payment is debited but confirmation is not received, candidates are advised to wait 24 hours before initiating a new transaction. All applicable service charges for payment of application fee are to be borne by the applicant.
  • During online application, candidates must choose a city for written examination from the list of eighteen cities including Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Bhopal, Bhubaneshwar, Chandigarh, Chennai, Dehradun, Guwahati, Hyderabad, Jaipur, Kolkata, Lucknow, Mumbai, Nagpur, New Delhi, Raipur, Ranchi and Thiruvananthapuram. SAC reserves the right to conduct examination only in Ahmedabad or in other city/cities as feasible.
  • Candidates are advised to bring, on the day of Written Test, a valid Government-issued photo ID in original and printed copy of the e-Admit Card sent to their email. They should also keep a printout/screenshot of the online application summary for future reference, as the site will not remain open for printing after 1700 hours of 12.02.2026.

IITGN IPDF 2026 Vacancy & Project Details

The advertisement is for an Institute Postdoctoral Fellow (IPDF) position at IIT Gandhinagar for the project titled “Thermodynamic Framework Development and Fabrication of Stable Lubricant Infused Micropatterned Slippery Non-Wetting Surfaces for Underwater Applications”. The candidate will contribute to the development and validation of a thermodynamic framework for designing and fabricating liquid-based slippery hydrophobic micropatterned surfaces for underwater applications.

Experimental techniques such as spin coating, dip coating, lithography, electron microscopy, contact angle goniometry and drop adhesion tests will be used, and the durability of slippery surfaces for underwater applications will be investigated.

Eligibility Criteria for IITGN Institute Postdoctoral Fellow 2026

1. Educational Qualification

Candidates must fulfill the following essential requirements:

  • Ph.D. degree in one of the following or allied fields with relevant background:
    Materials Science and Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Ceramic Engineering, Food Engineering, Chemistry, Physics.
  • The percentage/grade points should be a minimum of 60% or equivalent grade from graduation onwards.
  • At least 55% marks or equivalent in classes 10th and 12th is required.
  • Candidates who have submitted Ph.D. thesis are also eligible to apply.

2. Age Limit

The advertisement does not specify an age limit for the Institute Postdoctoral Fellow position.

3. Project-related Skills

Given the project description, candidates are expected to have relevant research background and interest in:

  • Thermodynamic framework development for liquid-based slippery hydrophobic surfaces.
  • Experimental techniques such as spin coating, dip coating, lithography, electron microscopy, contact angle goniometry and drop adhesion tests.
  • Investigation of durability of slippery surfaces for underwater applications.

Selection Process for IITGN Institute Postdoctoral Fellow 2026

The selection process will involve:

  • Shortlisting of candidates based on eligibility, academic performance and relevant research background.
  • Interview conducted in online mode.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be informed regarding the date and time of the interview via email.

Application Fee for IITGN Institute Postdoctoral Fellow 2026

Project Details

Project Title: Development of Bioinspired Hydrogel Adhesives for Minimally Invasive Internal Wound Sealing

Principal Investigator: Prof. Mukesh Dhanka, Department of Biological Engineering

Job Description

  • Design, synthesize, and characterize novel polymeric hydrogel platforms for drug delivery and clinical applications
  • Conduct experiments on chemical synthesis, hydrogel self-assembly, and material characterization
  • Perform cell culture and microbiology studies for biocompatibility and efficacy assessment
  • Develop and validate animal models for gastrointestinal wound evaluation and inflammatory bowel disease research
  • Develop advanced laboratory skills in chemical synthesis and self-assembled hydrogels
  • Opportunity to work on grant proposal development and inter-IIT collaborative projects
  • Conduct independent research and contribute to scientific publications

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

  • PhD degree from a reputed institute in any of the following disciplines:
  • Veterinary Science
  • Clinical Biochemistry
  • Chemistry
  • Nanotechnology
  • Chemical Engineering
  • Biomedical Engineering
  • Pharmaceutical Sciences
  • Material Sciences or allied subject areas

Academic Performance

  • Minimum 60% or equivalent grade in all qualifications from Graduation onwards
  • Minimum 55% or equivalent grade in 10th and 12th standard
  • Must have a good scientific publication record
  • Candidates who have defended their thesis and can join immediately are equally eligible

Desirable Qualifications & Experience

  • Expertise in chemical synthesis and polymeric material development
  • Experience in hydrogel development and self-assembly techniques
  • Knowledge of cell culture and microbiology methodologies
  • Prior experience in developing animal models for gastrointestinal wounds and anastomosis
  • Research background in inflammatory bowel disease (IBD)
  • Track record of scientific publications in peer-reviewed journals
  • Highly motivated, continuous learner with ability to work independently

Salary and Benefits

Monthly Remuneration: Rs. 72,000 - 85,000 (Consolidated)

The consolidated salary includes basic pay, dearness allowance, house rent allowance, and other applicable allowances as per IIT Gandhinagar norms.

Duration

Initial appointment is for 1 year, renewable for up to 2 more years based on annual performance review and project continuation. The position is contingent upon the continuation of the funded research project.

Important Dates

Event Date
Last Date for Application Submission 15-02-2026

Application Procedure

Candidates must send their complete application via email to Prof. Mukesh Dhanka at [email protected] with the subject line: "Application for Postdoctoral Fellow - [Your Full Name]"

Documents Required (All in Single PDF)

  • Current Curriculum Vitae (CV) with complete list of publications
  • One-page summary of previous research work and professional experience
  • One-page write-up explaining motivation for this postdoctoral position and research interests
  • Names and complete contact details (email and phone) of 2 potential academic referees
  • Certified copies of degree certificates and mark sheets (10th onwards)
  • Category/Caste certificate if applicable

Selection Process

  • Evaluation of applications based on CV, research background, and publication record
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview (online or in-person)
  • Technical discussion on research experience and project-specific knowledge
  • Final selection based on overall merit and fit for the research project

General Information

  • This is a position on contract basis only. No permanent employment is guaranteed.
  • The researcher is expected to work full-time on the assigned research project.
  • Accommodation will not be provided by IIT Gandhinagar. Candidates must arrange their own housing.
  • No travel or transport allowances will be provided for interviews or joining.
  • The position is contingent upon availability of project funding and satisfactory performance reviews.

  • Junior Clerk: Graduation or its equivalent academic qualification from any UGC recognized university

  • Starting Date for Apply Online: 22-12-2025

General Information/Instructions

  • Advertisement No. BKNMU/3/2023 dated 11/12/2023 and No. BKNMU/2/2024-25 dated 15/03/2024 are cancelled vide circular No.BKNMU/Mahekam/517/2025 dated 17/11/2025 which is uploaded on the university website. The candidates who have applied in response to advertisement No.BKNMU/3/2023 and No. BKNMU/2/2024-25 are required to apply afresh. They will receive refund for the fee paid earlier.
  • The Candidate must apply online. Only online application with required uploaded enclosures will be accepted.
  • Last date for the online application: 12/01/2026.
  • The applicant must send two hard copy of the application along with all self-attested testimonials, certificates and all supporting documents relating to the post on or before 17/01/2026 up to 06:00 p.m. to the University through Courier/In Person/ Registered Post/Speed Post to “The Registrar, Bhakta Kavi Narsinh Mehta University, Government Polytechnic Campus, Bhakta Kavi Narsinh Mehta University Road, Khadiya, Junagadh-362263" or else the application will not be considered.
  • The prescribed application fee shall be ₹1,500/- (Rupees One Thousand Five Hundred only) for Unreserved category candidates and ₹750/- (Rupees Seven Hundred Fifty only) for candidates belonging to Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), Socially and Economically Backward Class (SEBC), and Economically Weaker Section (EWS). The fee shall be payable online. The transaction receipt and the relevant reserved category certificate in the Government-prescribed proforma must be attached with the hard copy of the application without fail. Candidates belonging to the SEBC category shall also be required to attach a valid Non-Creamy Layer Certificate.
  • Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) are exempted from payment of the prescribed fees upon submission of the relevant Disability Certificate issued by the competent authority as per the policy of the Government of Gujarat.
  • Bank charges towards the online payment service (as applicable) will be borne by the candidates.
  • Application fee is not refundable.
  • Candidates must produce original testimonials, certificates and other documents at the time of interview, if called/needed.
  • Application sent through email will not be entertained.
  • Candidates are advised to submit the hard copy of the application to the University well in advance without waiting for the last date to avoid postal delay or any delay due to other unforeseen events or circumstances. The University will not be responsible for any postal delay at any stage.
  • Annexure – I “Check List” is mandatory for all posts. Supporting documents must be sequenced in order of the checklist with page numbers.
  • Annexure – II “Endorsement by the employer” is mandatory for already employed applicants.
  • Bhakta Kavi Narsinh Mehta University, Junagadh reserves all rights whether to fill up or not, any or all the vacancies advertised and also to make any amendments/modifications regarding eligibility criteria and required experiences and other provisions as per Government of Gujarat rules and Gujarat Public Universities Act-2023 and Gujarat Public Universities Uniform Statutes-2024 of the University.
  • Application should be submitted as per given online proforma only. Incomplete/without attaching necessary testimonials/without online payment of prescribed fees or application received after last date would be rejected.
  • Candidate should possess the required educational qualifications on the prescribed last date of online submission of application. No updates/additions will be entertained after the last date of submission of the online applications.
  • Any Corrigendum / Addendum for any further information and or update shall be uploaded only on the website of the BKNMU, Junagadh.
  • The University reserves the right to short-list the candidates on the merit-based/aptitude test/written test criteria or any other method for the purpose of inviting the candidates for interview. The decision of Bhakta Kavi Narsinh Mehta University with regard to the process of selection shall be final and binding to the candidates.
  • The selection process for the above post vide Sr.No.4 to 7 will be exam-based merit. The syllabus, exam pattern etc will be uploaded on the university website.
  • The experience gained as Daily Wager, Trainee, Honorary, Adhoc and Visiting Faculty cannot be considered as experience.
  • A salary certificate for the month of November, 2025 showing Pay Matrix Range, Pay Matix Level, D.A. and other allowances being paid by your Institution/Office/Firm should be enclosed with the application form and also be produced at the time of interview for salaried person, if already employed.
  • Age relaxation will be provided as per the existing Government of Gujarat rules.
  • Upper Age limit will be counted as on last date of submission of online application.
  • Candidates in their own interest are advised to visit University website: www.bknmu.edu.in regularly for updates.
  • The University shall verify the antecedents or documents submitted at any time, at the time of appointment or during the tenure of the service. In case, it is found that any document submitted is fake or the candidate has clandestine antecedents/background and has suppressed the said information, his/her services shall be terminated forthwith.
  • Candidates already in employment in University, Educational Institutions, Government Establishments and Organizations should forward their applications (hardcopy) through proper channel. In case the applicant is in service and delay is expected in getting endorsement of the concerned employer on the original application, the applicant may submit advance copy of the application along with all the enclosures directly (without the employer's endorsement on the advance copy). If the original application through proper channel has not been received on or before last date mentioned, the applicant will have to submit a 'NO OBJECTION CERTIFICATE' from his/her employer to the University at the time of interview.
  • The appointment of the selected candidate on Fixed Pay for the posts given on Sr.No.4,5,6 and 7 on regular basis shall be subject to the Terms and conditions laid down by the state Government Resolution dated 16/02/2006 & 28/03/2016 and their amendments from time to time by Government of Gujarat. Recruitment of Non-teaching/Administrative post as mentioned in Sr.No.4,5,6 and 7 shall be as per Resolution No. KhRCh/2002/57/(Part-4)/z.1, dated 18-10-2023 of Finance Department, Government of Gujarat on fixed pay for the first five years and its amendments from time to time.
  • The candidate appointed through direct recruitment shall, after receiving regular appointment, be covered under the New Defined Contributory Pension Scheme introduced by the State Government from 1st April 2005, as per the provisions of the Finance Department's Resolution No.: NPN/2003/G.O.I./10 (P.F.A.) dated 18th March 2005.
  • In case of any inadvertent mistake in the process of selection which may be detected at any stage even after the issuance of appointment letter and/or after appointment, the University reserves the right to modify/withdraw/cancel any communication made to the candidates.
  • Age of superannuation for all the positions shall be as per Govt. of Gujarat norms.
  • The University will not be responsible for any loss of e-mail, loss of any communication due to wrong address provided by the candidates.
  • Fake/Derecognized Institutions: Candidates, who have obtained degrees or diplomas or certificates for various courses from any Institution declared fake/derecognized by the University Grants Commission, New Delhi shall not be eligible for being considered for recruitment to the posts advertised.
  • In case of tie in the final merit list score in written test, interview, appropriate policy decided by the university shall be employed. And in case of any discrepancy in the above-mentioned guidelines, the decision of the BKNM university shall be considered as final.
  • For any query regarding technical support, contact: 079-23238887 or [email protected] and [email protected] for other queries

How to Apply

  • The Candidate must apply online. Only online application with required uploaded enclosures will be accepted.
  • The applicant must send two hard copy of the application along with all self-attested testimonials, certificates and all supporting documents relating to the post on or before 17/01/2026 up to 06:00 p.m. to the University through Courier/In Person/ Registered Post/Speed Post to “The Registrar, Bhakta Kavi Narsinh Mehta University, Government Polytechnic Campus, Bhakta Kavi Narsinh Mehta University Road, Khadiya, Junagadh-362263" or else the application will not be considered.
